name: Borredalsmila
description: Borredalsmila is an exciting race that offers varied terrain and challenging hills. The courses stretch through beautiful nature in Fredrikstadmarka, and participants get to experience both challenges and natural beauty. It is designed for both beginners and experienced runners, with distances suitable for everyone. The race has been organized since 1988, and in 2014 it became the first race to run in the opposite direction.
course_highlights: The courses stretch through beautiful nature, and participants get to experience both challenges and natural wonders.
It is designed for both beginners and experienced runners, with distances that suit everyone.
The 10 km races take place on gravel roads, and partly on mountains, in Fredrikstadmarka.

images.alt_text: Cyclists on a trail in the woods.
Runners and spectators enjoy themselves around a campfire after or before the race.

name: Bygdøymila
description: Bygdøymila is a fantastic race that takes you around the entire Bygdøy peninsula in Oslo, consisting of 50 percent asphalt and 50 percent gravel on a gently undulating course. The race was first held in the 1980s before it was discontinued, but it has been revived and organized in the last couple of years. This year, there were nearly 1500 registered participants, spread across the distances of 10 km, 6 km, 3 km, and the mini race, with the most participants in the main distance of 10 km.
course_highlights: The race takes you around the entire Bygdøy peninsula in Oslo, with a course that consists of 50 percent asphalt and 50 percent gravel.
Bygdøymila has experienced a significant resurgence and has become a very popular race in recent years.
A total of nearly 1500 participants registered, with 681 lining up for the main distance of 10 km.

images.alt_text: Runners in Bygdøymila. The race takes place on a gravel road along the sea. Several runners with bib numbers.
Runners in the Bygdøy Mile ran, wearing race numbers, on a path with autumn leaves in the background.
Runners at the starting line for Bygdøymila.
Map of the Bygdøy Mile course in Bygdøy, Oslo.

name: UM/NM Terrengløp, lang løype
description: We welcome you to the Norwegian Championships in cross-country running long course at Nordbytjernet, Jessheim! The course is planned as a loop of 1.5 km that will be run several times depending on the distance. There will also be an opportunity to participate in the recreational class, where you can add a loop up Grønlivegen for a total distance of 8 km. Remember that the deadline for regular registration ends at midnight on October 3rd.
course_highlights: The course follows a developed gravel path around the idyllic Igltjønna in Rindal Center.
It will be a 1.5 km loop that will be run several times depending on the distance.
The recreational class can, if desired, add a loop up Grønlivegen to Elshaug and back via Landsem along the old Grønlivegen, resulting in a total distance of 8 km.

name: Snøkuten Nordhagarunden
description: The Snøkuten Nordhagarunden takes place on October 17, 2023, and has a distance of 9.5 km. The race is part of the Snøkuten series and offers participants the opportunity to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings. The Nordhagarunden is quite demanding, and participants experience a varied course with both uphill and downhill sections. This race is a great opportunity for both experienced runners and beginners to test their limits.
course_highlights: The race is part of the Snøkuten series and gives participants the opportunity to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings.
The Nordhagarunden is 9.5 kilometers long and quite challenging, with varied obstacles along the course.
Only 24 raced the Nordhagarunden for time, but there were plenty of joggers with reflectors along the course.

Runners with headlamps and reflective vests ready for night running on snow.

name: Hjerteløpet 5K
description: The Heart Run 5K was held on Thursday, October 24, in Holmenkollen by the pharmaceutical company Boehringer Ingelheim, to benefit Adults with Congenital Heart Defects (VMH) and the Organ Donation Foundation. Nearly 300 people participated in the event, where they could choose to walk or run 3 or 5 km in Norway's ski arena at the top of Oslo. This was the first time the race was held in Holmenkollen, and the course was steep.
course_highlights: Participants could choose to walk or run 3 or 5 km in Norway's ski arena at the top of Oslo.
The Heart Race 5K is a refreshing fun run that starts and finishes at the Ski Arena in Holmenkollen.
Everyone is welcome, and it's free!

images.alt_text: The Heart Race 5k in Holmenkollen. People gathered in front of the ski jump.
People gathered at the Holmenkollen ski jump in brilliant sunshine.
Runners participating in a race, with start bibs and spectators in the background.

name: Lommedalen Rundt
description: Lommedalen Rundt is a race on the hills around Lommedalen in Bærum, first organized in 2015. The course is 19 km and mainly runs on trails and through forests, starting and finishing at Bærum Golf Club. There is also a separate 3 km race for children, and the 19 km distance caters to all levels of ambition. Each year, a few dozen runners complete more than 2 laps.
course_highlights: The course is 19 km and mainly runs on trails and through the forest.
The start and finish are at Bærum Golf Club.
A separate 3 km race for children and 19 km caters to all levels of ambition.

images.alt_text: Runner in mountain terrain, cross-country running. Waterfalls and snow in the background.
Runners in the cross-country race Lommedalen Rundt, Bærum.
Runners in cross-country running, possibly Lommedalen Round.

name: Kvalheimmila - Bislett
description: Kvalheimmila is a track race where everyone is welcome to participate. The race is held at Bislett Stadium, providing you with a great opportunity for a personal best in the 5 km or 10 km. The waves are divided according to desired finish times, and all waves receive pacers to help guide you to the finish line. But remember, you still have to run!
course_highlights: Kvalheimmila is Oslo's flattest and most even fun run!
The race takes place at Bislett Stadium, also known as the world record track in international athletics.
The arena is set up with a screen for passing times, upbeat music, and drink stations to ensure a great environment for fast races.

images.alt_text: Kvalheimmila ran at Bislett Stadium. Runners on the track with floodlights and an audience. 5 km and 10 km races.
Poster for Kvalheimmila at Bislett Stadium, featuring runners, date, distances, and information about the race.

name: Bergen Maraton
description: The Bergen City Marathon offers several distances for participants, including the Sport 1 Marathon (42 km), Jæger Half Marathon (21 km), BT Relay, Oris Dental 5 km, and Vestkanten Children's Race (2 km). The course is designed to be inclusive and suitable for various skill levels, with an elevation profile that provides a diverse experience for the runners. Race day starts with a group warm-up at 7:15 AM and concludes with Bryggen reopening to traffic at 4 PM. Bergen is the marathon city number 1 in Norway.
course_highlights: The Bergen City Marathon offers several distances for participants, including the Sport 1 Marathon (42 km) and the Jæger Half Marathon (21 km).
The course is designed to be inclusive and adaptable to different skill levels, with an elevation profile that provides a varied experience for the runners.
Race day starts with a group warm-up at 07:15 and concludes with Bryggen reopening for traffic at 16:00.

images.alt_text: Night picture of the city of Bergen, glowing buildings along the water and up the mountainside.
Night view over Bergen, with lights in the buildings and mountains in the background.
Bergen Marathon poster: Runners, date, distances. Anniversary logo.
Bergen Marathon logo with runners in the background.

name: Lillomarka Rundt
description: Lillomarka Rundt is a 50-kilometer loop on trails in Lillomarka, featuring 2500 meters of elevation gain and technical trails with a bit of gravel. The route passes through Sinober, which is the northernmost point, and participants are advised to bring their own food due to the length. The start is at Skytta kindergarten, and the race takes you through rolling terrain, with beautiful views from heights of 400 meters above sea level.
course_highlights: The course has an elevation gain of 2500 meters and consists of technical trail with a little bit of gravel.
We start at Skytta kindergarten, and the first leg goes over to Steinbruvann.
Well arrived at Sinober, we are at about 400 meters altitude, almost at the top of Lillomarka.

name: Hinnaløpet
description: The Hinnaløpet is an annual running competition held for the 39th time in Stavanger, Rogaland. There are two course options: Hinnaløpet, a challenging loop course of 9.3 km starting from Hinna Stadium into Sørmarka, where 70% of the route is on gravel and the rest on asphalt, and "Hinnaberget 5980," a shorter and less demanding variant of 5.98 km. The courses provide participants with a unique experience of the region's beautiful natural areas, featuring stage climbs up the hills in Sørmarka.
course_highlights: The Hinnaløpet offers a challenging loop course of 9.3 km, where 70% of the route is on gravel.
"Hinnaberget 5980" is a shorter and less demanding variant of the Hinnaløpet, with the same start and finish.
The race starts at 2:00 PM at Hinna Sports Park, which is also the finish area.

images.alt_text: Runners on a forest trail during the Hinnaløpet.
Hinnaløpet: Runners on their way to the finish line. The race takes place at the stadium.
Runners in a fun run are running on an asphalt road on a sunny day.
Map of the Hinnaløpet "Hinnaberget" course, featuring the start/finish and elevation points.

name: Checkpoint Melshei
description: Checkpoint Melshei is a low-threshold trail run that stands out because there is no fixed route. Participants must visit three checkpoints in Melsheia, but they choose their own path between them. You can opt to run on fast surfaces like gravel or asphalt, but that means a longer distance, or you can aim for a shorter route with rougher terrain off the trails. The race is held simultaneously with Hardhausens, creating a great atmosphere and a "full house" at the SI cabin on this day, complete with a kiosk, announcer, changing rooms, and lots of people.
course_highlights: What makes the race special is that there is no fixed course you have to follow.
Participants must pass through three locations in Melsheia, which are called checkpoints.
The race is held simultaneously with Hardhausen, so there will be a great atmosphere and a "full house" at the SI cabin on this day!

images.alt_text: Logo for Checkpoint Melshei with nature and buildings in the background.

name: Checkpoint Melshei 2026
description:
Checkpoint Melshei is a low-threshold trail run in Melsheia in Sandnes. The start and finish are at the SI cabin.

The course runs between three checkpoints that the runners must visit. Participants can choose their own route to the checkpoints. The checkpoints are announced in advance so that runners can plan their race.

The terrain depends on the route choice and will vary from fast surfaces like asphalt and gravel to trails and rougher terrain with varying elevation.

You can expect to run between 7 and 10 km.

Prizes for winners in each category, in addition to random draw prizes.

Kiosk and speaker at the venue. Restrooms and changing rooms at the SI cabin.
additional: See also https://www.sandnes-idrettslag.no/orientering/arrangement/checkpoint-melshei/
course_highlights: Checkpoint Melshei is an accessible trail run.
Participants choose their own route between three checkpoints in Melsheia.
The race is organized simultaneously with Hardhausen, which creates a great atmosphere and a "full house" at the SI cabin.

name: Mærraskallen Terrengløp
description: Mærraskallen – Trail running for the whole family takes place at Fossum on Saturday, October 22. Mærraskallen 15 km is a challenging course (approximately 15.7 km) where the first two-thirds involve a lot of elevation gain with running on trails and in marshland, while the last third is mostly downhill and on gravel roads. It is recommended that the youngest participants run together with an adult. Mærraskallen 4.2 km is a loop on the illuminated trail at Fossum, and Mærraskallen Mini 1.5 km is a race for the youngest with an open class for everyone under 12 years old, without timing.
course_highlights: The Mærraskallen 15 km features a challenging course with significant elevation gain and varied terrain.
It is recommended that the youngest runners participate alongside an adult to ensure a safe experience.
Mærraskallen Mini 1.5 km is an informal race for children under 12 years old, without timing.

name: Norgestesten Løp 7
description: The Norway Test is organized by volunteers from the Jessheim Running Group and Ull/Kisa Athletics, and the proceeds go towards promoting sports for children and youth. The race takes place in Jessheim with a mass start, and the course is 3,146 meters long and flat. Simple logistics make the race efficient, with the option to take the train or park 300 meters from the start. There are also many experienced pacers to help participants find the right pace, as well as a great children's race and distances ranging from 3 km to half marathon.
course_highlights: Mass start and many experienced pace setters who help you find the right pace.
The course is 3,146 m long and flat, making it accessible for all levels.
Great children's race and distances from 3 km to half marathon.

images.alt_text: Runners in a road race in Jessheim.

name: Glesværløpet
description: Welcome to the annual Glesvær Race in autumn splendor and great atmosphere! You can participate in the competitive class or the recreational class with Turtipp, and there is a beautiful course of 4.5 km. For a 3 km longer route, you can take the Coastal Path to Gløpsa. The Glesvær Race is a collaboration between Glesnes Youth and Sports Club, Sotra Øygarden Hiking Club, and the Trading Town of Glesvær, and the race is sponsored by local businesses.
course_highlights: You can participate in the competition class or the recreational class with Turtipp.
Great course of 4.5 km.
Participant prizes and drawing of prizes.

name: Ottestad Løpsfestival
description: The race festival in Ottestad consists of three races: HOKA Ottestad Rundt 17 kilometers (with and without timing) and the Spenst race 5 kilometers (with and without timing). Additionally, there is a children's race, the Sport1 sprint, with distances of 400 m, 1 km, and 1.8 km.
course_highlights: HOKA Ottestad Round 17 kilometers (with and without timing).
The Spenst Run 5 kilometers (with and without timing).
Children's race, Sport1 Sprint, with distances of 400 m, 1 km, and 1.8 km.

name: Svalandsgubben
description: Svalandsgubben Skauløp has become a term among both elite runners and recreational athletes. Every year since its inception in 1974, the last Sunday in October is the day everyone talks about. When the traditional event kicks off with a bang on Sunday, October 31, 2021, it will be for the 48th time, still in the prime of life for those enduring tough challenges. The race covers 27 kilometers of mud, marsh, and hardship, and despite the challenges, 973 participants lined up at the starting line.
course_highlights: Svalandsgubben has become a popular event among both elite runners and recreational runners since 1974.
The race takes place on the last Sunday in October, a tradition that has lasted for nearly 50 years.
Participants must navigate through 27 kilometers of challenging terrain consisting of mud and marsh.

name: Nightrun Trondheim
description: Nightrun Trondheim is an exciting running experience that takes you through scenic surroundings. The first 2 kilometers around the lake are relatively flat, while for about 1.5 kilometers, it gradually rises towards the end of Baklidammen. After that, it descends towards the finish line for the last 1.5 kilometers. The terrain is mostly gravel paths, but there are also sections with forest trails and forest floor. The route starts at the playground in the woods, across the road from Ferista parking, and you run counterclockwise.
course_highlights: The first 2 kilometers around the lake are relatively flat.
The course steadily rises towards the end of Baklidammen.
The surface is mostly gravel path, with some sections of forest trail and forest floor.

name: RunRudskogen
description: A 10-kilometer race on the very main track of Rudskogen, where the perfect asphalt usually belongs to screeching tires and roaring engines. RunRudskogen is a unique opportunity to run in the footsteps of motorsport, surrounded by the vibrant energy of Norway's most famous racetrack. Here, you can test your limits whether you are an experienced runner looking for a race event you have never experienced before, or looking for a fun activity for friends or the work crew!
course_highlights: The race takes place at Rudskogen's main track, known for its perfect asphalt.
RunRudskogen offers a unique opportunity to run in the footsteps of motorsport.
The event is suitable for both experienced runners and those looking for a fun activity with friends.

images.alt_text: Runners on the way.

name: Kondisløpet Langdistanse
description: Set yourself a training goal for the running season and sign up for the Kondisløpet long distance event. Here you can choose between the distances of 10 kilometers and half marathon. The race will take place in Elverum on November 1st, and the organizer, Kondtreninga Elverum, also offers a virtual option for those who wish to run wherever they want during the period of November 1st to 9th. When you sign up, you will receive a link to a page where you will enter your time, and timing during the physical event will be conducted via Strava.
course_highlights: Choose between the distances of 10 kilometers and half marathon.
Physical event in Elverum on November 1st.
Virtual solution available from November 1st to 9th.

name: Hålandsheia Rundt
description: Hålandsheia Rundt is a popular running event in Mandal, combining trail and road over a distance of 11 km. The race starts and finishes at Frøyland School, taking participants through the beautiful and hilly landscape of Hålandsheia. The route goes around the entire Hålandsheia, offering fantastic views of the town and the sea, and includes a trip down to Buøya.
course_highlights: Hålandsheia is one of Mandal's most popular hiking areas, known for its varied terrain with marshes, forests, and bare mountains.
The route is 11 km long and goes around the entire Hålandsheia, with the option to climb up to Flovarden for an even better view.
The terrain offers open nature with pine forests, deciduous forests, and spruce forests, as well as historical sites like "The Scout Cabin."

name: Tjømejoggen - høst
description: Tjømejoggen - autumn takes place at Lindhøy, Tjøme, on Sunday, March 16. The race starts at 12:00 PM with a 10 km, followed by a 5 km at 12:05 PM and a 2 km at 12:07 PM. If there are few participants, there will be a mass start for all distances at 12:00 PM. The courses run along the bike path towards Verdens Ende, with turnarounds marked for each distance.
course_highlights: The race goes along the bike path towards the World's End.
The 2 km has a turn after 1 km, the 5 km has a turn after 2.5 km, and the 10 km has a turn after 5 km.
Turns will be marked.

name: Ledlenser Nightrun
description: Ledlenser Nightrun is organized by Springtime Event AS in Bergen and takes place from Fløyen with a distance of 7.6 km. The race starts at 7:00 PM, and there are separate categories for both women and men in the age groups under 25, 25-39, 40-54, and over 55. All participants receive a medal, and there are prizes for the top three in each category, as well as self-service baggage storage in the starting area.
course_highlights: The race starts from Fløyen with a distance of 7.6 km.
The start time is at 7:00 PM, and there are separate categories for both women and men.
All participants receive a medal, and there are prizes for the top three in each category.

name: Åstveit 3000
description: Åstveit 3000 is a classic 3000m race taking place on November 13, 2025, with a registration deadline of November 10. The event is open to men and women aged 18 to 99, and there are limited spots in the heats. Participants are encouraged to provide their personal best time to ensure even heats, and pacers will be available. Race numbers can be picked up on race day from 5:00 PM at the athletics track.
course_highlights: The participants were good at writing down their personal best times/season best times in advance, so we could create even heats and almost everyone got to run with someone at their level.
Pacers will also be provided.
Sign up for the correct heat based on your estimated race time.

name: Vinterkarusellen 2. løp
description: Ålesund Winter Carousel consists of 5 races, of which the Winter Carousel's 2nd race is part of this series. The courses are designed for both beginners and experienced runners, and it is a great opportunity to test your fitness throughout the winter.
course_highlights: The courses are designed for both beginners and experienced runners.
It's a great opportunity to test your fitness throughout the winter.

name: 3-Sjøersløpet
description: The 3-Lakes Race is one of Norway's most enjoyable events to participate in, and it takes place in Stavanger with 5,200 participants. The course is both varied and beautiful, offering a fantastic sightseeing experience of some of the best that Stavanger has to offer. Follow one of our skilled pacers who will help you maintain the right pace along the way, and experience the exciting atmosphere with people, flags, and music along the route.
course_highlights: About 80% of the course is on a forgiving gravel surface, while the rest is on asphalt.
The course has around 160 meters of elevation gain, with quite a few downhill sections at the start and several small and large hills around Hålandsvatnet.
After 15 km, you encounter a long and gentle slope, before it steeply descends back to Store Stokkavatn, with only 400 meters left to the finish line after the final hill up towards Tjensvollkrysset.

name: Vinterkarusellen Ålesund 1. løp
description: Ålesund Winter Carousel consists of 5 races throughout the winter, starting at 2:00 PM from BestDrive in Fremmerholen every other Saturday from November to March. The first race in the winter carousel 2025/2026 takes place on Saturday, November 8, 2025. Participants can choose between two distances of 5 and 10 km, which are held on officially measured courses into Brusdalen. The 5 km distance also has a category for recreational runners without timing, and there is little car traffic on Gamle Brusdals veg.
course_highlights: The race features two distances of 5 and 10 km on certified courses.
The 5 km distance has a category for recreational runners without timing.
Participants keep their race numbers throughout the entire series, which saves both time and the environment.

name: Søgne Morothon
description: In 2024, we offer Langmoro 20 km and Kortmoro 10 km + children's race. The start and finish are at the new stadium in Søgne, and we will use the same course as in previous years. The courses are well marked, and you can see the latest course map on our FB pages.
course_highlights: Long Fun 20 km and Short Fun 10 km + kids' race.
Start and finish at the new stadium in Søgne.
The trails are well marked.

name: Morothon
description: Morothon is a traditional trail race held annually in Søgne, and it has become an important event for both local and visiting runners. The race is known for its challenging routes and the great atmosphere among participants. Today, Morothon offers several distances, including Langmoro at 20 km, Kortmoro at 10 km, and a children's race. The most important aspect of Morothon is participation; it is a celebration of community, endurance, and joy.
course_highlights: The race has earned a reputation as the toughest trail run in Southern Norway, measured in km per hour based on the winning time.
Morothon is known for its inclusive atmosphere, where everyone who finishes is regarded as a winner.
The race is held on the first Saturday after the first Sunday in November, and the entire course is marked with blue.

name: Dogrun - Trøgstad
location: utenfor fabrikken til VOM og Hundemat
description: Dogrun is for everyone who wants to participate in a pleasant activity with their dog. You can choose to compete with or without timing. There is an anniversary race in Trøgstad, taking place on Sunday, November 9, 2025, at 12:00 PM. The start and finish line are outside the VOM and Hundemat factory in Trøgstad.
course_highlights: Dogrun is for everyone who wants to participate in a pleasant activity with their dog.
You can choose with or without timing.
The start and finish are outside the VOM and Hundemat factory in Trøgstad.

name: Refleksløpet Kristiansand
description: The Reflective Race in Kristiansand invites you to a magical evening run with headlamps on Thursday, November 13. The start and finish line is at Fant Olsen in Baneheia, with registration starting at 4:30 PM. Finishers can start from 5:00 PM, while there will be a mass start with timing at 6:00 PM. The course is 4.1 km long and runs along the outskirts of Baneheia, marked with reflective markers. Participants must have a light, and mulled wine and porridge will be served after the finish.
course_highlights: The course runs along the outskirts of Baneheia and has a length of 4.1 km.
The course will be marked with reflective markers, and you must have a flashlight to participate.
Serving of mulled wine and porridge after the finish.

name: Arborettrimmen 1
description: The Arboretum Run is a lovely tradition that has been organized since Einar Søndeland started it in 1978. It had a record number of participants in 1983 with 587 runners, including Grete Waitz. The race offers distances to suit every taste in the beautiful surroundings of the Arboretum, where participants can choose to run one (2.7 km), two (5.4 km), or three (8.1 km) laps. For the children, a Mini Run of 600 m is set up, starting at 2:00 PM.
course_highlights: The race has a long and wonderful tradition and has been a popular event since 1978.
The participant record was set in 1983 with 587 participants, including the famous runner Grete Waitz.
Participants can choose from several distances, including 2.7 km, 5.4 km, and 8.1 km, as well as a 600 m Minitrim for children.

description: The Østmarka Trail Challenge organizes tough and challenging trail races in Østmarka. This race, taking place on Saturday, August 23, 2025, is not for the faint-hearted, as it features 37 km of technically demanding terrain and nearly 1000 meters of elevation gain. Participants will encounter trails that go over roots and rocks, and after many hours of preparation, one will feel ready for this challenge.
course_highlights: This race is not for the faint-hearted.

name: Hodelyktløpet Østmarka
description: Østmarka Trail Challenge – The Headlamp Race is a technically demanding trail run of approximately 12 km, primarily on blue and red marked paths in Østmarka. The course will be marked throughout by the organizers, but the chances of going off course are certainly present, so it is important to pay close attention, especially in the technical sections. A good headlamp is a must! From the start at Skullerud, we follow the Refugee Route up to Rundvann, before taking the technically challenging blue trail downhill.

In 2024, it will be held for the third time, and Einar Engdal has shared photos from the race. Results from the race are available, but unfortunately, several runners were recorded as not finishing.
course_highlights: A traditional race where many of the world's best orienteers have participated.
3. Christmas Day Race 2024 Einar Engdal has kindly shared photos from the race.
You can find the results from the race here.

name: Nyttårsløpet Tønsberg
description: The New Year's Run in Tønsberg has been organized for many years and is a fun run for absolutely everyone. Here, the atmosphere is relaxed, and the race is a great way to kick off a new year. Whether you are in peak shape or looking for a leisurely jog on the last day of the year, you are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: The New Year's Run is a fun run for absolutely everyone.
Here, the atmosphere is relaxed, and the race is a great start to a new year.
Whether you are in peak shape or just looking for a leisurely run, you are warmly welcome.

name: Nyttårstrimmen
description: The New Year's Run is a 10 km recreational race suitable for all runners. This race has a long tradition and is Norway's oldest currently active recreational race, held every New Year's Eve since 1975. This year, we celebrate the 50th anniversary of the New Year's Run, which attracts hundreds of participants in Grenland. Participants can expect a varied and enjoyable experience, despite challenges such as snow and weather conditions.
course_highlights: The New Year's run has been going strong every New Year's Eve since 1975.
Last year there were over 1100 registrants, and the organizers hope for even more this year.
The race has a special atmosphere, with various distances and activities for all ages.

name: Lierløpet
description: Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses, running on a wide pathway that is well-used by runners and fitness enthusiasts in the Drammen area. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km), and is open to both those who wish to jog or walk, as well as to those who are well-trained and fast. There is also a children's race, where all participants receive ice cream. Race numbers can be purchased at Lier Station, and the race starts at 12:00 PM.
course_highlights: Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses.
The race takes place on a wide pathway and is well-used by runners and joggers in the Drammen area.
Children's race with ice for all participants.

name: Bjørgene Løpskarusell 4. Løp
description: The athletics group warmly welcomes you to a new running series in Bjørgene on February 4th! The snow is gone and the trails are nice in Bjørgene. We hope to see you at the starting line!
course_highlights: The snow is gone and the trails are nice in Bjørgene.
We hope to see you at the starting line!

Runners on the podium with trophies.

name: Vinterkarusellen 5. løp
description: The 5th race of the Winter Carousel was held at Fana Stadium, where it was crowded with people and 515 finishers in the 5 km as well as 247 in the 10 km. Participation increased significantly compared to the previous winter race, and the racing conditions were good despite a brisk wind in some areas. Markus Galleberg and Eli Anne Dvergsdal were the fastest in the 5 km, while Andre Lenningsvik and Renate Galleberg won the 10 km. This race is part of the Ålesund Winter Carousel, which consists of 5 races tailored for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: The running conditions were good, even though it occasionally got windy in exposed areas of the course.
The Ålesund Winter Carousel consists of 5 races held during the winter months.
Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, where the 5 km course turns around halfway on the 10 km course.

name: Vinterkarusellen 5. løp
description: The 5th race of the Winter Carousel took place at Fana Stadium, where it was crowded with people and a total of 515 participants completed the 5 km, while 247 took part in the double distance. Participation has increased significantly since the winter race 3 weeks ago, and the running conditions were good despite a brisk wind in exposed areas. Markus Galleberg and Eli Anne Dvergsdal were the fastest in the 5 km, while Andre Lenningsvik and Renate Galleberg won the 10 km.
course_highlights: It was again crowded with people at Fana Stadium on Monday evening.
In the 5 km, Markus Galleberg (17:27) and Eli Anne Dvergsdal (17:56) were the best.
Marius Garman Sørli (Ask) and Maike Verhofstad (Gneist) fastest in the 5 km.

name: Eikanger Vintarkarusell 4
description: The second race in the winter series 2025-26 will be on Saturday, November 15, at Eikanger. In total, there will be seven races this season, with three before Christmas and four after New Year. The course is the usual one around Eikangervågen, and registration starts from 2:20 PM.
course_highlights: The race is part of the winter series with a total of seven races this season.
Three races will be held before Christmas and four after the New Year.
Registration for the race starts at 2:20 PM.

name: Snøkuten Nordhagarunden
description: The Snøkuten Nordhagarunden takes place on October 17, 2023, and has a distance of 9.5 km. The race is part of the Snøkuten series and offers participants the chance to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings. The course is quite demanding but takes you through stunning nature, and it is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. This is a popular event in Veldre Athletics' schedule.
course_highlights: The Nordhagarunden was the second to last of the season's six Snøkuter, and only 24 participants raced for time, while many others jogged along the course with reflective gear.
The fastest of them all was Helge Holthe from Gjøvik, who completed the lap in just under 33 minutes, while Therese Sjursen from BGF Fana was the fastest woman with a time of 39 minutes.
The course record from 1987, set by Edvard Dahl, stands at 30 minutes and 11 seconds, while Ragnhild Kvarberg holds the women's record at 35:29.

name: HOKA Solastranden Halvmaraton
description: HOKA Solastranden Half Marathon offers a unique running experience with distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. For the half marathon, runners should be aware that the course marshals will leave after a time limit of 2:40, but timing is open for up to 3 hours. There are also pacers available for all distances, and aid stations provide both water and sports drinks. The race takes place in a scenic area, with parking available at alternative locations nearby.
course_highlights: The race offers options for everyone, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km.
Timing for the half marathon is open for up to 3 hours, with officials monitoring the race times.
There are pacers available for all distances, as well as hydration stations with both water and sports drinks.

name: Vinterkarusellen 6.løp
description: The 6th race of the NECON Winter Series took place on January 20, where 721 participants completed the race despite heavy rain. 382 runners finished the 5 km, while 169 reached the finish line on the double distance. Hector Breivik from Ask was the fastest on the 5 km with a time of 18:13, while Miriam Emilie Stensland Donovan from Lerøy won the women's class with a time of 21:31. In the 10 km, victories went to Magne Knudsen (35:48) and Vanja Flatberg (40:26).
course_highlights: The duo of Linda Grøning (5 km/20:26) and Trine Larsen (10 km/38:20) were the best among the women.
Bjørn Tore Kronen Taranger (5 km/17.24/BFG Bergen Running Club) and Jens Larsen Åstveit (10 km/34.10/Gneist) were the best among the men.
The race was held on winter conditions, which resulted in a slight decrease in the number of participants.

name: 5 Km Sport Glexe
description: Sport 1 Glexe is organizing a 10 KM race on October 12th at 11:00 AM! The race starts at MSG car wash, heading towards Gvarv from Bø. The course has been certified and is a fast route on new pedestrian and cycling paths. The trail is easy to run, and there will be an unattended water station after approximately 3.4 km, 6.6 km, and at the finish line. Restrooms are available at Circle K, but there are no shower facilities.
course_highlights: The race has been officially measured and is a fast course on new pedestrian and bicycle paths.
The route is easy to run on walking and cycling paths.
Unmanned drink station after approximately 3.4 km, 6.6 km, and finish.

name: Bislett Spring 5k
description: The Bislett Spring 5k is held at Bislett Stadium and offers you a juicy opportunity for a personal best in the 5 km. The waves are divided by desired finish time, and all groups receive pacers to help guide them to the finish line. But remember, you still have to run!
course_highlights: Bislett Stadium is the place for running, and it provides a great opportunity to set a personal record.
The groups are divided according to the desired finish time, giving all participants a chance to achieve their goals.
All waves will have pacers to help guide them towards the finish line, creating a motivating atmosphere.

name: Sørlandstesten 5
description: The Sørlandstest is a low-threshold recreational run for everyone who wants a positive running experience, regardless of ambition level. Whether you are training for a larger goal, feeling the competitive nerves, or just looking for a social and active day – this is the race for you! We welcome both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are on the opposite side of the road from Gumpens Auto, along Setesdalsveien in Kristiansand, and participants follow a flat and fast course up Setesdalsveien to Strai, before turning around and running back.
course_highlights: The Sørlandstest is a low-threshold recreational run for everyone who wants a positive running experience, regardless of ambition level.
You don't need fancy equipment or extensive experience – the most important thing is that you show up with a good attitude and a desire to run.
We cheer just as much for the one who crosses the finish line first as for the one who completes their very first race.

name: Vinterkarusellen Løp 4
description: The Winter Carousel is an annual running series that includes several distances, with the courses measured and certified. This means that times achieved during the events will be approved for statistics for both 5 km and 10 km. Participants have the opportunity to set personal records that will be recognized forever. The series has a rich history that began in the mid-1980s, and as of winter 2023, it is Ålesund Races that is once again the organizer.
course_highlights: The courses are measured and certified, ensuring that times achieved during the race will be approved for statistics for both 5 km and 10 km.
Participants have the opportunity to set personal records that will be recognized forever.
The carousel has a participant record of 144 finishers in a single race.

name: Hamarkarusellen Vinter Løp 4
description: Hamarkarusellen Winter is the winter edition of the new Hamarkarusellen, and it follows the same 5-kilometer route for all races, on illuminated walking and cycling paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar. This event warmly welcomes all ambitions, whether you walk or run, with or without a time. There is no registration at the start, and the race provides an excellent opportunity to test your fitness, with 6 races throughout the winter.
course_highlights: We maintain the same controlled 5 kilometers in all the races; this is an excellent opportunity to use it as a test run.
Premiering for participation in all races in the winter series with a unique mug featuring the inscription "Hamarkarusellen Winter 2022/2023."
Serving of juice (and cake on most occasions) at the finish line.

name: Vinterkarusellen Sørlandet
description: The Winter Carousel Sørlandet is an exciting running competition held in Kristiansand. The race has a distance of 10 kilometers, offering participants the chance to experience the beautiful winter landscape of Sørlandet. This race is perfect for both recreational runners and experienced athletes looking to challenge themselves in a winter setting.
course_highlights: The race covers a distance of 10 kilometers, ideal for both beginners and experienced runners.
The Winter Carousel Sørlandet offers participants a unique opportunity to experience the scenic winter in Kristiansand.
The event promotes community and activity in the local area, and is a great opportunity to meet other running enthusiasts.

name: Bergen Vintermaraton
description: The Bergen Winter Marathon will be held for the 5th time on Saturday, January 18, 2025. The start and finish area will be at Fana Stadium. The course consists of a round-trip route on asphalt roads that are either completely car-free or have very little traffic, and a large part of the distance runs along a disused railway track in idyllic, rural surroundings. Exactly half a marathon is run per lap, and the same lap is run twice for a full marathon. The half marathon is run for 1 lap, while the marathon is run for 2 laps.
course_highlights: Bergen Winter Marathon is the first race of the Marathon Carousel's 6 annual races.
The race is always held in January, and the distances you can choose from are half marathon and marathon.
The course is slightly hilly and easy to run, except for a hilltop at Fana Stadium that must be run up and down.

name: B2Run Hannover
description: The B2Run Hannover on May 27, 2026, is a corporate run over a roughly 6.5 km long, mostly flat course along Lake Maschsee with a spectacular finish in the Heinz von Heiden Arena. The race is aimed at companies, organizations, and individual runners from Hannover and the surrounding area and promotes team spirit, motivation, and community feeling. The event offers a professional supporting program with moderation and music and is ideal for beginners, walkers, and experienced runners. The focus is on fun, camaraderie, and team building, not on personal best times.
course_highlights: Approximately 6.5 km long, varied loop course along Lake Maschsee
Mostly flat route suitable for beginners, walkers, and experienced runners
Spectacular finish in the Heinz von Heiden Arena
additional: The event is part of the nationwide B2Run corporate run series in Germany and offers a professional supporting program with moderation and music. Teams can run together to the finish to enjoy the event atmosphere. The event is ideal for team building, corporate health promotion, and active breaks outside of everyday work. 6.5 km course, team event, corporate run, finish in the Heinz-von-Heiden-Arena, personalized team running shirts, focus on team building and corporate fitness.

name: Steglitzer Volkslauf
price_range: 5,00 € Nachmeldegebühr, sonst keine expliziten Preise genannt
description: The Steglitz Volkslauf is a traditional running event taking place on May 27, 2026, at the Lichterfelde Stadium in Berlin-Lichterfelde. Organized by TuS Lichterfelde von 1887 e.V., the Volkslauf offers a sporting opportunity for runners of all ages. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized execution. The races start and end at the Lichterfelde Stadium, providing an attractive setting for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lichterfelde Stadium
Running routes through the surroundings of Berlin-Lichterfelde
Traditional event with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Late registrations are possible online from May 25th (00:01) until 30 minutes before the respective start for a fee of €5.00. Certificates for places 1-3 will be handed out during the award ceremony; all finishers can request a certificate with their place and time after the last runner has finished. Multiple race distances, online registration, start times from 6:00 PM, certificates and age group classifications, event held as part of the Steglitz Festival Weeks.

name: Abendlauf Wilstedt bei Nacht
description: The Wilstedt Evening Run at Night takes place on May 29, 2026, and transforms the village of Wilstedt into an atmospheric running course. The event is family-friendly and open to everyone, from beginners to experienced runners. The new running route offers beautiful views of the village at night. The atmosphere is enhanced by cheering spectators and a fireworks display in the evening.
course_highlights: New running route through Wilstedt with scenic village views
Atmospheric setting with cheering spectators along the course
Floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt after the run until 10:30 PM
additional: Start and finish are at the Wilstedt sports grounds. The event begins with the mini-run at 8:15 PM, followed by jogging and walking starts. Late registrations are possible on the event day from 6:30 PM to 8:00 PM, then participation costs 9 euros. Only pre-registrants receive a T-shirt or functional shirt, which will be handed out on the event day. After the run, free floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt is available until 10:30 PM. A fireworks display will conclude the event around 10:45 PM. Nordic walking poles are not allowed on the course. Children and strollers are only permitted during walking/hiking. Shower and changing facilities are limited. New family-friendly evening run through Wilstedt, including mini-run, fireworks, and musical entertainment, registration until May 17.

name: Lauf Rund um Burg
description: The 37th Run Around Burg is part of the Cross and Forest Run Series and takes place around Burg in Dithmarschen. The event offers runners the opportunity to run on scenic routes of 4.8 km and 10 km. The race is characterized by its natural surroundings and varied course. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and well-organized event.
course_highlights: Running routes of 4.8 km and 10 km
Part of the Cross and Forest Run Series
Natural course around Burg
additional: Typical May weather conditions: approximately 20 °C, mostly cloudy, an average of 55 mm of precipitation. The run is part of a diverse sports program by MTV Burg, with registration via Yolawo. In good weather, children's and youth sports activities are also planned.

name: Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf
description: The Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf is a charity run with the unique concept "Sport meets Music" in support of the Children's Hospice Middle Germany. The event offers various running competitions for children, teenagers, companies, and individual participants as well as walkers. In addition to the sporting event, there is musical accompaniment and a children's garden concert, making the run a special experience for participants and spectators. Race bibs can be picked up the day before, and after the run, there is an AfterRöblinglaufParty.
course_highlights: Variety of runs for children, teenagers, companies, and individual participants
Charity run in support of the Children's Hospice Middle Germany
Musical accompaniment and children's garden concert
additional: Race bib pickup on 28.05.2026 from 15:30 to 18:00 at Schwanenteich in Mühlhausen. Runs with team scoring for children and companies. AfterRöblinglaufParty and children's garden concert as part of the program. Multiple children's, youth, and corporate runs, online registration from 11.01.2026, donations for the Children's Hospice Middle Germany, including music events and after-run party.

name: Nacht von Hasbergen
description: The Night of Hasbergen is a traditional road race taking place on Friday, May 29, 2026, in Hasbergen. The event offers exciting running competitions for all age groups, from the baby run to relay races and the main 10 km race. The races will be held on a new course layout, which has been adjusted due to construction work. The event begins with an opening ceremony and a show act for the children and concludes with award ceremonies for the various competitions.
course_highlights: New course layout due to construction on Tecklenburger Straße
Competitions from 0.5 km baby run to 10 km main race
Street closures and parking bans on the race route from 4:00 PM
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 3:30 PM for a late registration fee of 2 euros. The bib number distribution begins on the day of the event from 3:30 PM at the Citizens' Hall at the Town Hall, Hüggelplatz 1, 49205 Hasbergen. The event includes five competitions: 0.5 km baby run, relay race 5 x 0.5 km, half-distance 5 km (ranking eligible), elite race 5 km, and main race 10 km (ranking eligible). All proceeds from the baby run are donated 100% to youth work in Hasbergen. Various race distances, relay start numbers, late registrations on the day of the event, information on exchange points, online registration, course layout with construction detours.

name: Raesfelder Mai-Lauf
description: The Raesfeld May Run takes place annually on the last Friday in May and offers a diverse range of races for all age groups. From the 400 m Bambini races for preschool children to the 5 km and 10 km runs for adults, there is something for everyone. Additionally, there is a team race over 5 km that promotes the fun of running together. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and are therefore eligible for official rankings.
course_highlights: 400 m child-friendly course for Bambinis
1000 m and 2.3 km courses for children and adolescents
5 km and 10 km DLV-measured courses for adults
additional: Start times: 4:00 PM Bambini races (400 m), 5:00 PM 1000 m school race, 5:30 PM 2.3 km school race, 6:00 PM 10 km Volksbank Run, 6:05 PM 5 km walking run, 7:30 PM 5 km corporate, family, and team run. The 10 km course is run as a 5 km lap twice. Part of the Lippe-Issel Cup, registration required, family-friendly, various categories.

name: VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf
description: The VfL Ahaus City Festival Run takes place on May 29, 2026, and offers runners a well-tested and attractive course in the city of Ahaus. The race is organized by VfL Ahaus 1892 e.V., one of the leading amateur sports clubs in the Münsterland region. The event is open to runners of all ages and features a friendly atmosphere with a focus on health and community. The course has been carefully explored and approved by the VfL Ahaus Running Group, ensuring participants can look forward to a great running experience.
course_highlights: Course tested and approved by the VfL Ahaus Running Group
Attractive city course in Ahaus
Event focused on health and community
additional: Registration opens on March 15, 2026. There are still starting places available. The run takes place as part of the city festival. VfL Ahaus, in cooperation with AOK, also offers functional training courses. The routes are not officially measured; registration begins on March 15, 2026; spots are still available; the event is part of the city festival with a diverse supporting program.

description: The Volksbank Run "Around the Offlumer See" is a traditional running event in Neuenkirchen, Lower Saxony, taking place on May 29, 2026. The course runs around the Offlumer See with start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg. Various races are offered for all age groups, from the toddler run to school runs and the main 10 km race. The event is organized by the SuS 09 Neuenkirchen running club and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with registration on the day of the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg
Course around the Offlumer See, measured by DLV for the 10 km main race
Various distances from 300 m toddler run to 10 km main race
additional: Registration on the day of the event is possible until 30 minutes before each start. Race documents can be picked up from 3:00 PM at the registration tent. Timing is provided by Teamsoft-Sportzeit. Races start in staggered times from 4:00 PM (toddler run) to 7:00 PM (main race). The course runs around the Offlumer See. Registration on the day of the event is possible. Parking is available at the Naturfreibad and Offlumer See.

name: 08. Dünenfeld Marathon
description: The Dünenfeld Marathon in Augustdorf is a special race organized according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large loops of 6.1 km each, totaling 42.7 km, and features some trail sections. The start is located at the viewpoint, from where runners can enjoy a beautiful view of the large dune fields. The event is a private race with self-supply and manual timing, requiring a photo of the clock as proof to be submitted via email.
course_highlights: 7 loops of 6.1 km with trail sections
Start at the viewpoint with a view of the dune fields
Course runs parallel to the dune field and Ölbach
additional: The race takes place with a minimum of 3 participants. There is no entry fee, but a voluntary donation of €5 is requested. Timing is done with a manual stopwatch, and a photo of the clock must be sent on the same day via email. No showers or changing rooms are available. Participants must be at least 18 years old. The course is marked with ribbon. Self-supply is required, as the start area is passed after each lap. Trail character, self-supply, no showers/changing rooms, participation at own risk, limited number of participants, registration until the day before at 6 pm.

name: 19. Lauf zwischen den Meeren
description: The Run Between the Seas is a unique relay race that takes participants as a team on a 92.2-kilometer route from Husum on the North Sea to Damp on the Baltic Sea. The course crosses Schleswig-Holstein and connects the coasts of both seas, with up to ten athletes per team running together. The race promotes both individual performance and community and attracts up to 800 teams from amateur and elite sports. The fastest relay teams take about 5 hours and 10 minutes to reach the finish line around 2:15 PM.
course_highlights: 92.2-kilometer route from Husum to Damp
10 varied stages with distances between 6.9 and 11.5 kilometers
Course passes through flat North Frisia, historic towns, along the Schlei fjord, and through the end-moraine landscape of Schwansen
additional: The entry fee is per team (5-10 runners). Teams registering for the corporate classification pay an additional 19% VAT. Race materials can be sent by mail (shipping option available until March 31, 2026) or collected at two pick-up dates (May 22, 10 AM - 6 PM, May 29, 1 PM - 8 PM). The race starts in Husum at the harbor pier, organized by LAV Husum. The course includes 10 exchange points and is partially temporarily closed for railway crossings. Relay marathon, registration opens June 13, 2025, various stages, team and individual participation, catering and accommodation on site.

name: 3. Abend-Kanallauf Rethmar
location: Sportgelände des MTV Rethmar, Sehnde, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: MTV Rethmar von 1900 e.V. - Sparte Laufen
description: The 3rd Evening Canal Run Rethmar 2026 is a versatile running event at the sports grounds of MTV Rethmar in Sehnde. Offered are distances from 400 meters for children up to the Kalimandscharo half marathon over 21.1 km. The 5 km and 10 km routes are measured and record-eligible, with a slight cross-country character. The event takes place in all weather conditions and is open to runners of all ages, regardless of club affiliation.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km and 10 km routes with a slight cross-country character
Half marathon route Kalimandscharo over 21.1 km
Diverse routes from 400 m for children to half marathon
additional: Late registration fee of 3.00 EUR is waived for 400m and 1,500m for all age groups U18. The 5 km and 10 km routes are measured and record-eligible. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Age group classification according to DLO. Routes measured, cross-country character, online registration, results published after the race, participation in all weather, various age classes.

name: 34. Emder Matjeslauf
description: The 34th Emder Matjeslauf will take place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, in the city center of Emden. The event is a traditional city run organized by the Emder Laufgemeinschaft e.V. since 1991 and is well known beyond the region. In addition to the main race over 10 km, there are also school class competitions and team rankings, making the run a versatile event for all age groups. The course has been adjusted due to construction work on Neutorstraße but still offers an attractive loop through the city. The Emder Laufgemeinschaft looks forward to many participants and wishes everyone good luck.
course_highlights: Loop through the city center of Emden
New course layout due to construction on Neutorstraße
Traditional city run since 1991
additional: The Wattje Loop over 600 meters is limited to 400 participants. There are school class competitions over 1,300 m and 2,500 m as well as a team competition over 5 km. Starting documents and functional shirts will be distributed; cotton or functional shirts can be ordered for Wattje runners while supplies last. Multiple race distances, participant limit of 400 for Wattje Loop, various race times, fixed date on 30.05.2026.

name: 55. Bartenwetzer Volkslauf
description: The Bartenwetzer Volkslauf is the oldest fun run in North Hesse and will take place on May 30, 2026, at the Waldstadion Melsungen. The event includes children's and school runs over 400 m and 1000 m, as well as races over 5 km, 10 km, and 19 km, which lead on firm paths through the Melsungen city forest. As the 10th scoring race of the North Hesse Cup, the run offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, award ceremonies, and a buffet. The start and finish areas are centrally located in the Waldstadion, which also offers changing facilities.
course_highlights: Runs on firm paths through the beautiful Melsungen city forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Melsungen on the edge of the city forest
Course lengths: 5 km, 10 km, and 19 km as well as children's runs on the track
additional: Race number pickup from 14:30 at the MT clubhouse in the Waldstadion. Late registrations on the day of the event are not possible. Changing rooms are available in the MT clubhouse. Refreshments with water on the long distances, warm tea at the finish, and from 15:30 onwards, a buffet with coffee, cake, and bratwurst. Medical services provided by the German Red Cross. Certificates and medals for Bambini and 1000 m runs, certificate printing available on-site or online. The event is subject to the applicable regulations for road and stadium-remote running events. Registration online via RaceResult. Event at Waldstadion Melsungen, including award ceremonies, refreshments, and medical support.

name: HafenCity Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld von 34€ trägt jeder selbst.

description: The HafenCity Run 2026 is a community run at a relaxed pace over a 4 km course through HafenCity Hamburg. There are no prerequisites or timing, with fun and shared experience taking center stage. The run combines recreational sports, team spirit, and charity, with part of the registration fee donated. Participants receive a DAV shirt and can run from age 6 onwards.
course_highlights: 4 km course through HafenCity Hamburg
Running without performance pressure or timing
Charity event with donation share per bib and team
additional: The start window is from 1 PM to 2 PM. There is no time limit or performance pressure. 6 euros from each registration fee and an additional 10 euros per team are donated to the charity fund. Participants receive a DAV shirt, with shirt size to be specified at registration. The run is open to everyone from age 6, with an entry fee of 34 euros, including a DAV shirt. There are no pre-meetings, and the run takes place on May 30, 2026, between 1 PM and 2 PM. The course is approximately 4 km long and runs through HafenCity, focusing on fun and community.

name: Aegidius-Lauf
location: Aegidiushaus, Auf der Bul, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Aegidius Run is a charity race established for over 20 years in Hanover, taking place on May 30, 2026. The event offers several race distances, including children's runs, a wheelchair race, as well as 5 km and 10 km runs and walking variants. Start and finish are at the Aegidiushaus ON THE BULT, and the participation fees go entirely to a good cause. The race course is attractive and is conducted without chip timing, using a stopwatch. All participants receive a certificate, and the top male and female runners are awarded prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Aegidiushaus ON THE BULT in Hanover
Attractive race course with multiple distances (1 km children's run, 5 km, 10 km)
Stopwatch timing without chip timing, certificates for all participants
additional: There is no chip timing, but a stopwatch. All participants receive a certificate, the top three women and men receive prizes. Race shirts will be handed out at the info booths starting at 14:00. The participation fee of 15 euros per adult race goes entirely to a good cause. Children's runs and wheelchair race are free. The event begins with children's runs from 14:00, followed by the 5 km runs and walking at 15:15, and the 10 km run at 16:15. Multiple race distances, online registration, certificates for all, prizes for the top three men and women, no chip timing, race on the backside of the Aegidius-Haus in Hanover.

name: Allbaulauf 2026
description: The AllbauLauf 2026 will take place on May 30th around Niederfeldsee and Krupp-Park in Altendorf, Essen. The event offers a colorful mix of races for students, youth, corporate runners, recreational runners, and competitive athletes. Especially popular are the short distances for toddlers and students, which run directly along the waterfront promenade and over a bridge. The event is a sporting highlight with a variety of running options for all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Around Niederfeldsee and Krupp-Park in Altendorf
Course for toddlers over 300 meters along the waterfront promenade and bridge
Diverse running options from students to competitive athletes
additional: The toddlers start at 12:00 PM on a 300-meter course. The University Championships of the University of Duisburg-Essen are held as part of the AllbauLauf, with registration through the university's sports department. The event includes distances of 300 meters for toddlers, 1 km for students, as well as 5 km and 10 km for adults. Registration is possible via the sports department of the University of Duisburg-Essen. There are also special offers for corporate runs and community events.

name: Bartenwetzer Volkslauf
location: Waldstadion Melsungen, Melsungen, Schwalm-Eder-Kreis, Hessen, Germany
price_range: Erwachsene 8,00 €, Jugendliche und Kinder 4,00 €, Bambini kostenlos

The event includes children's and school runs over 400 m and 1000 m, as well as main runs over 5 km, 10 km, and 19 km, which lead on firm paths through the Melsungen city forest. As the 10th scoring race of the North Hesse Cup, the run offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, award ceremonies, and a buffet. The start and finish areas are idyllically located on the edge of the city forest, making the run particularly attractive.
course_highlights: Runs on firm paths through the beautiful Melsungen city forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Melsungen on the edge of the city forest
Various distances from 400 m to 19 km
additional: Race bibs are issued from 14:30 at the MT clubhouse in the Waldstadion. Changing rooms are available in the MT clubhouse. Refreshments with water are provided on the long distances, warm tea at the finish, and from 15:30 onwards, a buffet with coffee, cake, and bratwurst. Medical services are provided by the German Red Cross. Late registrations on the day of the event are not possible. Certificates can be printed on-site or downloaded online via RaceResult. The courses run through the Melsungen city forest. Registration is only online, race bibs are collected at the clubhouse, no on-site late registration, refreshments at the finish area, medical services by the German Red Cross.

name: Greifenstein Berglauf
organizer: Fussfit Petry GmbH, webconcept GbR, weitere lokale Sponsoren
description: The Greifenstein Mountain Run is a challenging road race over 5.3 km from Ehringshausen-Katzenfurt to Greifenstein Castle, taking place for the 27th time on May 30, 2026. The course runs along country roads and farm tracks with a total of 260 meters of elevation gain to the finish at the castle, which offers a breathtaking view of the region. The race is open to youth, men, women, and seniors, with a combined classification for all categories. Nordic walking is offered without age classifications, and a free Bambini race for the youngest children takes place separately in the afternoon. The event concludes with an award ceremony and refreshments in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle.
course_highlights: 5.3 km road race with 260 meters of elevation
Start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle with panoramic view
Challenging section above Edingen
additional: The registration fee includes bus transfer to the start, clothing transport to the finish, and drinks at both start and finish. Bib numbers and finisher shirts will be distributed on the event day from 14:00 in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle. Late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start on the event day. Parking is available at the village exit of Greifenstein towards Beilstein. A free Bambini race for children will be offered around 16:50, accompanied by members of LG Dill. The award ceremony and refreshments with coffee, cake, cold drinks, and bratwurst will take place in the castle courtyard. On clear days, the courtyard offers an impressive view over the Dill valley to the Feldberg in the Taunus. Registration is open until May 28, 2026, online. Start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle. The race is without relay and walking categories. Results are available since 2008.

name: HIT-felder Volkslauf
description: The HIT-felder Volkslauf is a traditional race in Seevetal organized by TSV Eintracht Hittfeld. It offers courses for the whole family, from short runs on the Peperdieksberg sports facility to longer routes on field and forest paths. The event takes place on May 30, 2026, starting at 1:30 PM and is characterized by a friendly atmosphere with a comprehensive supporting program. All participants receive a finisher medal, and there are team rankings as well as cash prizes for the strongest pre-registered groups.
course_highlights: Courses on field and forest paths as well as partially asphalted side streets
Runs over 600 m, 1000 m, 2.5 km, 4.5 km, 10.6 km with small and large laps
Electronic timing, spikes not allowed
additional: Start and finish at the Hittfeld School Center, Sportanlage Peperdieksberg. Changing rooms and showers available at the school center. Late registrations on the day of the event are possible up to 30 minutes before the start for cash payment (except Roland-Witt-Familienlauf). Supporting program with coffee, cake, grilled sausages, and drinks. Certificates available online at www.stgk.de. Team rankings in certain runs. The most registered group receives a challenge cup and cash prizes. The event takes place in May, with typical weather around 20°C low and 10°C high, and offers not only running routes but also children's runs, walking, and Nordic walking.

name: Internationaler Biesfelder Dorflauf
location: Kürten, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 3,00 € Nachmeldegebühr ab 23.05.2026, sonst keine expliziten Preise genannt
