description: The Velen Animal Garden Run is a family-friendly fun run taking place on June 20, 2026, for the 18th time. With a total of 11 races, it offers routes for all age groups and fitness levels, from mini-marathon to school runs, as well as 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon distances, including Nordic walking. A special highlight is the relay race for families, friends, and colleagues, where four people run consecutively 1400 meters each. The event is held at the comprehensive school Velen and features a wide-ranging program with catering, music, and showers. Proceeds are donated to charitable organizations.

Varied distances from 421.95 m mini-marathon to half marathon
Relay race with 4 x 1400 m as a special highlight

Extensive supporting program with refreshment stands, music, finish line catering, beverage stations along the route, shower facilities in the sports hall, and a valuables deposit. Registration on the day of the event possible until 30 minutes before the start, cash only on the event day. Routes for all age groups, online registration, certificates available online, navigation addresses provided, shower facilities, valuables deposit.

name: Vohwinkeler Fuchslauf 2026

The routes lead through Osterholz and Eulenkopfweg, providing a varied running environment. The event places special emphasis on the participation of the youngest, who will receive a finisher medal regardless of the distance. Late registrations are possible until shortly before each race, offering flexibility for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Waldkampfbahn sports field in Vohwinkel
Course through Osterholz and Eulenkopfweg
Toddler and school runs on the sports field track

The event includes toddler runs (approximately 400 m), school runs (800 m and 1600 m), and 3.2 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances. Every toddler finisher receives a medal. Running courses for children, youth, and adults, online registration, on-site late registration possible, start and finish at Waldkampfbahn, medals for all children participants.

name: 19. Burgberglauf Gehrden
price_range: 3 € pro Kind für Bambini- und Kinderläufe, sonst keine Angaben
description: The Burgberglauf 2026 will take place on June 20th in Gehrden and offers runners various distances on a challenging 3.3 km loop course with approximately 50 meters of elevation. The route passes through forest terrain and fields, requiring good basic fitness. There is a separate flat loop course for children under 12 years old, while toddlers start on shorter rounds around the sports field. The event is family-friendly and features, in addition to the races, a raffle with attractive prizes as well as catering for spectators and participants.

Route passes through forest terrain and fields
Separate flat loop course for children under 12 years old

Parking not possible in the event area. Bib number distribution from 11:00 AM in the sports hall. Fully electronic timing with chip on shoe, chip must be returned after crossing the finish line (€10 fee for loss). Raffle with attractive prizes, main prize a pizza oven. Toddler races (300 m and 700 m) start at 2:00 PM, registration for toddlers also possible on-site on the event day (€3 cash). Catering for spectators with bratwurst, drinks, and ice cream. Route: challenging 3.3 km loop, forest paths, paved; registration only online; bibs in the sports hall; no parking in the event area; toddler races without placements, medal included.

name: Fuffy Twister - From Dusk Till Dawn
description: Fuffy Twister - From Dusk Till Dawn is a 50 km trail ultra marathon in Langenhagen, Germany, starting at night with a time limit of 8 hours. The race takes place in June and is characterized by simple organization with a low entry fee, a finisher medal awarded on-site, and results and certificates published online. The number of participants is small, making it a more local and challenging endurance test. The course runs along the northern edge of Hanover, near Hanover Airport, through Bissendorfer Moor and Kananoher Forest, with varied terrain and moderate elevation gain.
course_highlights: 50 km trail ultra marathon with asphalt, gravel, forest floor, and trail
Loop course on the northern edge of Hanover, near Hanover Airport
Approximately 130 meters of elevation gain, mostly flat terrain
additional: The race has a time limit of 8 hours and starts at night. The number of participants is small, typically in the single digits to high teens among finishers. Finisher medals are awarded on-site, results and certificates are available online. The weather in June is usually sunny with an average of 23°C during the day and 13°C at night. Start at night, 130 m elevation change, small runner group, finisher medal included.

name: Abendlauf TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen
description: The evening run of TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen takes place on June 20, 2026, in Wolfhagen-Ippinghausen. The event offers races over 10 km, half marathon, and marathon on paved and tarmacked forest paths with start and finish at the Weidelsburg Stadium. The course leads through the city forest with scenic sections such as the Stöcketeich and features several refreshment stations. The event is open to all age groups and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with certificates for all participants.
course_highlights: 21 km loop for the half marathon, marathon runs the loop twice
Start and finish at the Weidelsburg Stadium with a scenic loop through the city forest
Multiple refreshment stations (4 for the half marathon, 9 for the marathon) and showers/changing rooms available
additional: Spikes are not allowed in any weather conditions. Start times staggered by age groups from 4:30 PM (bambini) to 5:00 PM (10 km/half marathon/marathon). Each participant receives a certificate. Parking is available at the sports field, Waldecker Straße, and Vor dem Busche. Insurance through HLV for all participants, including non-club members. Courses on paved forest paths and sports field, no spike usage, registration via Raceresult, insurance provided by HLV.

name: Binner Abendlauf
description: The Binner Evening Run is a traditional running event held as part of the sports festival of the Sports and Youth Association Binnen e.V. The race offers a sporting challenge in a friendly and family-oriented atmosphere in Binnen. The event attracts runners of all ages and is a fixed part of the regional sports calendar. In addition to the run, there is a diverse sports festival with other activities and offerings for the whole family.
course_highlights: Running routes through the beautiful surroundings of Binnen
Family-friendly atmosphere at the sports festival
Traditional evening run with a long history
additional: The Binner Evening Run takes place as part of the SJB Sports Festival, which will be held on June 20 and 21, 2026. The event includes, besides the run, other sports and leisure activities. Results of previous races are published on the website. There are no explicit details about start times, fee structures, or participant limits on the available pages. The event is part of the 2026 sports festival, results will be published, and it offers a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Die 49. Nacht von Borgholzhausen
description: The Night of Borgholzhausen is a special running event taking place on June 20, 2026, in the city center of Borgholzhausen. From the Bambini race to school running and the atmospheric 10 km night run, there is something for all age groups and performance levels. The event is characterized by a unique atmosphere, marked by live music, cheerleaders, DJs, and torches along the route. Teams, beginners, and ambitious runners experience an unforgettable evening full of community and running enthusiasm.
course_highlights: Asphalted streets through the city center of Borgholzhausen
Atmosphere along the route with cheerleaders, live music, and DJs
Torch-lit route and garden parties along the course
additional: The event starts with the Bambini run at 6:00 PM (300 m, no time pressure, registration via kindergartens). Followed by two school running events for elementary school children (approx. 1.6 km) and secondary school students (approx. 3 km). The corporate run (5 km) and the 5 km run are suitable for beginners and teams. The highlight is the 10 km night run, which is supported by a special atmosphere with many spectators and music. Individual registrations are possible online until shortly before the last start at 9:30 PM. Various race distances, beginner running course, atmosphere with music and torches, online registration.

name: Europalauf 2026
location: Hennef, Siegtal, Allner See, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 20th Hennefer European Run on June 20, 2026, offers a diverse range of races from 1000 meters up to the half marathon (21.1 km). The routes lead through the center of Hennef, along Lake Allner, and through the picturesque Sieg Valley. The event is family-friendly, featuring beginner-friendly runs for children and beginners as well as challenging courses for ambitious runners. Special emphasis is placed on inclusion, with dedicated races for people with disabilities. The event is organized by the Hennefer Gymnastics Club in cooperation with the city of Hennef and takes place in a friendly, volunteer-driven atmosphere.
course_highlights: Diverse routes from 1000 m to 21.1 km through Hennef, Lake Allner, and Sieg Valley
Half marathon with over 150 meters of elevation gain and five bridge crossings
Panoramic courses with views over the Sieg Valley to the Siebengebirge
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 8:00 AM until 60 minutes before the respective start at the town hall, with a late registration fee of €2 per person and race. Start and finish are located at the Historic Town Hall of Hennef (Frankfurter Straße 97). Changing rooms and showers are available at Kronos Aktivclub. Timing is professionally managed with disposable chips from runtiming. The award ceremony takes place at 1:00 PM in front of the town hall. There is a team challenge with cash prizes for the best teams in the HIT Panorama Run. The courses are not suitable for wheelchair users, and coaching by bicycle leads to disqualification. Various routes are available, including accessible, panoramic, and challenging half marathon with elevation meters and bridges.

name: FORT FUN Westernlauf

description: The FORT FUN Western Run on June 20, 2026, is a popular running event at the FORT FUN Adventure Land amusement park in Bestwig-Wasserfall. Participants can choose from a total of 12 different race distances on the park grounds and the adjacent forests. The event is particularly family-friendly and offers beautiful views as well as the opportunity to enjoy the attractions of the amusement park afterward. The event is organized in cooperation with TuS Valmetal and is ideal for active children, teenagers, and families.
course_highlights: Run on narrow paths in the amusement park and adjacent forests
Beautiful views along the routes
12 different race distances for all age groups and skill levels
additional: Companions receive a discounted admission price of €24.90 per person. Toilets and showers are available on site. The event is especially family-friendly and offers access to the attractions of FORT FUN Adventure Land amusement park in addition to the run. Entry fee includes admission to the amusement park, 12 race distances, and park attractions.

name: GVG Horremer Abendlauf
description: The GVG Horremer Evening Run is a sporting running event organized by SCB Horrem and Aktion Horrem, conducted according to the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLV). The event offers races for various age groups and performance levels, including school runs and a fun run. The course features, among other things, a 5 km loop that is run twice during the 10 km race. The event emphasizes fairness and fun for all participants, from beginners to experienced athletes.
course_highlights: 5 km loop that is run twice during the 10 km race
School run with a 1.5 km distance
Event conducted according to DLV guidelines with scoring and award ceremony
additional: Race bibs can be picked up on the day of the event from 2 PM at Friedrich-Ebert-Platz (Horremer Market Square). Changing and shower facilities are available at Horremer Halle. Free massages for runners provided by the School of Physiotherapy Kerpen-Horrem. Online pre-registration is free and non-competitive for children’s runs. Timing is done using disposable transponders. Preferred race number can be requested during pre-registration for an additional 5 €. Registration opens on 09.02.2026. Timing with disposable transponder. Weather in June is typically around 23°C and sunny.

name: km Staffellauf-100 jahre TSV Brokstedt
description: The 100 km relay race for the 100th anniversary of TSV Brokstedt is a special endurance event taking place in Brokstedt. Teams of youths and adults with 7 to 15 members, including at least 2 women, run in pairs over 50 laps to cover 100 km. For children up to 13 years old, there is a shortened version with 25 laps and 50 km. The event is held at the sports field in Brokstedt and offers a sporting challenge for teams who enjoy running together.
course_highlights: 50 laps of 2 km each for the 100 km relay race
Pairs running in teams
Separate children's relay with 25 laps (50 km)
additional: A maximum of 100 teams can participate. Local teams may register from December 1, 2025. Registration is via email to staffellauf@tsvbrokstedt.de, including the team leader's name and the estimated number of runners. Withdrawal of the entire team is not possible. Start and finish are at the A-platz (Am Sportplatz 2b, 24161 Brokstedt). The race involves 50 laps for pairs, children's teams with 25 laps, a common finish line, a festival with a play area, food trucks, and an anniversary celebration from 8 PM.

name: Never Give Up Hindernislauf
description: The Never Give Up obstacle race 2026 takes place on June 20th in Heinum near Gronau and offers a unique running experience for the whole family. Adults can participate in a challenging main race of approximately 12 km with over 30 diverse obstacles along idyllic forest and field paths on the edge of the Seven Mountains. Additionally, there is a 5 km run with more than 25 obstacles for children and adults, as well as a Kidsrun for children from 4 years old with a roughly 2 km course full of exciting obstacles. Fun, team spirit, and crossing the finish line together are the main focus, accompanied by professional timing, medals for all finishers, and catering at the finish area.
course_highlights: Main race approximately 12 km with over 30 obstacles
Course runs through forest and field paths on the edge of the Seven Mountains
5 km run with more than 25 obstacles for children and adults
additional: Professional timing for adults and children; medals and certificates for all finishers; catering with drinks, snacks, a cake buffet, and street food at the finish area; obstacles can be overcome alone or in teams; large part of the obstacles are on or around the sports field for good spectator experience. Obstacle race through forest and fields, registration via RunTiming, family and kids runs, volunteers wanted

Distances from 400 m for children to half marathon (21.0975 km)
Competition at the Willi-Wicke sports field as start and finish area

Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the start/finish area. The children’s run is free, and accompaniment without scoring is allowed. The 5 km course is counted as a district championship. Late registrations are possible up to 1 hour before the start for an additional fee. Each participant receives a medal and a certificate, walkers and hikers receive a participation certificate. name: Referees Run

The Gelsenkirchen Referees Association traditionally forms one of the largest groups in this race. The event promotes camaraderie among referees and offers a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, and is supervised by Stefan Tendyck.

Traditionally large participation of the Gelsenkirchen Referees Association

Traditional race with a family-friendly atmosphere and regional connection

Course routes, online registration, various race distances, regional sports offerings.

name: Saucony Berlin 10K

description: The Saucony BLN 10K is a spectacular new race taking place on June 20, 2026, at the historic Tempelhofer Feld in Berlin. The event combines fast, urban running with a unique atmosphere at one of the city's most historic locations. Start and finish are located in the listed Hangar 6, accompanied by a Cool Down Zone with DJs, drinks, and street food. The course consists of two fast laps of 5 kilometers each, passing historic aircraft and through the hangar, offering an unforgettable running experience with urban lifestyle and music.
course_highlights: Two fast 5-kilometer laps across Tempelhofer Feld
Start and finish in the listed Hangar 6
Course passes historic aircraft and runs through the hangar
additional: The starter package includes an event shirt, timing with a transponder on the shoe, refreshment points, toilets along the route, post-race catering, individual rankings, finisher medal, insurance, online certificate, paid race video, access to the sunset party on the apron. Entry begins at 4 PM, sunset party until 10 PM, event ends at 11 PM. Guests need a valid guest ticket, which runners can receive free of charge until May 31, 2026. Bags up to A4 size are allowed; no luggage storage on site. The course runs across Tempelhofer Feld, including start/finish in Hangar 6, with a Cool Down Zone, music, street food, neon-design medal, limited event shirt, urban festival atmosphere.

name: Sommerlauf Waren(Müritz) (LC/NLC)
description: The 4th Summer Run Waren (Müritz) is a running event organized by the SV Waren 09 e.V. Laufteam. The race takes place at the Müritz Stadium in Waren (Müritz) and is aimed at children, teenagers, active runners, and masters. The event offers a sporting opportunity for runners of all ages in a beautiful setting. Registration is available through the platform tollense-timing.de.
course_highlights: Various race distances for all age groups
Event held at Müritz Stadium with a stadium-near course
Part of the Laufcup MV, ideal for competitive and recreational athletes
additional: Stadium-remote race, including children and youth competitions, registration via the organizer's website, popular summer event in the region

name: 10K Hamburg - Volkspark
description: The 10K Hamburg Volkspark is an exciting 10-kilometer running format that takes place on continuously closed and secured loop courses in Hamburg. The route runs on paved and asphalted paths and offers runners of all performance levels an attractive running experience. The event is part of the 10K Hamburg series, which is held at various attractive spots in the Elbe metropolis. Participation is exclusively online, and the event is already sold out.
course_highlights: Continuously closed and secured loop courses
Route on paved and asphalted paths
Attractive running course in Volkspark Hamburg
additional: Clothing depot for personal belongings/change of clothes available on the event day. It is recommended to travel by public transport, e.g., S-Bahn station Stellingen about a 20-minute walk to the event site on Max Schmeling Straße. Registration is exclusively online. The cup ranking includes all 10K Hamburg events with point allocation for the 30 fastest men and women. The run is publicly accessible, with recommendations for using public transportation. The event offers a fixed distance of 10 kilometers and medals for all finishers.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 1
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 kilometers into seven pleasant evening stages, each ranging from 5 to 7 kilometers. The first stage starts on Sunday, June 21, 2026, in Förste and passes through the beautiful Sösetal valley with views of the Lichtenstein and the famous Lichtenstein Cave. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers and also offers a Kids' stage over 750 meters in the Schützenpark. The stages take place daily until June 27, 2026, and are organized by regional clubs.
course_highlights: Round courses of 5 to 7 kilometers per stage
Route with views of the Lichtenstein and Gipskarst impressions
Passage by the world-famous Lichtenstein Cave
additional: The first stage starts on Sunday at 10:45 AM at the sports field in Förste. The award ceremony takes place on Saturday, June 27, 2026, at 6:00 PM, including a raffle of material prizes. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers; membership in a club is not required. Minors need written parental consent. After the first stage, there will be a refreshment with pasta specialties from MTV Förste. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, supports local sponsors, and features varied routes that promote both nature and local knowledge.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 2
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. It takes place annually and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad. Participants can run all seven stages or individual stages, each approximately 10 kilometers long. The event places great emphasis on a successful running experience and the protection of the islands from overload.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian Islands
Approximately 10 km running distance per stage
Run over promenades, dune landscapes, and the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Wattenmeer
additional: Race bibs are issued about 1 hour after the arrival of the special ferry until 30 minutes before the start. Race bibs with integrated chip for timing are provided. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available on the islands. Sports bag storage is offered. There are info events on June 19th before the race. The award ceremony takes place at 3:00 PM on Borkum. Stages on seven North Sea islands, approximately 10 km running distance per stage, registration is already fully booked, no waiting list, limited capacities due to ferry and infrastructure.

name: Barsinghäuser Fuchsbau Spendenlauf
description: The Barsinghäuser Fuchsbau Charity Run is a running event in support of the organization "FUCHSBAU" - grief counseling for children and adolescents e.V. Since 2010, the organization has been supporting young people confronted with the death of close relatives. The charity run was established in 2024 to finance the important work of Fuchsbau, as the organization has been fully dependent on donations since 2023. The event promotes community and social engagement in Barsinghausen and will take place again in 2026.
course_highlights: Running for a good cause in Barsinghausen
Community experience with supporting program and entertainment
Event location: REWE Sportpark Barsinghausen
additional: The charity run is supported by prominent figures, including artistic moments and entertainment such as Hoppeburg rental. The Stadtwerke Barsinghausen ensure the supply of drinking water. Jan Haller is the patron of the 2026 event. There is a dm running challenge and a supporting program. The event takes place at the REWE Sportpark. Run within 4 hours, with various activities and on-site catering, race on sports facilities, sponsors for laps, family festival.

description: The Bestensee Lake Run is a traditional race that has been held annually in Bestensee since 2002. It offers three different distances of 2 km, 7.5 km, and 16 km, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start takes place at the Landkostarena, surrounded by the idyllic lakes and forest landscape of the region. The event is open to all age groups, with children and adolescents up to 13 years participating for free.
course_highlights: Three distances: 2 km, 7.5 km, and 16 km
Start and finish at the Landkostarena in Bestensee
Run through the scenic lakes and forest region
additional: Children and adolescents up to 13 years participate for free. Late registrations are possible on race day until 08:45 AM, with a late registration fee of 2 euros. The start times are approximately 09:00 AM for 2 km, 09:30 AM for 16 km, and 09:40 AM for 7.5 km. The starting point is the Landkostarena, Goethestraße 17, 15741 Bestensee. Runners can register online; start and finish at the Landkostarena; courses in Bestensee; registration until June 20, 2024.

name: Buchholzer Stadtlauf
location: Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Buchholz City Run is a traditional race with cult character in the Nordheide region, taking place on June 21, 2026. The course runs right through the city center of Buchholz and is accompanied by numerous spectators, creating a special atmosphere and motivation. Various distances offer suitable challenges for all age and performance groups, from children's runs to the popular relay race in teams. Additionally, there is running training with certified coaches, and all participants receive special medals and certificates.
course_highlights: Course runs right through the city center of Buchholz
Numerous spectators along the route provide motivation
Two NLV-measured best-list capable courses (10 km and half marathon)
additional: Race bib distribution on June 20, 2026 from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM and on June 21, 2026 from 7:00 AM at the town hall. Late registrations are only possible in cash on June 20 and 21. Showers are available at the Waldschule. Helmet requirement for inline skaters, full protective gear recommended. Free finisher shirt for children and adolescents up to 18 years, adults pay €5 per shirt. Beverage stations every 5 km with tea and water more frequently. Various distances, running training, children's runs, course measurement, prizes for winners, medals, certificates, free finisher shirt for youth, beverages every 5 km, team competition.

name: Dahlenburger Moorlauf
description: The Dahlenburger Moorlauf is a popular community run with manual timing, attracting around 200 participants annually. The event offers races for children, walking, and two main races over 4600 meters and 8800 meters. The course is flat and mostly asphalted, with children's races taking place on the tartan track. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and a picturesque setting in the Dahlenburger Moor.
course_highlights: Flat, mostly asphalted course
Children's races on the tartan track
Run through the scenic Dahlenburger Moor
additional: Race bibs are available from 08:30 at the DSK sports facility/Dornweg in Dahlenburg. Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for a fee of 3.00 €. Manual timing. Showers are available at the swimming pool (admission required) or at the club house. Refreshments with water stations along the course as well as coffee, cake, and soft drinks at the sports field. Parking is available in front of the swimming pool and the school. Courses, registrations, community spirit, various race types.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Norderney (2. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. It takes place from June 20 to June 27, 2026, and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad. The individual stages lead over varied routes with maritime flair, dune landscapes, and the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Wattenmeer. The event offers a unique running experience with start and finish on the islands, including comprehensive infrastructure such as race number distribution, sports bag storage, and award ceremonies on site.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian islands with approximately 10 km per stage
Running routes through dune landscapes, beaches, and the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Wattenmeer
Start and finish on the islands with maritime flair and healthy North Sea air
additional: Race numbers are issued on-site on each island, e.g., at the tourist information on Norderney from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Sports bag storage is available on the islands, e.g., at the Conversationshaus on Norderney from 11:30 AM to 2:30 PM. Showers, changing rooms, and toilets are available on the islands. The award ceremony takes place daily at 3:00 PM on the Kurplatz or similar locations. The race number includes an integrated chip for timing and is valid for all stages. There is no waiting list or backup list, and race numbers cannot be transferred. The stage race on seven islands has limited participant capacity due to infrastructure and ferry capacities; registration is full, and there is no waiting list.

name: Globus-Theißen-Lauf
description: The Globus-Theißen Run is a community running event in Theißen, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place on June 21, 2026, for the sixth time. The race offers routes for all age groups, from toddlers over 1.5 km, 3 km, 7 km to 14 km. The event is held at the miners' stadium and is part of the Rangliste-Burgenland for adults as well as the Wiesen-Grundcup for children and adolescents. Refreshments include a cake buffet, coffee, and hearty foods, and there is children's entertainment during the award ceremony. The event is a community project by Globus-Theißen, local clubs, and residents.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 m (toddlers) to 14 km
Start and finish at the miners' stadium in Theißen
Routes available as GPS tracks and PDF
additional: Refreshments with homemade cake and coffee as well as hearty foods; proceeds support youth activities of the clubs; children's entertainment during the award ceremony; start and finish at the miners' stadium; ample parking nearby; certificates for children upon crossing the finish line; event is part of the Rangliste-Burgenland and the Wiesen-Grundcup. Routes for children, adolescents, women, men, and seniors; virtual routes possible; community event with regional significance

name: Lamspringer Klosterlauf
description: The Lamspringer Monastery Run is an annual running and hiking event with start and finish at the Lamspringer Waldstadion. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including children's runs, and is part of the South Lower Saxony Cup. Runners, walkers, and hiking enthusiasts are warmly invited to experience the diverse routes through nature around Lamspringe. The event combines athletic ambition with fun and community in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Lamspringer Waldstadion
Multiple running and hiking trails with different distances
Includes children's runs and routes from 400 m to 23 km
additional: Registration on site possible until 1 hour before the start. Distances: 400 m, 1 km, 2 km, 5 km, 15 km, 23 km. The event is part of the South Lower Saxony Cup. Start and finish location is the Lamspringer Waldstadion; various distances (1 km, 5 km, 8 km, 13 km, 22.9 km); changing and shower facilities; on-site catering; part of the South Lower Saxony Cup.

name: Reinhardswaldwalking
location: VfL Veckerhagen, Reinhardshagen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: VfL Veckerhagen 1897 e.V. cordially invites you to the 15th Reinhardswald Walking Day on June 21, 2026. Distances of 3 km, 6 km, and 11 km are offered, passing through farmland, forest edges, and the Reinhardswald. The start and finish are at the central sports facility of VfL Veckerhagen. Along the way, there are refreshment stations with drinks, and at the finish, beverages, coffee, cake, and sausages are available. The three largest participating groups will receive cash prizes.
course_highlights: Routes through farmland, forest edges, and Reinhardswald
Start and finish at the central sports facility of VfL Veckerhagen
Refreshment stations with drinks along the route
additional: The three largest participating groups will be rewarded with cash prizes. To facilitate planning, a non-binding notification of the approximate number of participants is requested by June 13, 2026. It is recommended to bring the completed registration form to speed up on-site registration. Participants can choose between 3 km, 6 km, 8 km, and 11 km; the event promotes community and nature experience; catering and prizes for groups with the most participants.

description: The 16th Sababurg Animal Park Run will take place on June 21, 2026, in the picturesque Sababurg Animal Park and the adjacent Reinhardswald. Runners will be accompanied by enthusiastic spectators and will experience a unique natural setting on carefully selected routes. The race is a charity run in support of the planned Amphibian World, which is to be established as a new nature learning site in the animal park. The Animal Park Run is also part of the Reinhardswald Run and Walking Cup and offers routes for various age groups and performance levels.
course_highlights: Running routes in Sababurg Animal Park and the adjacent Reinhardswald
Beautiful views of the animal park, the animals, and Sababurg
Routes over paved park paths, suitable for beginners and professionals
additional: Race bibs with transponders will be issued on race day and must be worn visibly at the front. Timing is via transponder. Refreshment points with mineral water and bananas are available approximately every 3-4 km. Changing, shower, and toilet facilities are available. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Children may be accompanied by an adult but not carried. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed on the race routes. The race is part of the Reinhardswald Run and Walking Cup series. Registration is open from May 1 to June 19, 2026. No registration on race day.

name: Sachsenlauf Coswig
price_range: 2 € erste Stunde, danach 1,50 € (Parkgebühren im Parkhaus an der Moritzburger Straße)
description: The Saxony Run Coswig is a traditional sporting event that has been held annually in June since 1980. The races lead on forest, woodland, and field paths through the Friedewald to the Moritzburger Hügelland, with a special highlight: passing through the Moritzburger Stud Farm to the castle pond and horse hill on the 21.1 km course. In addition to running routes, there are also walking and hiking options suitable for different fitness levels and ambitions. The event is part of the Meißner Sparkassencup and the Niederlausitzcup and also offers separate races with surprises at the finish for children and bambinis.
course_highlights: Running routes on forest, woodland, and field paths in Friedewald and Moritzburger Hügelland
Passing through the Moritzburger Stud Farm with castle pond and horse hill (21.1 km course)
Hiking routes on the Karras circular trails with biotopes such as Moselwiese and Seerosenteich
additional: Start and finish are located on Friedewaldstraße at the corner of Sachsenlaufweg. The award ceremonies take place in the schoolyard. Changing rooms and sanitary facilities are available in the nearby Spitzgrund sports hall. The cut-off time for all routes is 14:00. Parking is available for a fee in the Moritzburger Straße parking garage. Public transportation (VVO bus lines 400, 401, 405) is recommended for arrival. There are dedicated races for children and bambinis (500 m and 800 m) with small surprises at the finish. The bib numbers include a disposable transponder for timing. Late registrations are possible on race day until 10:00, payment only in cash. Route adjustments due to state championships, parking in the parking garage, travel by bus and train are recommended. Catering and award ceremonies are held in the finish area, with children’s and hiking routes also available.

name: Schlossinsellauf Lübben
description: The Schlossinsellauf Lübben is a traditional race event on the idyllic castle island in the town of Lübben in the Spreewald. It offers courses for children, teenagers, and adults, including Bambini runs, children's runs, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, as well as a Run & Bike half marathon. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and a varied course layout that takes place both on the castle island and in the surrounding Spreewald area. The race is part of the Spreewaldcup and attracts numerous runners each year.
course_highlights: Courses on the idyllic castle island in Lübben
Varied distances from 550 m Bambini run to half marathon and Run & Bike
Part of the Spreewaldcup with a diverse course layout
additional: Total participant limit of 1000 starters. Registration is binding and non-cancellable. Entry fees will be collected via direct debit. There is group and club registration. Age categories are defined for children and youth runs. The event is part of the Spreewaldcup. Facilities include changing rooms, lockers, showers, medical services, catering, and entertainment on site. Various race distances (Bambini, children, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, Run & Bike), registration opens from 01.02.2026, participant limit 1000.

name: Stunden-Lauf Herne
location: Sportpark Eickel, Herne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
