description: The Barumer Stick and Stone Run is a challenging obstacle race taking place on August 22, 2026, at the Barumer Waldstadion and the surrounding wooded, hilly landscape of the Lüneburger Heide. The course runs over sandy, muddy, and partly overgrown paths with water obstacles such as ditches and a village pond. The event offers runners a varied challenge in a natural environment and is suitable for individual participants as well as groups. Participants receive a medal and refreshments at the finish area.
course_highlights: Wooded and hilly landscape on the edge of the Lüneburger Heide
Sandy, muddy, and overgrown paths with water obstacles
Course with 4 km loops, which can be run 1 to 3 times depending on the distance
additional: Individual start times between 2 PM and 4 PM, communicated to participants via email by August 21, 2026. Start and finish are at the Barumer Waldstadion. There is a group discount offer for groups of 10 or more runners, where every 5th runner runs for free. Race documents will be issued 30 minutes before the start at the race office. There is a washing station on site and drinks and snacks in the finish area for refreshment. The race takes place at the Barumer Waldstadion and is suitable for all performance levels. There are also training plans and a family-friendly atmosphere that emphasizes fun in obstacle racing.

name: Exter FlexRun! 2026
location: Sparkassen Sportpark Exter, Vlotho, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Exter FlexRun on August 22, 2026, at Sparkassen Sportpark Exter offers a flexible running concept for all performance levels. Participants can choose their distance freely and run up to four laps of 10.5 km each, which adds up to the full marathon distance. Additionally, there are relay races, walking and Nordic walking routes, as well as a children's run. The event takes place in a scenic environment and provides a great atmosphere with catering and entertainment on site.
course_highlights: Loop courses on paved paths and mostly asphalted roads in and around Vlotho Exter
Refreshment stations after 4.0 km, 8.5 km, and at Sportpark Exter
Showers, changing rooms, and extensive catering facilities at Sportpark Exter
additional: Start and finish of all competitions are at Sportpark Exter. Flexible distance choice with up to 4 laps (each 10.5 km). Relay 4 x 10.5 km for teams. Walking/Nordic Walking 10.5 km and 21 km. Children's run 1.6 km from age 6. Team and corporate awards with recognition. Routes are signposted and secured with checkpoints. Registration is via Race Result; the event offers showers, changing rooms, catering, and is suitable for families.

name: Heideköniginnenpokal
description: The Heide Queen's Cup (HeiPo) in Amelinghausen is a traditional community run that will take place for the 31st time in 2026 as part of the Heideblütenfest week. The challenging courses lead through scenic passages, including along Lake Lopau. The race attracts many participants and is a staple of regional running events.
course_highlights: Scenic passages
Course along Lake Lopau
Part of the Heideblütenfest week in Amelinghausen
additional: The Amelinghausen Running Group meets regularly on Mondays and Wednesdays to run together. There is also a beginner's course that gradually introduces newcomers to running. The event is part of a lively running community with participation in many community and marathon runs across Germany. The race takes place in August, typically with summer weather around 25°C, with possible rain. There are also children's runs and other community races during the festival week.

name: Jahn-Gedenklauf
description: The Jahn Memorial Run in Lanz is a traditional race organized by SV Jahn Lanz e.V. The event takes place at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Stadium and offers various distances, which are also counted towards the Prignitz Cup. The start time is at 10 a.m., and the race is open to runners of all ages and performance levels. The event is supported by the Kreissportbund Prignitz e.V. and is a fixed date in the regional sports calendar.
course_highlights: Short distance: 6.6 km
Long distance: 12.5 km
Outside the Prignitz Cup: 3 km
additional: Tracks are not accessible with spikes, registration possible on-site, start at the stadium

name: Jan Schüpp Bürgerlauf Wittmund
location: Stadion an der Breslauer Straße, Wittmund, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Jan Schüpp Wittmunder Bürgerlauf is a running event organized by MTV Wittmund, starting at the stadium on Breslauer Straße in Wittmund. The course leads through the city center, past the marketplace and castle square, offering a challenging and varied running route. In addition to the main races, there are also children’s and youth races, which are offered free of charge. The event is well organized with support from police, fire brigade, and the German Red Cross (DRK), and is very popular among runners and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the stadium on Breslauer Straße
Course runs through the city center past the marketplace and castle square
Challenging route with varied course layout
additional: Parking is available at the stadium and on the Schützenplatz on Auricher Straße. The event is medically supported by police, fire brigade, and DRK. There are children’s and youth races free of charge, as well as main races with an entry fee. The event is accompanied by a moderator and supported by local sports clubs. The run includes distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 1200 meters, with a supporting program, on-site registration, and parking options at the stadium and Schützenplatz. The event is very popular among participants and offers a festive atmosphere.

name: middenmang-Loop 2. Emder Vielfaltslauf
description: The middenmang run is an inclusive diversity run in Emden, taking place for the third time on August 22, 2026. The race is open to all age groups and people with and without disabilities to experience the joy of running together. Various competitions and courses, from the Kinner-Loop for children to the 10-km middenmang-Loop for experienced runners, offer something for everyone. The run is part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series and promotes community, activity, and inclusion.
course_highlights: Diverse courses for children, adolescents, and adults with and without disabilities
Inclusion run focused on running together and overcoming barriers
Part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series with 5 km and 10 km courses
additional: The middenmang run includes various competitions and courses for all ages and abilities. The event emphasizes inclusion and community. The 5 km and 10 km runs are part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series. Registration is available online via the website. Contact person is Inga Weerts. Inclusion run with different courses for all age groups and abilities, part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series.

name: Münsterland-Sternlauf - Benefizlauf
location: Universitätsklinikum Münster, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Münsterland Star Run is a charity run in support of the Children's Cancer Aid Münster e.V. at the University Hospital Münster. Five routes lead in a star shape from different towns in the Münsterland region to the common goal at Leonardo-Campus in Münster. The run is designed as a stage race, where participants can set their own pace and run one or more stages. 100% of the proceeds are donated to the association for the promotion of children with cancer Münster e.V. to support the treatment and care of affected children.
course_highlights: Five routes lead in a star shape from different towns in the Münsterland region to Münster
Mostly business, walking, and bike paths as well as traffic-calmed streets
Accompaniment by stage leaders and DRK ambulance vehicles, refreshments at stage points
additional: The run is not a competition; participants determine their own pace. One or more stages can be run, and start and finish are possible at each stage point. Participants are responsible for their own return transport. For the first time, cashless donations are possible. Donation receipts are issued from 200 euros. Accompaniment by stage leaders and DRK ambulance vehicles. Refreshments are offered at stage points in cooperation with the Kolpingsfamilien. The run takes place in Münster and promotes social cohesion through sporting engagement.

name: Gladbecker Sparkassenlauf
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a traditional running event welcoming runners of all ages. The event offers various distances from a mini marathon to a half marathon as well as a team relay. All courses are certified by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for best lists. Participants receive finisher medals and personalized bibs with their names, making the running experience special. There is also a district championship ranking and extensive award ceremonies.
course_highlights: DLV-certified courses: 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Personalized bibs with first names for all participants
Live timing and net times for all races
additional: Finisher medals for all participants, personalized bibs with first names, live timing with net times, changing and shower facilities at the stadium, valuables can be handed in at storage stations, trophies and certificates for winners and age groups, team and club rankings, district championships with certificates and badges, no scoring for Bambinis and walking disciplines. Courses at Gladbeck stadium, online registration, late registration until 1 hour before start, medical support by the German Red Cross, various distances and categories

name: Rotherbaum 10K Hamburg - K Rotherbaum
description: The 10K Rotherbaum is an officially measured 10-kilometer race in Hamburg conducted according to international competition standards. The course is a loop, registered with the German Athletics Association and AIMS, ensuring that finish times are eligible for record lists. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a cup ranking across all 10K Hamburg races with attractive prizes. Registration is exclusively online, and participants are advised to use public transportation for their arrival.

Start and finish near the Hallerstraße subway station
Record-eligible finish times according to IWB and AIMS
additional: Clothing deposit for personal belongings available on event day. The cup ranking includes all 10K Hamburg events with points awarded to the 30 fastest men and women. Official registration confirmation will be sent via email after the registration deadline. Public transportation, especially to the Hallerstraße subway station, is recommended for travel. The race is part of the Hamburg 10K series, which includes various running events in Hamburg. Registration is possible online, and different categories are offered.

name: Der Alstertallauf

description: The Alstertallauf is a family-friendly race on the upper Alster hiking trail, considered the most beautiful running route in Hamburg. It is aimed at both young and old running enthusiasts as well as recreational athletes and offers various distances. The event takes place near the Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium in Hamburg and is known for its friendly atmosphere. In 2022, over 200 runners participated, with race distances ranging from 410 meters to 10 kilometers.
course_highlights: Run on the upper Alster hiking trail, regarded as Hamburg's most beautiful running route
Family-friendly race for all ages and performance levels
Various distances: 410 m, 1,500 m, 4 km, and 10 km

name: Gettorfer Staffelmarathon
description: The Gettorf Relay Marathon is a team marathon taking place on August 23, 2026, at Sportpark Gettorf. The course consists of a roughly 4.2 km loop, which is run ten times. Teams consist of 5 to 10 people who pass the chip-timed baton in the exchange zone. Alternatively, the duo marathon can be completed by two people who share the ten laps freely. Timing is done electronically via transponders and shoe chips, and intermediate times are recorded for each runner.
course_highlights: Loop course of approximately 4.2 km at Sportpark Gettorf
Ten laps per team or duo
Electronic timing with baton transponder and shoe chip
additional: The deadline for both competitions is 4:45 PM. Each person may run a maximum of two laps. Team re-registration (change of team members) is possible online until the registration deadline. Bib numbers are mandatory and provided by the organizer. Online registration is available, with early bird discounts, supported by local partners such as AOK NordWest, Zippel’s Läuferwelt, Förde Sparkasse, EGE.

name: Bielebohlauf
description: The Bielebohlauf Oppach is a running event in the Lusatian Mountains offering various distances from 400 meters to 20 kilometers. The runs take place on forest, meadow, and field paths as well as small roads around Bieleboh. The longer routes are challenging and include steep inclines. There are special Bambini and children's runs for kids. The Oppach stadium provides catering and entertainment, and finishers receive certificates and clips online.
course_highlights: Routes through the landscape of the Lusatian Mountains around Bieleboh
Forest, meadow, and field paths as well as small roads
Challenging longer routes with steep inclines
additional: Registration on site possible with a 5€ late registration fee. Dogs are allowed on the walking route; leash and muzzle are mandatory in the stadium. Trophies and gifts for course winners from 4.9 km and age group winners. Age-appropriate gifts for winners of the 1.5 km route. Results, finisher clips, and certificates are available online immediately after the race. Food, drinks, and entertainment are provided in the stadium. Routes with inclines, dogs allowed on walking route, food and drinks available.

name: Breitunger Pleßlauf

name: ews Volks- und Spendenlauf
description: The 14th ews Volks- und Spendenlauf takes place across Bad Segeberg, passing scenic locations such as Kalkberg and Lake Segeberg. The event annually supports selected projects, with donations in 2026 distributed among three projects. The race is a community event that unites movement and social commitment.
course_highlights: Across Bad Segeberg

Along Lake Segeberg

name: TuS Hiltrup Halbmarathon
location: Stadion am Osttor, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

The course runs in a loop within the stadium, along the canal promenade, and through the Hiltrup residential area, offering a varied and attractive running environment. In addition to the classic half marathon, there is also a relay race, which is particularly interesting for teams. The event is open to runners born in 2008 (individual start) and 2010 (relay) and offers a family-friendly atmosphere within a large sports club.

name: 1. Laufchallenge Mellendorfer TV
description: The Sparkassen Running Pass 2026 for the Hannover region offers 43 running events, making it the largest running series of its kind in Germany. Participants can collect stamps at various events in the Hannover region and thus discover the region through running. Participation is directly at the individual races, which take place at many beautiful locations with different activity options. Additionally, there is a Running Pass app with an event calendar and a digital running journal.

Collect stamps at a total of 43 running events in 2026
Exclusive prizes for avid runners in gold, silver, and bronze

Participation is directly at the individual races, which are spread throughout the year. name: Die Generalprobe
description: The General Rehearsal is an urban road race in Berlin, serving as the perfect preparation for the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON. On August 23, 2026, runners can test their form on a super-flat loop course through the Berlin districts of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf, and Zehlendorf. The event offers a quarter marathon, a half marathon, as well as races for children and youth. The event is characterized by a lively atmosphere and a personal medal for all finishers.

name: B2Run Hamburg

No registration is possible on-site after the deadline. The award ceremony starts from 6:00 PM. Participation fee starts at €2.50 for late registrations. Support for charitable projects is possible.

Start times are assigned based on the reported average pace, and digital course maps are provided before the race.

Start in Hamburg St. Pauli, finish on the beach in St. Peter-Ording
Diverse natural reserves, marshlands, and sea breeze
additional: Participants must be born in 2010 or earlier (Ultra teams from 2008). Team sizes: 10-person teams (each runner covers 3 sections) or Ultra 5-person teams (each runner covers 6 sections). 5-pack teams are combined with a similar 5-pack team. Team categories are assigned automatically upon registration (men, women, diverse, mixed). For 10-person teams, 2 vans are required as team vehicles; for 5-person teams, 1 van. Start times are allocated based on the reported average pace. The event lasts over 24 hours. Digital course maps are provided before the event. The relay race includes various categories, participation is open from 2008 onwards, with detailed information on registration, costs, and procedures, including navigation with course maps.

name: Birklauf
description: The Birklauf of MTV Gelting 08 is a traditional race event taking place on August 29, 2026, starting at 3:45 PM in the Birkhalle Gelting. The event stands for sport, fun, and pure nature, offering runners of various age groups the opportunity to compete. Timing is provided on all routes except the Sprottenlauf over 750 meters, and all finishers receive a medal. The results are age group-specific, and there are awards for the top three runners.
course_highlights: Timing on all routes except Sprottenlauf 750 m
Results by age groups
Medal for all finishers
additional: Registrations are possible until August 22, 2026. The event is organized by MTV Gelting 1908 e.V. All finishers receive a medal, and awards are given to the top three places. The Sprottenlauf over 750 m is without timing. Routes pass through the Geltinger Birk nature reserve and Nordschauwald. Registration until August 22, 2026, race bibs from 3:00 PM, catering with fruit and drinks.

name: Edersee-Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1.2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Edersee Run is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Running Cup and will take place on August 29, 2026, in Vöhl-Herzhausen at Lake Eder. The race is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, an association that promotes sports and community for all age groups. The event is very popular and offers runners an attractive opportunity to engage in sports and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Eder. Pre-registration will start soon, and the club sincerely thanks its supporters and sponsors.
course_highlights: Various race distances for all age groups
Flat, fast courses at Lake Eder
Family and children runs included
additional: The race is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Running Cup. The event is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, which also offers other sports programs and training groups. The race bibs are supported by sponsors. Pre-registration for 2026 will start soon. Multiple race distances, family-friendly, event within the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup, start and finish at the Grillhütte Herzhausen.

name: Elstertal-Lauf
description: The Elstertal Run of the 1st SV Gera is a traditional race event with various course options for runners of all ages. On August 29, 2026, individual competitions over 10 km and 15 km as well as relay races for companies and students will take place. Additionally, there are children's runs and a challenging stair climb with approximately 1300 steps. The event is part of the Thuringian and Gera Running Cup series and offers a varied course through the region.
course_highlights: 15 km individual course for men, women, and youth
Company and student relays over 5 x 3 km with variable number of runners
2500 m stair climb with about 1300 steps
additional: Children's runs as part of the Osterland Cross (600 m, 800 m, 1000 m / 3 km). The relay competitions allow 2 to 5 runners per team; with 4 runners, one runs 6 km. The individual courses are part of the Thuringian and Gera Running Cup series. Multiple race types including stair climb; training plans and detailed information available.

name: Karlis Härtetest
description: The Karlis Härtetest is a traditional race organized by the Pretzsch Running Team. The race takes place annually in autumn near Leipzig and offers a challenging cross-country course that tests runners of all ages. The club SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V. has a long history in running and promotes community and sporting ambition through this event. The event is known for its special atmosphere and the opportunity to prove oneself on a varied course.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country course at the Kanuzentrum near Leipzig
Various challenges for runners of all ages
Traditional event with strong club affiliation
additional: The organizer is the club SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V., which also organizes other running events and challenges. There are no explicit details about start times, prize categories, or registration procedures on the searched pages. The race will take place on August 29, 2026, and is known for its demanding course and friendly atmosphere. It is suitable for both hobby runners and ambitious competitors.

name: Lauf rund um Tiefwarensee
description: The 20th race around Lake Tiefwarensee in Waren (Müritz) is a traditional running event taking place on August 29, 2026. Organized by Müritzer LSV, the course runs around the picturesque Lake Tiefwarensee and offers runners an attractive and varied running environment. The event is open to runners of all performance levels and is a regular feature of the regional race calendar.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Tiefwarensee
Start and finish at the sports field at Lake Tiefwarensee, Güstrower Straße
Scenic route in Waren (Müritz)
additional: Registration address: Peter Hoffmann, Am Pappelgrund 10; Event number: 26V08000010060000; Category: remote stadium event (6.5.1) Registration deadline is August 27, 2026. The event is part of a regional running and nature experience program that highlights the beauty of Lake Tiefwarensee and the surrounding nature.

name: Mindener Volkslauf
description: The Minden People's Run is the largest running event organized by SV 1860 Minden, with over 1,000 participants annually. On August 29, 2026, the 50th anniversary race will take place, featuring many new highlights along the course and in the stadium. Parallel to the anniversary, the club will celebrate the 10th anniversary of the merged SV Minden with numerous activities. The event offers a great atmosphere and an after-run party following the corporate run, inviting everyone to join in the celebration.
course_highlights: Course with new highlights and varied sections
Start and finish in the stadium with special atmosphere
After-Run Party after the corporate run
additional: The 50th Minden People's Run offers an after-run party following the corporate run. Registration is expected to open in May 2026. In 2025, 1,467 active participants reached the finish line. The event also celebrates the 10th anniversary of the merged SV Minden with many individual activities until the end of the year. The event takes place in August, with registration starting in May 2026. It is the largest event of the club with a special focus on community and anniversary celebrations.

name: Monte Sophia XXII und 65. HAG-Lauf
description: The Monte Sophia Mountain Run and the Heinrich-Antons Memorial Run (HAGL) are traditional scenic races in the Rhenish lignite mining area near Niederzier. The Monte Sophia Run covers 25 km with 380 meters of elevation gain and takes place over the Sophienhöhe, a former spoil heap with varied paths, distinctive natural and cultural points, and beautiful views. The HAGL offers a shorter alternative of 10 km, while the Broisterd Round with 5.3 km is also suitable for beginners. The event also includes children's runs and a 10 km walking route, making it ideal for landscape runners and marathon preparers.
course_highlights: 25 km Strecke mit 380 Höhenmetern über die Sophienhöhe
Markante Punkte wie Steinkompass, keltischer Baumkreis, Goldene Aue und Römerturm
Wechselnde Steigungen von sanft bis steil auf festen Kieswegen und Asphalt
additional: Umkleiden und Duschen sind in der Turnhalle nutzbar. Verpflegungsstellen mit Wasser, Tee, Obst und Cola sind auf der Strecke und im Ziel vorhanden. Kinder erhalten Medaillen und Urkunden, die ersten drei jeder Altersklasse erhalten Sachpreise. Doppelstarter erhalten für jeden Lauf eine separate Startnummer. Radbegleitung, Babyjogger, Hunde und Kopfhörer sind verboten. Landschaftslauf mit verschiedenen Strecken, inklusive Kinderläufe und Walking, im Rheinischen Braunkohlerevier, anspruchsvoll mit Steigungen

name: Mühlhäuser Altstadtlauf
organizer: Stadtverwaltung Mühlhausen, Kreissportbund Mühlhausen, SV 1899 Mühlhausen e. V.
price_range: Schülerläufe: 1,00 Euro; Hauptläufe 5 km / 10 km: 6,00 Euro (Jugend), 12,00 Euro (Erwachsene)
description: The Mühlhäuser Old Town Run is a traditional race through the historic old town of Mühlhausen, taking place annually since 1997. It offers a sporting contrast to the Mühlhäuser fair with three race distances of 1.7 km, 5 km, and 10 km, bringing together runners from the region. The start and finish points are traditionally at the Untermarkt in Mühlhausen. The event is organized in cooperation with the athletics club SV 1899 Mühlhausen e.V. and attracts approximately 800 to 1100 participants each year.
course_highlights: Three courses through the historic old town (1.7 km, 5 km, 10 km)
Start and finish at the Untermarkt in Mühlhausen
Established since 1997 with regional running community
additional: The race is traditionally held as part of the Mühlhäuser fair and is designed as a sporting contrast to the fair. Organization is in cooperation with the local athletics club SV 1899 Mühlhausen e.V. No prices or start times are published on the website. The start and finish are at the Untermarkt in Mühlhausen. Three distances: youth runs from 9:00 a.m., 1.7 km; main runs of 5 km and 10 km; online registration until August 22, 2025; accompanying program at the Untermarkt.

name: Panorama - Run - Bad Laasphe
location: Wabachstadion, Bad Laasphe, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Panorama Run in Bad Laasphe is a varied race as part of the SummerCityGames, organized by TV Laasphe. The course starts from the Wabachstadion and leads over paved paths and forest trails to the highest point of the route, featuring a challenging ascent and a predominantly downhill second half that offers a beautiful view. There is a 6 km youth/open race as well as a 12 km main race, which runs the course twice and thus presents a real challenge. The event also offers changing rooms and shower facilities directly at the sports field.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wabachstadion Bad Laasphe
Paved paths and forest trails with a steep ascent to the highest point
Predominantly downhill second half of the course with a beautiful view
additional: Late registrations are possible 60 minutes before the competition begins with a 3 € late registration fee. Bibs are issued at the club house on the sports field. Changing rooms and shower facilities are available at the sports field. Course description: 6 km and 12 km run, uphill and downhill, paved paths and forest trails; registration until 28.08.2025; late registration 60 minutes before start for a fee; start/finish at the sports field Bad Laasphe; changing rooms/shower available

name: Salzbergener Raffinerielauf
description: The Salzbergen Refinery Run is a popular road race in the beautiful community of Salzbergen, taking place on August 29, 2026. Various distances are offered for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a school mile, a 5 km fun run, and a 10 km main race. The event is part of the EL-CUP and features exciting competitions as well as a lively supporting program for runners and spectators. The races start at the Salzbergen Secondary School and promote both individual and team competitions.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Salzbergen Secondary School
Distances: 600m Bambini run, 1700m school mile, 5km and 10km fun runs
Team competition in the main races
additional: Start times: first race at 14:30; 14:45 school mile; 15:15 5km fun run; 16:15 10km main race; 16:20 5km walking/nordic walking (without timing). Team competition for timed races, teams consist of 3 participants. Registration on-site until 45 minutes before each race, late registration fee 1.00 Euro. Race documents can be picked up from approximately 13:15 at the on-site race office. Races with team scoring, online registration, supporting program, trophies, and medals.

name: 4. S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz"
description: The 4th S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz" is a nature-oriented community run in Eichsfeld that appeals to runners of all ages and fitness levels. The varied courses lead through breathtaking natural landscapes around the Dünkreuz and offer exciting challenges for both experienced runners and beginners. In addition to the sporting competition, the sense of community is at the forefront, supported by an attractive accompanying program at the sports field. The run is part of the Eichsfeldcup and is organized by SG Birkungen 07.
course_highlights: Nature-oriented courses around the Dünkreuz
Diverse competitions for young and old (400 m to 10 km)
Part of the renowned Eichsfeldcup
additional: There are 4 courses with 5 competitions: Bambini-Run (400 m), Youngster-Run (1.5 km), 6-K-Run (6 km run/nordic walking), and 10-K-Run (10 km run). The event promotes community spirit and offers an accompanying program at the sports field. Results from previous years are available at my.raceresult.com. Forest paths, fields, elevation gain, Nordic walking, course signage, medical services, transponder timing, community program.

name: 22. Eilenriederennen Hannover
location: Eilenriede Park, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Eilenriederennen Hannover is an established summer running event that takes place through the green lung of the state capital Lower Saxony. The popular race is offered in three different distances: 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon. The course is officially measured, mostly asphalted, and nearly flat, allowing for fast times. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere with musical entertainment in the beer garden and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass series of the Hanover region.
course_highlights: 100% asphalted course except for a small U-turn on unpaved paths at the 5 km distance
Loop course to the forest station and back to the zoo and Lister Tower
Course is flat and officially measured except for crossing the Messe Schnellweg
additional: Number bib distribution on the day before (29.08.2026) from 15:00 to 17:00 at the Lister Tower beer garden is recommended to avoid delays. Late registrations are possible online until 29.08.2026 14:30 and on-site without surcharge, provided the race is not fully booked. Refreshment points at km 3, 5, 7, and 10 with water, isotonic drinks, and energy gels; at the finish line with watermelons and drinks. Timing is done with a chip integrated into the start number. The event location is the district center Lister Tower, Walderseestr. 100, Hannover. Recommended travel by bicycle or public transport (city train lines 3, 7, 9, stop Lortzingstraße). The course is officially measured, with refreshment points at km 3, 5, 7, 10, and at the finish; registration online or on-site; bib distribution at the Lister Tower beer garden; the event takes place in summer.

name: 23. Windmühlenberglauf
location: Bezirkssportanlage am Windmühlenberg, Fallersleben, Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 23rd Windmühlenberglauf will take place on August 30, 2026, in Fallersleben (Wolfsburg) at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg. The event is organized by VfB Fallersleben and offers runners of various age groups and performance levels the opportunity to participate in a traditional race. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Windmühlenberg and promises a varied running experience. Registration is open until August 25, 2026.
course_highlights: Run at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg
Scenic course in Fallersleben
Traditional race with different age and performance categories

Run through the natural landscape of the Altmark region
Jubilee event with a party on the eve

There is a small party on August 29, 2026, at Arendsee Beach. Event photos will be provided. The organizing team donates €1 per participant to Special Olympics Saxony-Anhalt e.V. Registration has been open since December 1, 2025; the event includes multiple competitions and a party the day before; suitable also for marathon preparation.

name: 45. Königseer Stadtwaldlauf
location: Oberhain bei Königsee, Landkreis Saalfeld-Rudolstadt, Thüringen, Germany
description: The Königseer Stadtwaldlauf is a traditional running event in Oberhain near Königsee, held annually. The event offers runners of various performance levels an attractive course through the city forest with diverse terrain. The family-friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings make the race a special experience for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque city forest of Königsee
Varied terrain with forest paths and nature trails
Family-friendly event with different distances

name: 6-Stunden-Sparkassenlauf
location: Sportzentrum Seevetal, Seevetal-Fleestedt, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 6-Hour Sparkassen Run in Fleestedt takes place on August 30, 2026, on a 1,200-meter loop at the Seevetal Sports Center. The course mainly runs on paved surfaces and partly on grass, and is well visible from the start/finish area, creating excitement for spectators. In addition to the individual competition, there are team and relay events, with the marathon (42.2 km) receiving its own classification. The race is open to runners born from 2008 onwards, and the relay race is also available for youth born from 2014. For younger participants, there is a 5,000-meter run and the opportunity to earn the DLV running badge.
course_highlights: 1,200 m loop at Seevetal Sports Center
Course mainly paved, partly grass
Start/finish area well visible for spectators
additional: Marathon distance requires 35 laps. Team classification sums all kilometers, relay classification involves exchanges. Participation is open from 2008 birth year, relay from 2014. Youth 5,000m run for birth years 2009-2014. Children born between 2015-2020 can earn the DLV running badge. The event starts at 10:00 AM, with a duration of six hours, during which participants aim to complete as many laps as possible. Breaks are allowed, and the event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various race categories and children's activities.

name: Blankeneser Heldenlauf
description: The Blankeneser Heroes Run on August 30, 2026 offers five varied courses with different distances and profiles, appealing to both beginners and experienced runners. The races lead through the picturesque Blankeneser Staircase District, along the Elbe River, and through diverse parks and residential areas. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the unique combination of urban and natural running enjoyment. Participants can expect a finisher medal and a lively award ceremony at the finish line.

Varied profiles from flat to challenging with climbs such as the Polterberg
Finish at the Blankeneser Weekly Market Square with a finisher medal

Official registration deadline is August 19, 2026, with online late registration and increased entry fee available until August 29, 2026. Finisher medals are included in the registration fee. Results and certificates will be provided online. Photos can be purchased after the event through a photography partner. Various course profiles and distances, including medal distribution and award ceremony; registration, late registration, and travel by public transport are possible.

name: Grafschaftslauf
location: Gut Rietberg, Rietberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Grafschaft Run connects the historic towns of Rietberg, Verl, and Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock and offers runners a varied course rich in history and atmosphere. The race starts at Gut Rietberg, passing historic buildings and through the city center, continuing along the Ems River to the Gartenschau grounds. The route leads through atmospheric locations with multiple exchange points for relay runners and ends in the Holter Forest at the Hunting Lodge to Holte, which provides an impressive backdrop for the finish line. The race is characterized by diverse scenic paths, enthusiastic spectators, and a special connection between sport and regional history.
course_highlights: Start at Gut Rietberg with historic castle ambiance
Atmospheric spots in Westerwiehe and Kaunitz with relay exchanges
Finish through the peaceful Holter Forest to the Hunting Lodge to Holte

The course passes through historic town centers, along the Ems River, through the Gartenschau park, and ends at the castle in Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock. There is also a 10 km run and walking options. The event emphasizes a lively atmosphere with multiple spectator points and musical accompaniment. Races include: 28 km individual run, relay race, 10 km run, walking; registration opens on 01.01.2026; motto: Experience history actively.

name: Altra Sunset Wattenmeer
price_range: 1.100,00 Euro bis 1.500,00 Euro für Teams, je nach Anmeldedatum
description: The Altra Sunset Wadden Sea is a unique team relay race taking place on August 29 and 30, 2026. The course covers approximately 250 kilometers through the stunning natural landscape along the Elbe River and the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site Wadden Sea National Park. The race starts in Hamburg at St. Pauli Hafenstraße and finishes in St. Peter-Ording in the Bad district. Teams consist of 5 or 10 runners, each taking on multiple segments, making the race a special community experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 250 kilometers through the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site Wadden Sea National Park
Start in Hamburg, finish in St. Peter-Ording, Bad district
Natural experience along the Elbe with breathtaking landscapes
additional: The start times of the teams will be assigned after registration closes based on the reported average pace. Participants born from 2010 onwards are eligible, for ultra teams from 2008. There are team categories by gender and mixed teams. Registration is managed by a team captain who oversees team members. The race includes 30 stages, night and day runs, navigation with map material, starting in Hamburg and ending in St. Peter-Ording. Participation is open to teams from multiple countries, with variable weather and sporting challenge.

name: Bottroper Ultralauf Festival (BUF)
description: The Bottrop Ultra Running Festival 2026 takes place on August 30 and 31 at Batenbrockpark in Bottrop and offers an unforgettable running experience for ultra runners. In addition to the proven 6- and 24-hour runs, the Hilltop Backyard is also a special highlight. The festival is characterized by a great community, exciting challenges, and a unique festival atmosphere, which is shaped by hourly restarts and parallel competitions.
course_highlights: 6- and 24-hour runs at Batenbrockpark
Hilltop Backyard as a special highlight
Hourly restarts and parallel competitions
additional: The festival features hourly restarts, a parallel competition, and a simultaneous hiking event, creating a special festival atmosphere. Running event with 6h, 24h, relay, and backyard events; at Batenbrockpark; online registration; event in August 2026

name: Burgwald Märchen Marathon
description: The Burgwald Fairy Tale Marathon in Rauschenberg is a diverse running event with courses for ultra marathon, marathon, half marathon, three-quarter marathon, fun runs, and costume runs. The event offers a well-organized race route with refreshments, timing, and medals for all finishers. The bib number distribution takes place the day before, and the races start from 8:00 a.m. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy the race in a fairy-tale environment.
course_highlights: Diverse distances from 5 km to ultra marathon (52 km)
Start and finish near the sports hall and outdoor pool in Rauschenberg
Cut-off time for all races is 4:00 p.m.

All finishers who reach the finish line by 4:00 p.m. will receive a medal. Certificates can be printed online or collected at the finish area. Start and finish are located near the sports hall and outdoor pool in Rauschenberg. The course mostly runs through the forest, partly on paved paths; refreshments every 5±2 km; dogs allowed.

name: CrossFunRun
description: The CrossFunRun on August 30, 2026, in Ahrensburg offers varied courses for all age groups and performance levels. The races take place in Wulfsdorfer Park with start and finish at Heidkoppelhof. The event is family-friendly with special Kids Cross-Run courses and relay competitions. All participants receive medals, certificates, and prizes. The event is organized by WEcycle e.V., which ensures a great atmosphere and exciting cross-country running experiences.

Family-friendly Cross-Run courses and relay competitions
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site from 10:00 AM for an additional fee of 5 euros. The event offers awards in the form of medals, certificates, and prizes. There are relay Cross-Run competitions with 3 or 4 team members. Directions are via Bornkampsweg and Wulfsdorfer Weg in 22926 Ahrensburg. On-site registration is possible, various categories, family-friendly, activities for cyclists and runners, start and finish at Heidkoppelhof Ahrensburg.

name: DO IT FAST
description: DO IT FAST in Dortmund offers runners the opportunity to set their personal best on a fully measured 2.5 km loop course. Depending on the distance, the course will be run 2 or 4 times and is eligible for record listings. In addition to the athletic competition, participants will receive a finisher medal, refreshments, and an award ceremony for the top runners. A photo banner at the finish area invites memorable photos, and the results can be accessed digitally via QR code.
course_highlights: DLV-measured 2.5 km loop course
10 km run: 4 laps, 5 km run: 2 laps
Photo banner in front of the blast furnace as a photo spot
additional: Race office opens at 07:30 AM. Award ceremony for men and women, each for places 1-3, after crossing the finish line on the event area. Finishers receive a medal and refreshments. Races on a measured 2.5 km loop course, registration until 16.08.2026, including shirt options, timing, award ceremony, photos.

name: Felsburglauf
description: The Felsburglauf is a traditional race competition that has been held annually since 2013 on the last Sunday of August at the stadium below the Felsburg in Felsberg. The event offers courses over 400 meters, 1,000 meters, 5,000 meters, and 10,000 meters and attracts runners of all ages from the region. The family-friendly atmosphere and the beautiful setting make the race a popular event in the Schwalm-Eder-Kreis. As a licensed course for the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup, participants can also earn points for the overall standings.
course_highlights: Courses over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m
Start and finish at the stadium below the historic Felsburg
Family-friendly atmosphere with good weather and beautiful scenery
additional: The race is part of the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup. The youngest participants are often born in 2020 or later, and the oldest runner was born in 1937. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht 1863 Felsberg and partner TSV Jahn Gensungen. Courses: 400 m, 1 km, 5 km, 10 km; Terrain: stadium and Felsburg surroundings; registration not explicitly mentioned.

name: Kölner Halbmarathon- Die Generalprobe
location: Sportpark Müngersdorf, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 27th Cologne Half Marathon on August 30, 2026, offers runners the opportunity to choose from four distances: 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 28 km. Course and finish line refreshments with water, bananas, and Maxi Nutrition bars

Changes to registration are only possible at the bib distribution and cost €15. The course, start/finish in Cologne, on-site registration, refreshments, race bibs, parking, showers, and changing facilities are available.

name: Lahnparklauf

description: The Lahnparklauf takes place on August 30, 2026, in the heart of Hesse and is an established running event that appeals to runners of all performance levels. The organizing team of team-naunheim SPORT e.V. looks forward to welcoming many participants and offers training in various sports in addition to the run.

Running event in the heart of Hesse
Suitable for runners of all performance levels

Course map and elevation profile online, registration online, parking at REWE parking lot, no bag storage provided by the organizer, medical services by Malteser Hilfsdienst e.V.

name: Rund um Ennepetal

description: Around Ennepetal is an annual recreational sports event held on the last Sunday of August, combining running, hiking, and walking along the 60 km long Ennepetal circular trail in five stages. The route passes through diverse nature with stunning views of the Bergisches Land, reservoirs, and historic sites. The event is suitable for all performance levels and offers guided groups for runners and walkers as well as independent hikers. The stages are scenic and feature cultural highlights as well as challenging sections. After the race, participants can access their results and certificates online.
course_highlights: 60 km in 5 stages with varied ascents and descents through forests, floodplains, and horse meadows
Beautiful views of the Bergisches Land, reservoirs, and historic half-timbered villages like Beyenburg
Guided groups for runners and walkers, independent hikers with GPX data, refreshment points at the end of stages
additional: Late registration on the day of the event is possible for a fee until 30 minutes before the start. The start and finish point is the sports facility of Rot-Weiß Rüggeberg e.V. Organized bus transfers to the start points of stages 2 to 5 and back are provided. The cut-off time is 8:30 PM. Runners and walkers are accompanied in groups with local guides, and hikers receive GPX data for self-guided tours. Results and certificates are available online. The event includes multiple stages with a challenging route, including bus transfers between start points and refreshment stations at transfer points. Participation is open to all, with various disciplines and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Stundenlauf des TuS Fleestedt
location: Sportzentrum Seevetal, Seevetal, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 6-Hour Sparkassen Run in Fleestedt takes place on August 30, 2026, on a 1,200-meter loop course at the Seevetal Sports Center. The course mainly consists of paved surfaces and partly grass, and is well visible from the start/finish area, creating excitement for spectators. In addition to the individual competition, there are team and relay events, with the marathon distance (42.2 km) receiving its own ranking. The race is open to participants born from 2008 onwards, with special offers for youth and children.
course_highlights: 1,200 m loop course with predominantly paved surfaces and grass sections
Course mostly visible from the start/finish area
Marathon distance with 35 laps and its own ranking
additional: Participation possible from birth year 2008; relay competition also for youth born from 2014; 5,000m run for youth born from 2009 to 2014; DLV running badge for children born from 2015 to 2020 during the event; team scoring combines all kilometers. Event held on a 1,200 m loop course at the Seevetal Sports Center, various competitions, registration possible.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The 40th People's Hike Day of TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. is a traditional hiking event in Tiftlingerode, taking place on August 30, 2026. The event is aimed at hiking enthusiasts and offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy nature and the surroundings. It is a social and athletic activity suitable for all age groups. The event is organized by TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. and is part of the competition calendar of the German Athletics Association.
course_highlights: Hiking on the sports field TSV Immingerode
Participation in the People's Hike Day in Duderstadt
Nature experience in the Eichsfeld region
additional: Hiking event, Location: Sports field TSV Immingerode, Duderstadt, Registration and contact via the club

name: Wandertag
location: Neuhaus im Solling, Holzminden, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Neuhäuser Wandertag is an annual hiking event in the Solling-Vogler region around Neuhaus im Solling. Participants can choose from four different routes ranging from 4.7 to 18 km, passing through diverse landscapes with dense forests, green meadows, and beautiful viewpoints. The start and finish point is the Haus des Gastes in Neuhaus, Lindenstraße 6, where hikers begin between 8 and 10 a.m. Drinks and small snacks are offered at control points for a small fee. In the afternoon, an award ceremony takes place, honoring among others the largest participating groups and the oldest hiking friends.
course_highlights: Diverse landscapes with densely wooded areas and lush green meadows
Great viewpoints with magnificent views over the Weser Uplands
Four marked routes between 4.7 and 18 km
additional: Start and finish are at the Haus des Gastes in Neuhaus, Lindenstraße 6. Participants start between 8 and 10 a.m. Drinks and small snacks are available at control points for a small fee. An award ceremony takes place in the afternoon, honoring the largest groups and the oldest hiking friends. Refreshments include hearty dishes and sweet cake varieties. Musical entertainment and a variety of info and sales booths round out the event. Routes between 5 and 20 km, catering at control points, musical accompaniment, sales booths, and an award ceremony in the afternoon.

name: 23. Lehrter CityLauf
description: The 23rd Lehrter CityLauf will take place on September 4, 2026, and is a traditional running event in the city center of Lehrte. The races include distances of 2, 4, and 10 kilometers, including children's and school runs as well as an inclusion run over 2 kilometers. The corporate team competition over 4 and 10 kilometers is once again sponsored by the KURTULUS GROUP. A lively atmosphere is ensured by musical accompaniment and a varied supporting program involving the LSV departments.
course_highlights: Course runs through Lehrte city center
Races over 2, 4, and 10 kilometers
Inclusion run as part of the 2-kilometer race
additional: There is a corporate team competition over 4 and 10 kilometers, sponsored by the KURTULUS GROUP. Musical accompaniment by Walter Nebel. Participation of LSV departments in the supporting program is possible. Support from volunteers on the course and in organization is welcome. Stand spaces for companies are available. In addition to the races, the event offers a diverse supporting program, including live music, food stalls, and corporate competitions. Participation is open to all, registration is via Raceresult.

name: Höinger Heidelauf
location: Ense-Höingen, Kreis Soest, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Höinger Heidelauf is a traditional race held annually on the first Friday in September in Ense-Höingen. Known as the toughest 10 km race in the Soest district, the event offers courses for various runner types, including 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon. The route primarily runs over paved paths and gravel trails through the Sauerland mountains and is characterized by a challenging topography. Besides the sporting challenge, community and atmosphere are at the forefront, making the race a special experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Toughest 10 km race in the Soest district
Course over paved paths and gravel trails
Run through Sauerland mountain landscape
additional: Children's races start at 16:45, 5 km and half marathon at 17:30, 10 km race at 18:30. Start and finish are at the Karl-Kleine-Stadion. The event offers great catering and a strong community atmosphere. Short-term trail closures and safety concepts must be observed. The event has achieved participant records in the past despite adverse weather conditions. Running event with children's races, main races, challenging course with elevation meters, online registration available.

name: IHK-Ausbildungslauf move-on
location: Rostrup bei Oldenburg, Ammerland, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The training run "Move On!" is organized by the Oldenburg Chamber of Industry and Commerce (IHK) and will take place on September 4, 2026, around Lake Zwischenahner. The route is approximately 12 km long and runs from BBS Ammerland in Rostrup through Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen, Dreibergen back to Rostrup. The target audience includes trainers, trainees, examiners, teachers, and other stakeholders from the field of training and further education in the Oldenburg region. In addition to the run, the event offers a supporting program with bib distribution, team photos, a barbecue evening with music, and an award ceremony. The event takes place in all weather conditions, with parking available at BBS and at Bau-ABC Rostrup.
course_highlights: Round course of approximately 12 km around Lake Zwischenahner
Start and finish at BBS Ammerland in Rostrup
Route through Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen, Dreibergen
additional: Bibs and T-shirts can be picked up on the day of the event from 14:00 to 15:30 at BBS Rostrup. There is a walking group starting at 15:00. The run begins in four groups starting at 16:00 at 4-minute intervals. After the run, a barbecue with music acts will take place from 18:00 at Bau-ABC near the finish line. The award ceremony is scheduled for 18:30. The IHK does not assume liability for accidents or thefts. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Valuables cannot be stored. Parking is available at BBS and Bau-ABC. Race on September 4, 2026, registration from June 1, 2026, in all weather, parking available at BBS and Bau-ABC Rostrup.

name: Sparkassen Pütt-Tage-Lauf 2026
organizer: Sparkasse Münsterland Ost, SG Rote Erde Beckum, Ski-Club Beckum, TV Beckum, Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen
price_range: online registration, exact fee not specified
description: The Sparkassen Pütt-Tage-Run is a road race event held on Fridays in the city center of Beckum and is part of the Pütt-Tage festivities of the city. The program includes short races for children, a youth run, a charity run, as well as the 10 km main race, which also serves as the FLVW 10 km road race championship. The course runs through several laps around the streets near Hühlstraße, with start and finish lines located there as well. The event is organized by several local clubs and the Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen. Timing is done with a RaceResult transponder in the bib number.
course_highlights: City streets around Hühlstraße in Beckum
10 km main race with multiple laps
Charity run approximately 4.2 km over about five laps
additional: The program begins with a 400 m children's race, followed by 1 km kids' runs (ages 6-9), 2 km youth run (ages 10-15), and the 10 km main race (from age 16). Timing is done with a RaceResult transponder in the bib number, results are published online. Multiple race categories including children, youth, charity, and main race; event as part of Pütt-Tage; city course; timing with RaceResult transponder.

name: Straberger 1/3 Marathon
description: The Straberger 1/3 Marathon takes place on September 4, 2026, in Dormagen and offers races over 5 kilometers and 14.065 kilometers. The course runs naturally past the Knechtsteden Monastery and through the forest, ideal for beginners, advanced, and ambitious runners. The event is characterized by samba and festive atmosphere in the town center and is also suitable as a test run for the Cologne Marathon. There are youth races for children with free running shirts and medals at the finish line.
course_highlights: Naturally scenic course past Knechtsteden Monastery
Run through the forest
Festive atmosphere and samba in the town center of Straberg
additional: Children up to U8 receive a free running shirt and a medal at the finish line. Adults can order a breathable running shirt for 18 euros during registration and pick it up on the event day with their bib number. The youth races take place at Linden-Kirch-Platz in the town center with various lap lengths depending on age group. Parking is available nearby at Hubertus-Schützensaal and sports field. Naturally scenic course, youth races, festive atmosphere, start and finish at Linden-Kirch-Platz, online registration, free for children up to U8, running shirt included.

name: Intern. Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Sea Run organized by TSV Poggenhagen from 1946 e.V. will take place on September 5, 2026. The event is a traditional fun run, scored according to the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLO), and recognized for all fun run badges of the DLV. Certificates are available for all placements and can be downloaded online, along with an award ceremony for the top three finishers in each category. Additionally, a special prize will be awarded for the strongest registered group. Participation conditions and liability restrictions are prerequisites for participation.
course_highlights: Scoring according to DLO guidelines
Recognition for all fun run badges of the DLV
Award ceremony on event day with a special prize for the strongest group
additional: Online registrations will be confirmed with a registration confirmation. There is no entitlement to a refund of the organizational fee in case of non-participation. Certificates for all placements will be available for download on the internet. The event is part of the TSV Poggenhagen program and offers, in addition to the running competitions, the opportunity to participate in fun run badges of the DLV. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful course in the lake region.

name: Volkslauf Eisbergen 2026
location: Sportplatz Eisbergen, Waterbusch 40, Porta Westfalica, Germany
organizer: TuS Eisbergen TURN- UND SPIELVEREIN 1919 EISBERGEN e. V.
description: The Eisbergen Volkslauf is a traditional running event in Porta Westfalica offering various distances for children and adults. The course runs around the Eisbergen sports field and provides diverse running options with 5.7 km for the Volkslauf and 17.7 km for the long-distance race. Participants' well-being is also catered for, and the event is part of the Mühlenkreisserie. The course is viewable on Komoot, enabling good preparation.
course_highlights: Loop around the Eisbergen sports field with start and finish at the sports field
Volkslauf course approximately 5.7 km, long-distance approximately 17.7 km (two laps with minimal variations)
Children's runs: Bambinilauf 400 m, Schülerlauf 800 m
additional: Bambinilauf (400m) for children up to 6 years without registration and entry fee. Schülerlauf (800m) for children up to 12 years. Online registrations are only possible until September 4th, after which only on-site late registrations with a late registration fee. The start times have changed: Bambinilauf at 14:00, Schülerlauf at 14:15, Volkslauf & Walking at 15:00. Catering is provided. Courses: 5.7 km Volkslauf & Walking, approximately 17.7 km long-distance; Start location: Sportplatz Eisbergen, Waterbusch 40; Weather in September around 19°C, cloudy.

name: Herbstwaldlauf (Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup) inkl. Hobby-Mountainbike-Rennen
location: Finnentrop-Fretter, Finnentrop, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 62nd Autumn Forest Run (Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup) in Finnentrop-Fretter is a short race event taking place on September 5, 2026. In addition to the run, there is also a hobby mountain bike race. The event offers runners and mountain bikers an attractive opportunity to experience the autumnal landscape of the Sauerland and stay active in sports.
course_highlights: Short race distance of 0.4 km
Includes hobby mountain bike race
Autumnal forest landscape in Sauerland
additional: The event features a varied course layout, including trail running, mountain running, and mountain biking, often with changeable weather in Sauerland.

name: Volkslauf in St.Vit Laufen und Gutes tun
location: St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The charity run "Running and Doing Good" takes place on September 5, 2026, in St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The races lead on flat loop courses through the town of St. Vit with start and finish at the Küsterhaus. The event supports various social projects, including outpatient palliative care for children, the Malteser Heart's Desire ambulance, DKMS, and families in need. In addition to the runs, there is for the first time an inline skating race and a charity tattoo event that promotes the social engagement of participants.
course_highlights: Flat loop courses through the town of St. Vit
Start and finish at the Küsterhaus
Inline skating race over 9.1 km (5 laps) with helmet requirement
additional: Timing is done with a disposable chip on the running shoe. Race documents will be issued on the day of the event from 1:30 PM at the registration tent next to the Küsterhaus. Refreshments with water are available along the course, as well as tea and fruit at the finish area. Changing rooms are available at the local youth center. Inline skating race requires helmet use. Charity tattoo event and DKMS registration on site. Participation is possible through membership, with donations for children's hospices, DKMS, and families in need. The run includes various distances, including a kids' run and inline skating.

name: Werler Kurpark Crosslauf - Hindernislauf für Groß und Klein
location: Werl Kurpark, Werl, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Werler Kurpark Crosslauf is an obstacle race for young and old, taking place in the picturesque Kurpark of Werl. The event offers runs for various age groups and skill levels, from short distances for children to challenging 6.4 km for endurance runners. New in 2026 is the relay cross, which promotes team spirit and fun. The varied course includes numerous exciting obstacles, making the race a special experience.
course_highlights: Varying obstacles such as Climb the Wall, Water Lagoon, and Mountain Climber
Course lengths from 480 meters to 6.4 kilometers
New in 2026: Project S as an additional obstacle
additional: Registration on-site until 60 minutes before the respective start is possible (except for relay). Bib numbers with electronic timing via Racersult. There is an exclusive Kurparkcross shirt, which can only be pre-ordered until June 30, 2026. Spikes, barefoot running, and costumes are not allowed for safety reasons. Accompaniment on the course is only permitted during the U6 Bambini run. Obstacles, courses for children and adults, family-friendly, team spirit, fun.

name: Wiehler AggerEnergie- und Sparkasse Gummersbach Sommerlauf
location: Wiehltalstadion, Wiehl, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Wiehler AggerEnergie and Sparkasse Gummersbach Summer Run is a varied running event for all age groups and performance levels. The courses start from the Wiehltalstadion and pass through the redesigned park areas in the center of Wiehl, offering a scenic backdrop. Whether as an individual runner or in a team, the summer run invites participants to be active, experience community, and have fun. The motto "Wi(ehle)r are sporty!" emphasizes the vibrant sports culture in Wiehl.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wiehltalstadion
Run through redesigned park areas in the city center
Scenic and varied course
additional: The race takes place on Saturday, September 5, 2026. The event is open to individual runners and teams. Contact person is Nicole Woberschal (Tel. 02262 99-206). Race courses start from Wiehltalstadion, scenic backdrop, registration possible

name: Wildman Harz
description: The WILDMAN Harz is a challenging trail running event around the mountain town of Wildemann in the Harz. The course features steep climbs, technical downhills, through spruce forests and alpine meadows, offering an authentic trail running experience in the Upper Harz. With distances ranging from 1.5 km to 55 km, there is a suitable challenge for every trail runner. The event is accompanied by a lively supporting program with a pasta party and a grill party, making the weekend a special experience.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and technical downhills
Spruce forests and alpine meadows
Single trails over roots and stones around Wildemann
additional: Registration is possible online until 30 minutes before the respective start with an additional fee of 10 EUR. Age restrictions per course are defined. Supporting program includes a pasta party on Friday and a grill party on Saturday. There are scoring categories, mandatory equipment, and refreshment points. Registration is via the partner myRacePartner.com. Courses with up to 2,100 meters of elevation, refreshment points, timing, environmental and fairness rules, supporting program including pasta and grill party, registration required.

name: Volksbank Mitte Kurstadtlauf
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Kurstadtlauf in Heilbad Heiligenstadt is a traditional race taking place on September 5, 2026, for the 27th time. The course covers 19 kilometers over the Dün and starts and ends at the Vitalpark. A tree is planted for each participant to reforest local forests, making the race environmentally particularly significant. The event offers a warm atmosphere and invites runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: 19 km run over the Dün
Start and finish at the Vitalpark (Leineaue 1)
Scenic route with forest sections
additional: Race number pickup from 8:30 a.m. in front of the Vitalpark. Late registrations are possible with a late registration fee of €3. The start and finish are at the Vitalpark, the race runs over the Dün, and there is a tree planting activity for participants.

name: 55. Brockenlauf
description: The Brocken Run is Germany's oldest mountain race and has been held annually since 1927 in Ilsenburg in the Harz. The main course over 26.2 km features 890 meters of elevation gain to the highest mountain in northern Germany, the Brocken, and offers a challenging experience with variable high-altitude mountain climate at the summit. The route passes through picturesque nature, historic sites, and offers impressive views. In addition to the main race, there are shorter courses that also provide a natural experience. The event is open to all runners, regardless of club membership.
course_highlights: 26.2 km with 890 meters of elevation gain to the Brocken
Variable high-altitude mountain climate at the summit with temperatures from -15 °C to 15 °C
Start in the medieval town of Ilsenburg, run along the Ilse and through the Harz Forest
additional: Timing at multiple points along the 26.2 km route via SPORTident Timing. The course is challenging with steep sections up to 12.5% incline and concrete slabs at the summit. The event is open to runners and hikers. The organizer reserves the right to change the course if conditions on the Brocken become unreasonable. Registrations are already possible, with various course lengths including ultra and running events, as well as a book flea market and exclusive running shirts.

description: The 20th Borkum Mile Run with Nordic Walking will take place on September 5, 2026, on the North Sea island of Borkum. The varied courses lead through the charming beach and dune landscape and offer the right challenge for every running enthusiast, from the junior pirate run to the quarter marathon. The high-sea climate and fresh sea air make the event a special experience, complemented by a comprehensive supporting program for participants and accompanying persons.
course_highlights: Courses through beach and dune landscape of Borkum island
High-sea climate and fresh sea air
Diverse routes from pirate run to quarter marathon
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event on-site until 45 minutes before the competition begins for an additional fee of 5.00 EUR, but without entitlement to the full service package and T-shirt. Catering on the course and at the finish line, changing rooms, bag storage, showers, and 90 minutes of free access to the Erlebnisdeck of Gezeitenland are included. Additionally, discounted ferry prices are available during the event weekend. Routes on promenade and beach, no age classes for Nordic Walking, refreshment stations on longer routes.

description: The Brokser Volkslauf takes place on September 5, 2026, in Bruchhausen-Vilsen and offers running and walking disciplines for all age groups. The event includes courses from 400 meters to 20 kilometers as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. Held in all weather conditions, participants can look forward to a colorful supporting program with a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The races start at the school and sports center, and children's and youth races are awarded medals.
course_highlights: Courses from 400 m (children's run) to 20 km (Volkslauf)
Start and finish at the school and sports center Bruchhausen-Vilsen
The 20 km route consists of two laps of the 10 km course
additional: Start and finish are at the school and sports center Bruchhausen-Vilsen. Bib number distribution begins at 13:00. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event. Award ceremonies are held in stages after each race. Medals are awarded for children's and youth races. The supporting program includes a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. Running, walking, held annually, in all weather conditions.

name: Ederauenlauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.4 km
description: The Ederauenlauf in Bergheim is a popular running event with a variety of course lengths suitable for runners of all ages and performance levels. The course runs through the picturesque Ederauen and offers ideal conditions with a measured, record-eligible route. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, numerous helpers, and a good mood. In addition to the athletic competition, the focus is also on the shared experience and supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Measured, record-eligible route through the Ederauen
Courses from 400m for children to half marathon (21.1 km)
Start and finish at the central sports facility of TV08 Bergheim
additional: The event offers various distances from 400m for children to a half marathon of 21.1 km. The course is dry, windless, and ideal for running weather. There is a family-friendly atmosphere with many helpers and spectators. The event supports social projects such as the Children's Cancer Aid Marburg. The central sports facility of TV08 Bergheim serves as the start and finish point. Courses are measured and well marked, including Nordic walking; donations for children's cancer aid; event scheduled for September 2026.

name: Fehmarn Marathon
description: The Fehmarn Marathon takes place annually on the island of Fehmarn and offers runners a varied course through the eastern part of the island. The main races lead over roads, dike paths, and uneven field paths, providing a diverse running experience. The event begins on September 5, 2026, at 9:30 AM at the sports field at the island school in Fehmarn. In addition to the marathon, there are other races with award ceremonies, and all participants receive an official marathon shirt. Timing is done with a foot chip attached to the running shoe, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Loop courses over roads, dike, and uneven field paths
Course through the eastern part of Fehmarn
Start and finish at the sports field at the island school
additional: Number bib distribution on the day before from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM and on the event day from 8:00 AM. Award ceremonies are held sequentially after the races. Timing is done with a foot chip to be returned after the race; a fee of €15 is charged for loss. The event ends around 3:15 PM with the arrival of the final support cyclist. Parking recommendations with walking distance to the start area are available. Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before each race. The shirts tend to run small; larger sizes are recommended. The event takes place in all weather conditions, online registration is possible, including race shirts and various categories.

name: 10. Parchener Fiener-Cross
description: The Parchener Fiener-Cross is a traditional cross-country race in the Jerichower Land, taking place as part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP race series in northern Saxony-Anhalt. The event attracts numerous runners of all ages each year and offers additional competitions with the Heidel-Team-Cup and family classification. The race is held at the Klapperhalle in Parkstraße in Parchen and is known for its varied cross-country course. The event promotes running in the region and combines athletic competition with a community experience.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Jerichower Land
Start and finish at the Klapperhalle in Parchen
Part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP with Heidel-Team-Cup and family classification
additional: The event takes place near the Klapperhalle in Parchen, with refreshment points and a family-friendly atmosphere. Registration is done online, and results are published after the race.
