The races lead through the traffic-free city center with start and finish on the marketplace in front of the town hall. Various distances are offered from a 300-meter Bambini run to the 10 km main race as well as relay competitions. The run is suitable for all age groups and offers a great opportunity to experience Bedburg in motion.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the marketplace in front of the town hall
Routes lead through the traffic-free city center of Bedburg
10 km main race with five laps through the city center
additional: Registration on the day of the event is possible until one hour before the respective start with a late registration fee of 3.00 euros (except for the Bambini run, which is free of charge). Headphones, MP3 players, baby joggers, and dogs are not allowed for safety reasons. Multiple race distances, online and on-site registration until one hour before the start, no dogs or headphones on the course.

name: Brachter Depotlauf
location: Brachter Depot, 41379 Brüggen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Brachter Depot Run is a guided scenic run through the beautiful Brachter Depot, taking place in different pace groups from 5:00 to 7:00 min/km. Various distances are offered, including half marathon, 14 km, 5 km beginner run, children's run (max. 2 km), and walking. The event emphasizes nature experience and social engagement, as participation in the children's run is free and a starting donation is collected on the event day. The races are organized by TSF Bracht and Depotrunners Bracht and feature a varied course in a natural environment.
course_highlights: Guided scenic run through the Brachter Depot
Different pace groups from 5:00 to 7:00 min/km
Various distances: half marathon, 14 km, 5 km, children's run
additional: Participation in the children's run is free. For all other runs, a starting donation of €10.00 is required, payable in cash only on the event day at the registration desk. The event is organized by TSF Bracht and Depotrunners Bracht. There is inclusive catering for participants. The races are held in different pace groups to accommodate all running speeds. Scenic run, various courses, inclusive catering, online registration.

name: Braker hkk Lauf
description: The 19th Braker hkk Run will take place on September 13, 2026, in Brake (Unterweser). It is a short race with distances of 850 meters and 10 kilometers. The race offers a pleasant running opportunity with typical September weather, featuring mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. Please note that the exact event details should be verified directly with the organizer.
course_highlights: Distances: 850 m and 10 km
Typical September weather with around 19°C and 45 mm of precipitation
Start location in Brake (Unterweser)
additional: The race includes two distances: 850 meters and 10 kilometers. September weather is typically mild and cloudy with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event usually takes place at comfortable temperatures around 19°C. Participants should check the current details with the organizer before registering.

name: Brückenlauf Halbmarathon Köln des ASV Köln
description: The Bridge Run Half Marathon Cologne organized by ASV Cologne is a traditional race covering 21.1 kilometers, running right through Cologne along the Rhine and over six of the city's most beautiful bridges. The course offers spectacular views of the cathedral and the city, accompanied by an exciting atmosphere and music along the route. In addition to the half marathon, there are shorter distances for beginners and children, including the Kölsche Runde (11.11 km) and the Bambini Run (500 m). The race combines athletic challenge with Rhineland joie de vivre and is suitable for both ambitious and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 21.1 km along the Rhine with views of the Cologne Cathedral
Crossing six Cologne bridges, including Hohenzollern Bridge and Rodenkirchen Bridge
Start and finish at the Chocolate Museum square with a lively atmosphere
additional: The Bridge Run is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for the best list. The LVN Southeast Regional Championships take place during the half marathon. Registration is available online, with on-site late registration possible on the event day. The Kölsche Runde is ideal for beginners and hobby runners, while the Bambini Run is for children aged 3-6 years. Both start and finish at the Chocolate Museum square. The event features music, announcers, and a lively atmosphere along the route. The race begins in Rheinauhafen and is part of the LVN Southeast Region Championships. Registration is possible online, including a T-shirt for members. Participation fees vary depending on the category.

name: DeisterCrossing Springe
description: The DeisterCrossing is a nature-oriented endurance event that combines running and marching in the outstanding natural scenery of the wooded Deister mountain range. The event offers courses over 10 km, 21.1 km, and 42.2 km for runners and marchers. The challenging routes include, among others, the Deister Hölle with 200 meters of elevation gain in a row and provide a unique natural and mountain experience near Hanover. The event is relaxed, with consideration among participants, and offers, in addition to the sporting challenge, refreshment points, finisher gifts, and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Deister Hölle with 200 meters of elevation gain in a row after 5 km
Marathon marchers additionally cover 50 meters of elevation to Bielstein
Nature and mountain run in the wooded Deister mountain range near Hanover
additional: Number pickup from 7:15 a.m. at IGS Springe. Timing chip is issued and exchanged at the finish for a wheat beer glass with DC logo. Showers and changing rooms are available in the sports hall of IGS Springe. Parking is available at IGS, Netto, and BZE. Arrival by S5 to Springe station, a 10-minute walk to the school center north. Refreshment points with seating and sandwiches, finish buffet. Awards ceremony for the top three women and men in the running competitions at 12:00 p.m. (10 km and half marathon) and 2:30 p.m. (marathon). Marchers receive patches to sew on. Routes in forested areas, refreshment points, patches for marchers, online certificates, award ceremonies, parking, showers & changing rooms in the sports hall, travel by train.

name: Dübener Heidelauf
location: Obermühle, Bad Düben, Landkreis Nordsachsen, Sachsen, Germany
description: The Dübener Heidelauf is a traditional forest run held at the picturesque Obermühle in Bad Düben, a spa town in North Saxony. Organized by SV Bad Düben, the event offers courses for children, teenagers, and adults. With distances ranging from 500 meters to the half marathon (21.1 km), the race appeals to both young runners and experienced long-distance athletes. The run is part of the regional athletics structure for North Saxony and Leipzig and is characterized by its family-friendly, club-oriented nature.
course_highlights: Forest run through the Dübener Heide
Course lengths from 500 m to 21.1 km (half marathon)
Event location at Obermühle in Bad Düben
additional: The race takes place in typical September weather with an average temperature of 19 °C (lowest 10 °C) and mostly cloudy skies. The event includes age groups from under 8 years to adults and is not a commercial large-scale event but a regional club race. Cross-country/forest terrain, races for various age groups, regional club event.

name: Eicklinger Volks- und Familielauf
description: The 1st Eicklingen Folk and Family Run is aimed at active families who want to spend a lovely day running together. The focus is on fun and the joy of running, without competitive pressure. The event offers a friendly atmosphere for all age groups and promotes movement within the community.
course_highlights: Running routes over 3 km and 6 km
Family-friendly event
Start location in Eicklingen
additional: Typical weather in September: approx. 19 °C, low of 10 °C, an average of 45 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy. The event is ideal for families who want to run together and offers a relaxed, communal atmosphere. The weather in September can affect the running enjoyment but is generally pleasant.

name: Garbenteicher Volkslauf
description: The Garbenteicher Volkslauf, organized by the Sports Club 1928 Garbenteich e.V., is a traditional race in Pohlheim, known as a good preparatory course for the Frankfurt Marathon. The route has been safety-optimized so that no federal roads or railway tracks need to be crossed. There are a total of seven refreshment stations with water, cola, and tea, and after the race, participants can enjoy excellent catering. The bib number distribution takes place on the day of the event from 08:00 or the day before at the Sports and Culture Hall Garbenteich.
course_highlights: Safe route without crossing federal roads or railway tracks
Seven refreshment stations with water, cola, and tea
Routes of moderate difficulty with moderate elevation gain
additional: Bib numbers and transponders can be collected on the day of the event from 08:00 or the day before between 16:00 and 17:00. Late registrations are possible on the event day until race start for an additional fee of 5 EUR. Changes to other distances are free of charge up to two days before the race. The route is marked and checked multiple times before the start. The race takes place on September 13, 2026, starting behind the Sports and Culture Hall Garbenteich. There is no club affiliation requirement, and the event is ideal for marathon preparation.

name: Hattinger Hüttenlauf
description: The Hattinger Hüttenlauf is a traditional race in HenrichsPark in Hattingen, offering various running and walking routes for all age groups. The course runs along footpaths with cobblestones, gravel, and asphalt beside the park ponds, starting and finishing under Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Museum Henrichshütte. In addition to the competitive race, there are classifications for children, youth, the fun run, and the 10 km Sparkassenlauf, as well as awards for the largest groups and the fastest Hattingen runners. The event is family-friendly and provides all participants with certificates for printing online.
course_highlights: Course in HenrichsPark along footpaths with cobblestones, gravel, and asphalt
Start and finish under Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Museum Henrichshütte
Race along the park ponds
additional: Late registrations are possible up to one hour before each start. All children in the Bambini race receive a medal. Certificates can be printed online by all participants. There are classifications in age groups and awards for the largest groups (schools, clubs) as well as for the fastest Hattingen runners. Various race distances, online registration, supporters from sports and business sectors.

name: Kiel Lauf
description: The Kiel.Lauf is a traditional running event in Kiel featuring various competitions for all age groups. The main discipline is the half marathon over 21.1 kilometers, which runs through the Kieler Westen and attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes. The popular race over 10.2 kilometers is the most participated event and offers a loop through Kiel city center with great atmosphere. Additionally, there are shorter runs for students and children, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: Half marathon runs through Kieler Westen
Popular race through Kiel city center
Various distances from about 0.7 km to 21.1 km
additional: The half marathon starts at 10:50 AM, the popular race at 9:45 AM. Due to construction work, there may be short-term route changes, which will be announced in advance. The event is very well attended with over 10,000 runners. There are various races for students and children, making the event family-friendly. The event includes street closures, participant information, and offers functional running shirts for most categories.

name: Kristall Lauf Weißwasser

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voranmeldung ist bis zum 05. September 2025 23:59 Uhr online über den Baer-Service möglich

description: The Kristall-Lauf Weißwasser is a versatile popular race that appeals to runners and walkers of all ages. The course runs through mixed terrain including asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, and forest trails with roots. The race is part of several regional rankings such as the Dresden District Ranking, the Sachsenenergie Runner Cup, and the Niederlausitz Cup, and also offers an official walking classification by the German Athletics Association. A special feature is the traditional team race, which promotes community and team spirit.
course_highlights: Mixed terrain: asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, forest trail with roots
Part of regional rankings: Dresden District Ranking, Sachsenenergie Runner Cup, Niederlausitz Cup
Official walking classification by the German Athletics Association
additional: Registrations on race day are possible on-site with an additional fee of €6 (2025) or €4 (2024). The race includes individual and team classifications. The routes are marked and binding on race day. The event is open to all age groups from children to seniors. Terrain: asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, forest trail with roots; team race with at least three runners; start at Bruno-Bürgel-Oberschule; registration on-site or online.

name: Othaler Gutshof Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Othaler Gutshoflauf is a young but popular running event with start and finish at the youth and school farm at Gutshof Othal. The event offers various distances from 0.5 km up to the half marathon of 21.1 km, which is run as the Intersport Liebig Half Marathon through several towns. The race allows participants to explore the eastern foothills of the Harz on diverse routes. Approximately 350 runners participate annually, highlighting the growing popularity of the event.
course_highlights: Half marathon route through Sotterhausen, Holdenstedt, Klosterrode, and Beyernaumburg
Start and finish area at the youth and school farm at Gutshof Othal
Various distances from 0.5 km to 21.1 km
additional: Start times: 09:00 AM for the half marathon, 09:45 AM for 10 km run/walking, 10:00 AM for 5 km run/walking, 10:05 AM for 0.5 km run, 10:15 AM for 1 km run, 10:30 AM for 2 km run. Routes for children, hobby runners, and competitive runners; start and finish area at the youth and school farm at Gutshof Othal; supported by sponsors such as Intersport Liebig and Autohaus Liebe.

name: Rathaus Center Dessauer CityRUN
description: The 26th Dessau Rathaus-Center CityRUN is a traditional race in the city center of Dessau, attracting runners from the region and beyond for many years. The course runs on a loop through central streets of the city with start and finish on Zerbster Straße near the Rathaus-Center. The race offers a sporting challenge in an urban environment and is part of a diverse sports program organized by the club Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organizing major sporting events in the region for decades.
course_highlights: Loop course through the city center of Dessau
Start and finish on Zerbster Straße at the Rathaus-Center
Course route via Steinstraße, Askanische Straße, and Kavalierstraße
additional: Volksbank children's run for children up to 9 years old over 1,000 meters, free for all children and students of Dessau. The organizer is the club Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organizing numerous major sports events in the region for over 20 years. Various distances, including children's runs, corporate run, registration on-site possible, finisher medals.

name: runroll City
description: The event runroll City takes place on September 13, 2026, in Bielefeld and offers a fast-paced sports experience on a 7.2-kilometer flat course right in the city. The course is ideal for quick times and suitable for both intensive running training and a fast competition. Participants can enjoy movement in an urban environment and become part of a dynamic event.
course_highlights: 7.2 kilometer long course
flat course for fast times
urban race in the heart of Bielefeld
additional: The event is known for its inclusive atmosphere and the opportunity to run or skate. It is aimed at everyone who enjoys movement in the city and offers an attractive route in downtown Bielefeld.

name: Stiftungslauf Salzgitter
description: The Foundation Run at Salzgittersee is a traditional running event taking place on September 13, 2026. The event offers various race competitions, including two main runs, a relay race, a short run, and walking. The start is at 10:30 AM at the DLRG building at Salzgittersee in Lebenstedt. The Salzgitter Foundation invites all running enthusiasts to join in and enjoy the fun of movement together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the DLRG building at Salzgittersee
Various race competitions: main runs, relay race, short run, walking
Run along Salzgittersee in Lebenstedt
additional: The event includes two main runs, a relay race, a short run, and walking. For questions, the organizer can be reached by phone at 0172/5416779. Event at Salzgittersee with main runs, relay race, short run, and walking.

name: Volksbank-Münster-Marathon
description: The Volksbank-Münster-Marathon is a major running event organized by runners for runners, mostly on a voluntary basis and with great passion. With around 12,000 participants, over 300 artists and bands along the route, and more than 100,000 spectators, the autumn marathon offers a unique atmosphere. The course is almost flat and runs through the bike- and run-friendly city of Münster. At the finish area on the Prinzipalmarkt, a red carpet is rolled out, making the finish line a special experience.
course_highlights: Course almost flat
Over 300 artists and bands along the route
Finish on a red carpet at Prinzipalmarkt
additional: The marathon is part of a large event with several competitions such as Atruvia Relay Marathon, Wecker-28 (28 km), Stadtwerke Kids Marathon, Westfalen AG Charity Run (10 km), and H+B technics Health Run (6 km). There is a combined ranking with the Enschede Marathon. The marathon office is staffed on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 9:00 am to 3:00 pm. A marathon guide with general information and FAQs is available. The marathon attracts about 12,000 runners, offers qualification opportunities for other races, and is supported by numerous sponsors. There are also accompanying events such as lectures and health seminars.

name: Waldlauf des TuS Calle-Wallen - Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup
description: The 46th Forest Run of TuS Calle-Wallen is part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup and takes place on September 13, 2026, in Meschede. The event offers races over 1 km and 10 km and is aimed at runners of all ages. The race leads through the forested areas around Meschede and promises a varied course in a natural setting. The typical weather in September is mild and mostly cloudy, ideal for running events.
course_highlights: Run through the forested areas around Meschede
Course lengths of 1 km and 10 km
Natural and varied running route
additional: The typical weather in September is around 19°C with lows of about 10°C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy. The event takes place in Meschede, with typical weather around 19°C and overcast skies. It is a good opportunity for the whole family to participate in a traditional race.

name: wep-Lauf
organizer: WEP Intersport Engels / Ralf Sester / TuS Jahn Hilfarth
description: The wepLAUF in Hückelhoven is a versatile sporting event with a family festival character, taking place on September 13, 2026. Offered are courses from the marathon to short distances for children, including a Flexi-Marathon, where participants can decide after each lap whether to continue. The start and finish area is located at Breteuilplatz, and the event includes not only the running program but also a lively supporting program with a bouncy castle, stage entertainment, and stalls. The event particularly promotes participation by children and adolescents with a school ranking. The surrounding streets are closed during the run, and free parking is available at Hückelhoven Center.
course_highlights: Marathon lap is completed four times, half-marathon lap twice
Flexi-Marathon with individual distance and certificate after completing the run
Start and finish area at Breteuilplatz, streets closed during the run
additional: The marathon traditionally starts as the first discipline of the day. Free parking is available at Hückelhoven Center. Registration is possible until September 10, 2026, 23:59. There is a diverse supporting program with a bouncy castle, stage entertainment, and sponsor stalls. The schools with the most participants will be awarded. Registrations are open until September 10. The start and finish are at Breteuilplatz, with free parking, changing rooms, and showers available, as well as support for young runners and corporate relay teams.

name: Zeuthener Jedermannslauf
price_range: kostenlos bis ca. 14,- € je nach Wettbewerb und Anmeldedatum
description: The Zeuthen Open Race is a popular community run held annually in September in Zeuthen. It offers various competitions for all age groups, from children to adults, with distances ranging from 400 meters to 10 kilometers. The event is family-friendly and promotes recreational sports in the region. The races start at the Zeuthen S-Bahn station and feature a varied course along the forest promenade.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400 m to 10 km
Start and finish at Miersdorfer Chaussee at Zeuthen S-Bahn station
Family-friendly community run with categories for all ages
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before each race against an additional fee. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the competitions. There are age group classifications and overall rankings with awards. The event runs from 8:00 AM to approximately 4:00 PM. The course includes cobblestone sections. Registration is open until September 10, 2026. Bib number distribution is on September 12, 2026. Medals are awarded to all finishers. Facilities such as showers, catering, and sales stands are available.

name: B2Run Berlin
description: The B2Run Berlin on September 16, 2026, is a corporate run featuring a approximately 5.7 km course around the Berlin Olympic Stadium. The race concludes with an emotional finish inside the historic Olympic Stadium and offers a unique team event for companies and individual participants from Berlin and the surrounding area. The focus is on team spirit, motivation, and fun, not on personal best times, making it ideal for beginners, walkers, and experienced runners. The event combines athletic activity with corporate health promotion and a professional program including moderation and music.
course_highlights: Approximately 5.7 km loop around the Berlin Olympic Stadium
Emotional finish inside the Olympic Stadium
Suitable for beginners, walkers, and experienced runners
additional: The race is part of the nationwide B2Run corporate run series in Germany, focusing on team building, health promotion, and employee motivation. The course can also be completed on foot or in a wheelchair. The event offers a professional program with moderation and music. Participation is open to companies of all sizes as well as individual runners. Over 10,000 participants are expected; various VIP and general areas; registration and ticket information are available on the official website; stadium layout and participation conditions are described in detail.

name: SportScheck RUN Hannover
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The SportScheck Run Hannover is an evening Night Run that transforms downtown Hannover into a spectacular light spectacle. Runners can choose between a 1 km race for children, 5 km, and 10 km routes that lead through the illuminated city center with sights such as the Opera Square, the Lower Saxony State Parliament, Kröpcke, and the New Town Hall. The atmosphere at night makes the run particularly appealing, creating an unforgettable experience. There is a 10 km SpeedRUN for the fastest runners, where the goal is to finish in under 50 minutes. The event is open to all performance levels and also offers training plans for preparation.
course_highlights: 5 km circular course through downtown Hannover
Passing illuminated sights such as the Opera Square, State Parliament, Kröpcke, and Town Hall
Evening start with a special atmosphere at night
additional: There is a 10 km SpeedRUN for runners under 50 minutes, starting one hour before the regular 10 km race. Children aged 7 to 12 can start on a 1 km route. Training plans for different performance goals are offered. The event takes place in the evening, with a festive atmosphere and a route through Hannover's main sights. There are no explicit price details.

name: Kassel Marathon
description: The Kassel Marathon is the largest sporting event in North Hesse and takes place from September 18 to 20, 2026, at the Auestadion Kassel. The event offers a variety of competitions such as marathon, half marathon, power walking, relay, corporate run, and children's races. The marathon course includes 200 meters of elevation gain and runs through the city of Kassel. Participants receive a finisher medal and a free finisher shirt. Medical support for runners is provided by the German Red Cross, and there is a massage service after the race.
course_highlights: Marathon course with 200 meters of elevation
Start and finish at Auestadion Kassel
Various competitions from marathon to children's run
additional: Finishers receive a medal and a free finisher shirt (sizes XS - XXL). After the race, there is a free massage at the Auestadion. Medical support is provided by the German Red Cross and a medical team. The certificate can be downloaded and printed online; no on-site printing. Main event at the Auestadion includes medal, certificate, finisher shirt, medical support, massage, and catering; registration is possible online; participation is open to those born in 2008 or earlier.

name: Future Run - Ausbildung in Bewegung
location: VSV Sportanlage, Buxtehude-Hedendorf, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Teilnahmegebühr beträgt 15,00 EUR pro Person. Die Anmeldung ist bis zum 31. August 2026 möglich.

description: The FUTURE RUN 2026 is a running event themed "Training in Motion" that highlights dual vocational training. For its 10th anniversary, the previous apprentice run has been renamed and is now open to everyone who wants to showcase dual training. Participants can choose between 5 km and 7 km distances, and group registrations are also offered. The event promotes fitness, health, and team spirit in training companies and will take place on September 18, 2026, at the sports facility of VSV Hedendorf-Neukloster.
course_highlights: Choice between 5 km and 7 km race distances
Event location: VSV sports facility, Buxtehude-Hedendorf
Promotion of fitness, health, and team spirit
additional: Program: 14:30 Check-in, 15:00 Welcome & group photo, 15:30 joint warm-up, approx. 17:30 award ceremony, followed by a communal barbecue. Group registrations are possible. Race on September 18, 2026, at the sports facility of VSV Hedendorf-Neukloster, with group registration options.

name: ONW-Lauf Dannenberg 2025
price_range: 6 Euro für Erwachsene, kostenlos für Kinder/Schüler

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Die Apotheke Seepassage übernimmt die Startgebühr für Kinder/Schüler!

description: The ONW Run 2026 is a major charity run in support of the Oncology Network Wendland, taking place on September 18, 2026, in the old town of Dannenberg. There are three race distances: 2.1 km, 4.2 km, and 10.5 km, starting at the marketplace. The event is open to participants of all ages and promotes the good cause with a strong sense of community. The registration fee for students is covered, adults pay 6 euros. Groups of four or more can participate in the team competition and win trophies.
course_highlights: Three distances: 2.1 km, 4.2 km, and 10.5 km
Start and finish at the marketplace in the old town of Dannenberg
Charity run supported by local sponsors and catering
additional: Race bibs can be picked up at the Seepassage pharmacy on September 17 from 9 am to 12 pm and 3 pm to 5 pm, as well as on September 18 from 9 am to 12 pm. Pickup on the marketplace is possible from 3 pm. Kristallkraft donates 1 euro per runner to the ONW. Sparkasse provides drinks for all runners. Groups of four or more can participate in the team competition, with the four best runners in each group being scored. Payment of the registration fee is also possible via PayPal. All proceeds go 100% to the Oncology Network Wendland. Race on September 18, 2026, with group and team classifications, online registration with PayPal, race bib pickup at Seepassage pharmacy, part of the Wendland Run Cup.

name: Stadtfestlauf Lüdinghausen
description: The City Festival Run Lüdinghausen is a traditional running event organized by SC Union 08 Lüdinghausen e.V. The event offers runners of various age and performance levels the opportunity to compete on diverse courses through the city and its surroundings. The race is part of the Westmünsterland Running Series and attracts numerous participants each year who appreciate both the sporting competition and the community experience. The event is open to everyone who enjoys running and is organized by a dedicated club with many years of experience.
course_highlights: Diverse routes through Lüdinghausen and the surrounding area
Part of the Westmünsterland Running Series
Varied running courses for different age and performance groups
additional: Runners can register online; the event also includes a market, music, and family activities.

name: Wipperfürther Stadtlauf
location: Wipperfürth, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: ab 4 EUR (Bambini- und Schülerläufe), 9 EUR (4,4 km Lauf), 14 EUR (Hauptlauf)
description: The 20th Wipperfürth City Run will take place on September 18, 2026, and will lead through the historic old town of Wipperfürth. The event offers races for all age groups, from kindergarten runs to the main 10 km race, which is officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The races are electronically timed, and all participants will receive commemorative medals. The event is open to everyone, membership in a club is not required, and attractive awards are given to the fastest and class winners.
course_highlights: Historic old town of Wipperfürth
10 km main race with 7 large laps, DLV-measured
Various distances from 0.5 km to 10 km
additional: Late registrations are possible on September 18, 2026, from 4:00 PM at the KSK branch in Marktplatz (additional fee of 3 EUR). Race documents will be handed out from 4:00 PM at Marktplatz. Changing rooms and showers are available at the fire station on Lüdenscheider Straße 14. Relay race exchanges take place at the start area on Lüdenscheider Straße by handing over a sash or baton. All participants receive commemorative medals, with trophies for the top finishers in the Bambini and school runs, and prizes for the 4.4 km race and main race. The city champions are determined from the fastest Wipperfürth participants. Various running competitions, medals for all finishers, registration until September 11, 2026, start/finish at the large parking lot Ohler Wiesen.

name: 32. Stadtparklauf
description: The City Park Run Sondershausen is a traditional race event held annually in Sondershausen City Park. The event offers various distances from 500 meters to 10,000 meters and is suitable for runners of all ages and skill levels. The course runs through the picturesque city park and provides a pleasant running atmosphere in a green environment. The race is organized by SV Glückauf Sondershausen e.V. and is very popular in the region.
course_highlights: Run through Sondershausen City Park
Various distances from 500 m to 10,000 m
Family-friendly and varied course
additional: Results from previous years are available as PDF files for all distances. The event offers online results from past years and is an annual event that includes running as well as family and leisure activities.

name: 6. The Devil's Loop - Langenberg Backyard Ultramarathon
description: The Devil's Loop - Langenberg Backyard Ultramarathon is a challenging ultramarathon held in Enge-Sande, Schleswig-Holstein. The race is part of the Waterkant-Cup and offers runners the opportunity to test their endurance on a demanding course. The organizer, the sports club Enge-Sande from 1959 e.V., is a well-established club offering a variety of sports activities. The event is aimed at ambitious runners seeking a special challenge.
course_highlights: Backyard ultramarathon format with round running
Event in the rural surroundings of Enge-Sande
Part of the Waterkant-Cup with multiple races
additional: The race is part of the Waterkant-Cup series, which consists of six races. The organizer is the sports club Enge-Sande, which also provides additional sports offerings and training times for runners. There are no explicit details about start times, pricing tiers, or registration fees on the available pages. The event is designed for ultra-long durations, with multiple rounds until only one runner remains. It takes place in September 2026 and is very popular among ultramarathon enthusiasts. Participation requires prior registration, and the event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and challenging course.

name: Altstadt-Run 2026
description: The Altstadt-Run Treysa 2026 will take place on September 19th in Schwalmstadt and is part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup. The event offers runners an attractive opportunity to run through the historic old town of Treysa. Organized by ESV Jahn Treysa, the race is aimed at all running enthusiasts seeking a sporting challenge in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: Run through the historic old town of Treysa
Start and finish at Marktplatz 7 in Schwalmstadt
Part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup
additional: The event is associated with local community activities and takes place at Marktplatz 7 in Schwalmstadt.

name: Crosslauf Rund um den Wasserturm
description: The cross-country race around the water tower in Oberschöna is a varied run offering distances from 1 km to 10 km. Children and students can participate in special races, and Nordic walkers are also warmly welcomed. The course runs around the distinctive water tower and provides a sporting challenge in a scenic environment.
course_highlights: Varied cross-country run around the water tower
Distances of 1 km, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Separate races for children and students
additional: Nordic walkers are also welcome. Typical weather in September: about 19°C, mostly cloudy with approximately 45 mm of precipitation. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various competitions and routes for all age groups.

name: Duinger Berglauf
description: The Duinger Mountain Run takes place on September 19, 2026, in Duingen, Lower Saxony, and offers races for children and adults. The event starts and ends at the OBS sports hall and includes short children's races as well as more challenging 5 km and 10 km mountain runs with approximately 110 meters of elevation gain. Organized by the Duinger Sports Club e.V., the race has been an accessible local mountain running event for 19 years. After the race, all participants receive free access to the indoor pool and sauna, with changing rooms, showers, and on-site catering.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses with approx. 110 m elevation gain
Route mainly on paved field and forest paths
Children's races near the school grounds, adult races from the sports hall
additional: Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start. Free access to the indoor pool and sauna after the race. Changing rooms, showers, food, and drinks available on-site. No club membership required. Various distances, including children's and adult categories; registration possible until shortly before the race; post-race amenities include indoor pool and sauna.

name: Edeka Ladage-Lauf Wennigsen

description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen offers a diverse program for all age groups with distances ranging from about 600 meters for kindergarten children to 10 kilometers for adults. The races take place on a varied loop course on the grounds of the Sophie-Scholl-Gesamtschule, which passes through residential areas and field paths and promises a special atmosphere at the start and finish. In addition to the sporting competition, the social aspect is also in the foreground, as the proceeds from the main race are donated to the craft community of the Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is a popular community run with a family atmosphere and a long tradition in the region.
course_highlights: Varied loop course on the grounds of the Sophie-Scholl-Gesamtschule
Course passes through residential areas, field paths, and along Argestorfer Straße
Start and finish in close proximity to the event area with a special atmosphere
additional: Registrations are possible until one hour before the respective start with additional fees. Kindergarten and elementary school children runs start at 5:00 PM, with award ceremonies shortly after the races. The 5 km run consists of two laps of the 2.5 km loop course, and the 10 km run consists of four laps. Participation in the main race includes automatic entry into the prize draw. The proceeds from the main race are donated. Various distances, children and adult categories, donations to local clubs.

name: Freimarktslauf
description: The Garrel Freimarktslauf is the largest community run in the region and offers a diverse running experience with its flat loop courses for young and old, beginners and professionals. The event includes distances from 400 meters for children to 10 kilometers for main races, which take place on a 2.5 km flat loop through Garrel. In addition to the athletic competition, community and fun are the main focus, supported by the RunClub Garrel, which specifically promotes beginners. Over 1,300 participants make the race a popular event with unforgettable moments.
course_highlights: Flat 2.5 km loop course through Garrel
All main races on the same loop with 1, 2, or 4 laps
Varied distances from 400 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: The race offers a combined scoring for 5 km and 10 km runs. There are special races for children and adolescents, including a children's run, a taster run, and a school children’s run. The RunClub Garrel supports beginners and re-entrants with joint training sessions. The event is a large community celebration with over 1,300 participants and numerous photos and results available online. The race includes various distances and is open to runners of all ages. Registration is online, and the event is part of regional festivities.

name: Insellauf Rund um Amrum
location: Norddorf auf Amrum, Nordfriesland, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Island Run around Amrum is a popular running event for everyone, taking place annually in late summer on the North Sea island of Amrum in Norddorf. The event offers a sporting challenge amidst the unique nature of the Wadden Sea National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Participants can enjoy the varied landscape with dunes, Kniepsand (a type of sandy beach), and sea views. The race is an attractive opportunity for both locals and vacationers to combine activity and nature experience.
course_highlights: Run through the diverse landscape with Kniepsand and dunes
Course within the Wadden Sea National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Start and finish in Norddorf on Amrum
additional: The island run takes place annually in late summer. The event is part of the extensive sports program on Amrum. The venue is the AOK-Nordseeklinik Strunwai 23 in Norddorf on Amrum. The event occurs within the Wadden Sea National Park area and emphasizes nature experience and beach activities. Registration is possible on-site or via email, with catering and support from local partners.

name: Klausdorfer Kranichlauf
description: The Klausdorf Crane Run invites runners of all ages to various routes in the beautiful surroundings of Klausdorf. Timing is done with a chip issued with the start number. Each participant receives a certificate and a medal, and the top three finishers of each route are specially honored. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish line, and changing rooms and toilets are available at the Vorpommernhus. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: Running routes through Klausdorf, Hohendorf, Wendisch-Langendorf, Zarrenzin, Barhöft, and Prohn with views
Start and finish at the Vorpommernhus near the beach
Refreshments on the course and at the finish
additional: Late registrations are possible on September 18, 2026, from 18:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 07:00 to 09:30 at the Vorpommernhus. The award ceremony for the Landknirpselauf takes place immediately after crossing the finish line. Parking is sufficiently available around the Vorpommernhus. Registration is possible via email or online. Participation is at your own risk. Medals and certificates are provided to all participants. Refreshments are available at the finish and on the course. Parking is available.

name: Mühlenlauf in Laar
location: Laar, Grafschaft Bentheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: Verein zur Erhaltung der Windmühle Laar/Vechte e.V.
description: The Mill Run in Laar has been organized by SV Grenzland Laarwald since 1986 and takes place annually on the third weekend of September. Runners of all ages can choose between 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances. The start and finish are located at the historic windmill, which, together with the Mill Society, creates a cozy atmosphere. Food and drinks are available to ensure the well-being of participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic windmill in Laar
Distances: 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Run through the scenic surroundings of Laar
additional: The Mill Run is organized in cooperation with the sports club. The windmill and the homeland house can be rented for celebrations. Drinks and snack offers are available on site for runners and spectators. The event takes place in September, with provisions for drinks and snacks. Pre-registrations are possible, and late registrations can be made on site. The event is held in all weather conditions.

name: Neusser Integrationslauf
description: The Neuss Integration Run, organized by DJK RHEINKRAFT Neuss 1914 e.V., will take place on September 19, 2026, at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sports Facility in Neuss. The run stands for active integration, where people of all origins, skin colors, religions, and with disabilities can run or walk together. The focus is on the community experience and a symbol for integration, not on competition. The colorful supporting program with music, children's activities, and culinary offerings makes the day a festival for participants and visitors.
course_highlights: Open course for running and walking without time pressure
Diverse participants of all ages and backgrounds
Colorful supporting program with bouncy castle, bull riding, and music
additional: The run is open to all age groups, origins, skin colors, religions, and disabilities. There are no rankings; fun and community are the priorities. The supporting program offers a variety of activities for participants and visitors, including a bouncy castle, bull riding, children's program, music, and culinary specialties. The event takes place at the Ludwig-Wolker Sports Facility and is part of the SportWeek for All 2026, with inclusive sports offerings and trial activities.

name: Röderhof-Benefiz-Lauf
description: The Röderhof Benefit Run takes place on September 19, 2026, in Diekholzen and offers various running and walking routes for all age groups and fitness levels. The event is a traditional charity event, emphasizing the fun of running and the collective commitment to a good cause. The distances range from 500 meters to 10 kilometers, including special wheelchair races. Start times are staggered to ensure smooth proceedings.
course_highlights: Varied distances from 500 m to 10 km
Includes wheelchair races and walking routes
Run through the scenic surroundings of Diekholzen
additional: Registration deadline online is September 15 at 21:00. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 1 hour before the start, with an additional fee of 2 euros. Payment can be made via direct debit. The event features multiple start times for different routes and categories, including special wheelchair races and walking routes. Various running disciplines, wheelchair races, walking, and donation options via PayPal.

name: Welterbelauf Zollverein 2026
location: Zollverein, Essen-Stoppenberg, Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Zollverein World Heritage Run takes place on September 19, 2026, on the grounds of the Zollverein Coal Mine Industrial Complex in Essen-Stoppenberg. The race routes lead over the Ring Promenade and past notable industrial monuments such as the Doppelbock headframe, the SANAA building, and the Zollverein slag heap. Various competitions are available for all age and performance levels, including a 10 km run, relays, walking events, and Special Olympics categories. The 10 km course is officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for rankings. The run combines athletic challenge with the unique atmosphere of UNESCO World Heritage.
course_highlights: Route over the Ring Promenade and past the Doppelbock headframe
Passage by the SANAA building and the Zollverein slag heap
10 km course officially measured by DLV and eligible for rankings
additional: The event offers eight different competitions, including the 10 km Zollverein Run, 3 x 3.3 km Pütt relay, 5.4 km Kumpel Run and Steiger Walk, 2.7 km Coal Mine Run, 1.2 km Schülerlauf (student race), 600 m Helen Keller Run, and 300 m Bambini Run. Parking on the grounds is free for participants and visitors. The event is easily accessible by public transport and car. International competition rules of the DLV and IAAF apply. Registration begins on May 15, 2026; the event includes team relays (Pütt Run) and offers certificates and results online.

name: Wilstermarsch Lauf
description: The Wilstermarsch Run is a traditional running event in Wilster, taking place on September 19, 2026, for the 34th time. The event offers various race distances for children and adults, including 400 meters, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km, passing through the scenic Wilstermarsch. In addition to the athletic competition, a lively supporting program with games, bouncy castles, a DJ, a barbecue stand, and refreshments provides entertainment and a feel-good atmosphere for participants and spectators. The run is part of the Steinburg Cup and attracts several hundred runners each year, supported by numerous volunteers.
course_highlights: Runs through the scenic Wilstermarsch
Stadium rounds for children with loud support from spectators
5 km loop course through Nortorf and Wilster with varied terrain
additional: The Wilstermarsch Run includes multiple races for different age groups and distances, including children’s runs from 400 meters, 2 km children’s race, 5 km, and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km walking. There is an extensive supporting program with bouncy castles, a DJ, barbecue stand, refreshments, and photo wall. The event is supported by approximately 40 volunteers and is part of the Steinburg Cup. Prizes and vouchers are raffled among participants, and milestone gifts are given to the 33rd finishers. Registrations are planned for spring 2026. The event is family-friendly, offering entertainment for all involved.

name: Wutzseelauf
description: The Wutzseelauf in Lindow (Mark) is a family-friendly road race taking place on September 19, 2026, for the 21st time. The varied courses lead around Lake Wutzsee through the Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park and offer running opportunities for all age groups from babies to experienced runners. The event is characterized by a warm atmosphere, professional timing with transponders, and a colorful supporting program. Participants can look forward to distances from 600 meters to 22 kilometers, including Nordic walking. After the races, award ceremonies are held, and each finisher receives a certificate available for download or print on-site.
course_highlights: Running courses around Lake Wutzsee in the Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park
Distances from 600 m to 22 km for all age groups
Varied routes with forest and lake passages
additional: Timing is done using transponders integrated into the start numbers via myRacePartner. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event online until 10 minutes before the respective start, except for the Bambini runs, which have no late registration fee. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races. Each finisher can download their certificate online or have it printed on-site. Course profiles for children, adolescents, and adults, online registration, start numbers with transponder, various distances, routes through forest and around Lake Wutzsee.

description: The PSD Bank Half Marathon in Hamburg is a fast and flat running event that passes through the Wandsbek district and takes runners up to the Berne subway station in the north. The course runs back through Rahlstedt and Tonndorf to the start and finish area on Wandsbeker Marktstraße. The race is characterized by a unique atmosphere with support from spectators and live bands along the route and takes place in late summer at dusk.
course_highlights: Fast and flat course through the Wandsbek district
Northernmost point at the Berne subway station
Strong support from spectators and bands along the route
additional: Drop-off of clothing bags on event day from 08:30 to 13:30 at the Wandsbeker weekly market. The start and finish are located on Wandsbeker Marktstraße in front of the Quarree shopping center. The race bib distribution takes place on September 19 and 20, 2026. Medical emergency services are available, the course is cordoned off and secured, and a finisher medal is awarded. The results list and personalized certificates are available online. The event also includes the Köhlbrand Bridge Run and offers detailed information on the course, registration, and results.

name: 14. Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra
description: The Northeimer Daylight Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon held in Northeim. The course runs through varied terrain and offers a special challenge for experienced ultrarunners. The event has a long tradition with numerous finishers and records, underscoring the high quality and sporting demands of the race. Participants can download the GPX track of the course to prepare optimally.
course_highlights: Long ultramarathon distance of over 100 km
Varied terrain with daylight running character
Course records of over 125 km (men) and 104 km (women)
additional: The GPX track of the course can be downloaded. The event has a long history with finisher numbers and course records. There are no explicit price details or start times available on the pages. The event takes place twice a year in March and September, with multiple editions since 2018. The courses are available as GPX files, facilitating preparation.

name: 28. Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The 28th Hiddestorfer Beetroot Run is a family-friendly running event organized by the running club of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. The event offers courses over 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km, and the Hemminger Half Marathon (21.3 km). In addition to the athletic competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners' breakfast, cakes, waffles, grilled foods, drinks, and a varied supporting program with face painting for children. The event is open to all runners; membership in a club is not required.
course_highlights: Courses ranging from 1.4 km to 21.3 km (Half Marathon)
Start and finish at the sports field of SVE Hiddestorf
Family-friendly atmosphere with runners' breakfast and culinary offerings
additional: Race bibs and chips will be issued on the day of the event from 7:00 a.m. The timing is done with a chip that must be returned after the run. There is a free Möhrrchen Run (500 m) for children up to 6 years old, without registration or entry fee. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports and tennis hall near the start and finish. Parking is limited and up to 500 meters walking distance. Late registrations are only possible online until the registration deadline. The runners' breakfast is free for all participants and includes cheese, salami, baguette, and red wine (from 18 years). Courses over 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km, and 21.3 km; online registration; event takes place at the sports field in Hiddestorf; parking options are limited.

name: 8. Altstadtlauf Salzwedel
description: The Old Town Run Salzwedel is part of the Elbe-Ohre Cup and will take place for the eighth time in 2026. The course runs through the historic old town of Salzwedel on a 5 km loop. The longer distances, 10 km and half marathon, are run with multiple laps. The event is organized by Sportclub Demker '95 e.V. and offers an attractive competition opportunity for runners in northern Saxony-Anhalt.
course_highlights: Loop through the historic old town of Salzwedel
5 km loop as the basis for all distances
Longer distances (10 km, half marathon) with multiple laps
additional: The event recorded 223 finishers in 2023 and offers running opportunities for all age groups, including children’s and youth races.

name: Uentroper Geithelauf
description: The 24th Uentroper Geithelauf will take place on September 20, 2026, and features a run through the green heart of Uentrop. The event is organized by the Turn- und Sportverein 46/68 Uentrop e.V. and offers a sporting community in a natural environment. The running routes lead across fields and forest paths in the surrounding area and are suitable for various fitness levels. The event emphasizes fun, community, and a pleasant atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Running routes through the green heart of Uentrop
Natural paths over fields and forest trails
Suitable for different fitness levels
additional: The running groups are arranged so that no one is overwhelmed and everyone can find their rhythm. Experienced instructors support participants with technique and preparation. The event promotes flexibility and fun in running within the community. Run through the green heart of Uentrop, Date: September 20, 2026
