The course is unmarked and run via GPS navigation, with a final GPS track and a briefing sent via email beforehand. Three refreshment stations offer drinks and snacks, with participants required to carry their own drinking containers and cups. Participation is limited to 50 runners, with a time limit of 9 hours.
course_highlights: 53 km ultratrail through moors and heath areas near Langenhagen
Route passes through Kananoher Forest, Black Moor, Otternhagen Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Great Heath, and Bissendorf Moor
Unmarked course requiring GPS navigation with pre-provided track
additional: Maximum 50 participants. Time limit 9 hours. Three refreshment stations with cola, water, fruit, and snacks, some unmanned. Bring your own water bottle and cup. At the finish, coffee, cake, bratwurst, and drinks. Participants must be at least 18 years old. Participation at own risk, no liability from the organizer. Trail sections, GPS navigation, 3 refreshment stations, maximum 50 participants, 9-hour limit, start in Kaltenweide.

name: 14. Burgdorfer Spargel-Lauf
price_range: Kinder: 5 €, 2.500 m-Lauf: 8 €, 5.000 m-Lauf: 10 €, 10.000 m-Lauf: 12 €, Nordic Walking: 10 €
description: The Burgdorf Asparagus Run is an annual running event held as part of the Oktobermarkt city festival in Burgdorf. On October 4, 2026, the 14th edition of this popular event will take place, welcoming hobby runners of all ages. The courses run along the Aue river and through the city center, starting and finishing at the Auebrücke Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße. The event offers races over 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, as well as Nordic walking and a children's run.
course_highlights: Course along the Aue river and through the city center of Burgdorf
Start and finish at the Auebrücke Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße
Children's run over 660 meters through central streets of Burgdorf
additional: Timing is done electronically via chip at the start number. Online certificates are available for all participants. Late registration on the day of the event from 12:30 to 13:30 with an additional fee of €4 is possible. Parking options include the train station, Schützenplatz, and Rathaus II. The award ceremony takes place at the Auebrücke after the main races. The run takes place in all weather conditions. The course runs through Burgdorf along the Aue, castle, and city park; registration is open until October 2, 2024; parking is available nearby.

name: 23. Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The 23rd Central German Marathon on October 4, 2026, offers a unique running experience through the Central German metropolitan region with start in Leipzig and finish in Halle (Saale). The course passes through two federal states and two cities, starting at the Sportforum in Leipzig and ending in the over 1,200-year-old cultural capital Halle. In addition to the marathon, there are other disciplines such as the Handellauf half marathon, the half marathon relay, 10 km run, 10 km walk, Salzwirkerlauf, and the AOK Schnupperlauf. The event combines sporting challenge with cultural highlights and green running routes in the Handel city.
course_highlights: Start in Leipzig at Sportforum, finish in Halle at Marktplatz
Course through two federal states and two cities
Run through the green lungs of the Handel city and the city center of Halle
additional: Start and finish at different locations: start in Leipzig at Sportforum, finish in Halle at Marktplatz. Various disciplines including relay and walking. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible. Distribution of start documents takes place in Leipzig. The event combines sporting challenge with cultural and scenic highlights. Multiple distances, start and finish in Halle - Marktplatz as well as Leipzig - Elsterflutbecken; routes are still subject to approval. The weather in October is usually mild with temperatures around 14°C.

name: 26. Generali Köln Marathon
organizer: Kölner Marathon Veranstaltungs- und Werbe GmbH
description: The Generali Cologne Marathon is a unique running experience that combines top-level and recreational sports with carnival, folk festival, and running festival. The course takes runners through lively Cologne neighborhoods such as Rodenkirchen, Lindenthal, Ehrenfeld, and Nippes, ending spectacularly at Cologne Cathedral. With up to 15,000 participants, the marathon offers an exhilarating atmosphere supported by thousands of spectators along the route. The event also emphasizes sustainability and features a diverse accompanying program.
course_highlights: Start in Deutz at Ottoplatz with a panoramic view of Cologne Cathedral and the Old Town
Passage three times at Rudolfplatz with strong spectator support
Course through diverse districts such as Südstadt, Ehrenfeld, and Nippes
additional: The marathon starts in Deutz at Ottoplatz and includes multiple transition zones for relay and school marathons. There are 11 refreshment stations during the marathon and 6 during the half marathon. The event is limited to 15,000 participants for the marathon. The course passes well-known Cologne sights and districts, with the finish line at Cologne Cathedral. The event emphasizes sustainability and offers a diverse program with carnival and running festival. Registration is open, with various race disciplines, limited starting spots, special competitions for students, and a sustainable event.

name: Boitzer Herbstlauf
description: The Boitzer Autumn Run is a local autumn race with walking in Walsrode, Lower Saxony, organized by the sports club SV Kirchboitzen. The event will take place in 2026 for the 19th time as an in-person event and is open to runners and walkers of all ages. Participants will receive the most important information directly on-site from the organizing team. Additional practical tips will be provided by SV Kirchboitzen.
course_highlights: Distances: 800 m and 14 km
Typical October weather with about 14 °C and mostly cloudy
Event in the Walsrode region, Lower Saxony
additional: The event is a local club race with walking. The most important info is given on-site by the organizing team, with further details provided by SV Kirchboitzen. It is recommended to check the event details with the organizer before registration. The event takes place in autumn weather with temperatures around 6-14°C, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. It is aimed at runners and walkers who want to enjoy the autumn atmosphere.

name: Büdelsdorfer Eiderlauf
description: The Büdelsdorf Eiderlauf is a traditional autumn race in Büdelsdorf, Schleswig-Holstein, organized by SG Athletico Büdelsdorf. It offers classic local road race distances, including 5 km and 10 km, which are flat and easily manageable, making them ideal for hobby runners and beginners. The start and finish are often located at the Eiderstadion, giving the event a family-friendly and straightforward atmosphere. The race attracts children, teenagers, and local club runners and is a regular part of the regional running scene in autumn.
course_highlights: Flat road race distances
Start and finish at Eiderstadion
Family-friendly and local club race
additional: The race takes place in typical October weather with approximately 14°C daytime temperature and mostly cloudy skies. There are various distances from 1.5 km to 11.1 km, including children's races. After a Corona break, the procedure was adjusted to incorporate the start and finish at the stadium. Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, 5.8 km, 10.9 km, 11.1 km; flat routes; event in autumn; start and finish at the stadium; participation open to all age groups.

name: Cottbuser Oktoberlauf
description: The Cottbus October Run is a traditional race event held at the Cottbus Sports Center in the athletics stadium and mainly in the forest on solid paths and bike paths. The event offers various distances from 400 meters up to the half marathon (21.1 km), with partly paved and unpaved routes. There are special races for children and adolescents with obstacles and varied course sections. Participants receive a commemorative medal and can download certificates online. The event is part of the Sparkassen Run and Walking Cup and offers trophies and material prizes for the best runners in different age groups.
course_highlights: Courses at the Cottbus Sports Center with start and finish in the athletics stadium
Forest passages with solid paths and bike paths, partly unpaved routes
Refreshment points at the Spree Bridge on the longer distances
additional: Timing is done with an ankle transponder, which must be returned after the race (20 EUR fee in case of loss). The bib number must be visibly worn on the chest. Trophies, certificates, and material prizes are awarded for age groups and overall finishes. Changes to the courses for 5 km, 10.5 km, and 21.1 km should be noted. Late registrations are possible online until October 3, 2025, and on-site until one hour before the start. The race starts at 10:50 AM, participation is part of the Sparkassen Run and Walking Cup, online registration is available, with various categories including children and toddler runs.

name: Gaudilauf 14
organizer: Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Gaudilauf is a traditional race taking place on October 4, 2026, in Bad Liebenwerda. The route runs from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda back to Munich and offers a scenic course along the Elster. The race is characterized by a friendly atmosphere, where competitive spirit is secondary. Refreshments are provided every 5 kilometers, and at the finish line, participants can enjoy a cozy celebration with drinks and grilled food. A bus transfer from the finish back to the start is available upon request.
course_highlights: Race route from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda and back
Refreshments approximately every 5 kilometers with drinks and apples
Finish with a Maß beer or other drink and a festival tent with grilled food
additional: Number bibs are issued at the respective starting locations until the start time. Bus transfer from Munich to Bad Liebenwerda is possible upon registration (departure around 9:10 AM). Luggage transfer from the start to the finish is offered. Free entry to the festival tent on race day, grilled food for a small fee. Due to current circumstances, the start from Schweinfurth has been canceled. 14 km run/hike, registration via email, bus transfer from Munich, no official timing.

name: Gaudilauf 27
description: The Munich-BaLi-Munich, formerly known as Gaudilauf, is a 27 km road race in Munich, Germany. The race typically takes place in early October with a start in the morning. The event is organized by LWV 05 Bad Liebenwerda, indicating a club-organized race with a modest number of participants, fewer than 100 runners. The event offers good organization and value for money, although the course is rated as average in scenic quality.
course_highlights: 27 km road race in Munich
Start in the morning in early October
Small field of participants under 100 runners
additional: The race is organized by the club LWV 05 Bad Liebenwerda. The number of participants is small, with only a few finishers recently. The weather in October is typically cool and cloudy, with an average of 14°C during the day and 6°C at night, and about 40 mm of precipitation. 27 km road race, early October, small participant field, registration via website, scenic course with an average rating.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The Autumn Run in Ovenhausen is a traditional race event organized annually on the first Sunday in October by TuS Ovenhausen. The event offers various courses for different age and performance groups, including a challenging 20.8 km tour through forests and mountains as well as shorter runs for young athletes. The race features a diverse route with sections on bike paths, in the Grube Stadium, and in the forest. It is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes and usually takes place in pleasant autumn weather.
course_highlights: 20.8 km tour through forests and mountains near Ovenhausen
Sections on bike paths and in the Grube Stadium
Forest run with varied terrain
additional: The race traditionally takes place on the first Sunday in October. There are various age groups and distances, including a 1,000m run for children and a 4.5 km run, which is also counted as the district championship in cross-country running. The event is organized by TuS Ovenhausen, which works closely with HLC Höxter. Runs on forest paths, district championships, distances from 1 km to 20.8 km, start and finish locations only visible with RUNME Premium.

name: Luftschifflauf
location: Flughafen Essen/Mülheim, Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The TURCK Airship Run at Essen/Mülheim Airport offers a unique running experience on the airport's runway. The flat, fast course without tight turns or elevation changes is ideal for personal bests. The highlight is the spectacular finish inside the impressive WDL airship hangar, making the race an unforgettable event. The family-friendly event includes various distances for children, teenagers, and adults and takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on the airport's runway
Spectacular finish inside the WDL airship hangar
Loop courses around the airship hangar with wide taxiways
additional: Start times staggered: 11:30 AM for children’s runs, 1:00 PM for youth and community run, 1:30 PM for 4x2.5 km relay and 10 km run. A total of 1500 starting places. Re-registrations are possible up to 15 minutes before the respective start. The event takes place in all weather conditions, cancellation only in case of storm warnings. Family-friendly event with on-site catering. Race on airport runway, family-friendly, children’s run, on-site catering, online registration, in all weather, parking outside the premises.

name: Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The Central German Marathon is a special running experience in the heart of Germany, connecting the Central German metropolitan region on a fast course between Leipzig and Halle (Saale). The classic marathon route, where the first German marathon was held in 1925, runs from the Bach city of Leipzig to the cultural capital Halle. In addition to the marathon, there are other disciplines such as the Handellauf half marathon, the half marathon relay, 10 km run, 10 km walk, and the Salzwirkerlauf. The event offers a diverse program and is suitable for runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: Fast marathon course between Leipzig and Halle (Saale)
Start in the Bach city of Leipzig, finish in the cultural capital Halle
Run through one of Germany's greenest cities
additional: For the marathon, there are pacemakers for target times of 3:30, 3:45, 4:00, and 4:15 hours. The bib number includes a ticket from the Central German Transport Association for a free one-way or return trip on the event day between Halle and Leipzig within the respective fare zones. Split times must be adhered to; otherwise, disqualification will occur. Race documents can be collected at various registration offices. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible. The event includes various race types, starts in Halle and Leipzig, and offers a varied route through the Central German region with villages, forests, and floodplains.

name: Soester Stadtlauf
price_range: abhängig von der Distanz (Infos im Anmeldeportal)
description: Experience the traditional Soester City Run, a sporting highlight for young and old in the historic city center of Soest. Whether casual runners, ambitious athletes, or families - together, the day becomes an unforgettable event with a unique atmosphere along the course. The event offers various race distances, an attractive supporting program, and catering for all participants and guests.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the heart of the historic old town
Atmospheric run through the Soest city center
Moderation, music, and catering along the route
additional: Race distances: Bambini runs 475m (start 12:00), school runs 950m (ages 2016-2018, start 12:45) and 1450m (ages 2006-2015, start 14:15), main runs 4km (start 15:00) and 10km (start 15:45). Parking at the outskirts with shuttle service. Beverage and snack stands for participants and guests. Attractive family program and moderation on site. Various race distances, start and finish in the heart of the old town, catering, shuttle service, award ceremony immediately after the races.

name: Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried
price_range: 10,00 € Nachmeldegebühr für Erwachsene/Jugend U18 bis U20
description: The Autumn Cross at Bergfried is a short autumn cross-country race held on the grounds of Bergfried in Saalfeld, Germany. The course lengths range from 800 meters to 4.8 kilometers and are designed for fast trail running, not for long road races. The race takes place outside the stadium and is classified as both a mountain run and a cross-country race. The Saalfeld Athletics Club has been organizing the event for many years with separate races for children and adults as well as various age groups.
course_highlights: Terrain around Bergfried in Saalfeld
Course lengths from 800 m to 4.8 km
Combination of mountain running and cross-country
additional: The race includes categories for youth, open class, masters, and local runners from Saalfeld-Rudolstadt. In a previous edition, approximately 200 children and adolescents participated. Typical weather in October is around 14°C during the day and 6°C at night, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation and mostly cloudy skies. The race is run outside the stadium, including categories for children and adults, trail and mountain running. Registration deadline is September 29, 2026.

name: Warburger Stundenlauf 2026
description: The 34th Warburg Hour Run will take place on October 7, 2026, in Warburg. The competition is open to adults and offers both individual and team categories. The running course is flat, and the event lasts for one hour. Additionally, there are competitions for children and adolescents, with details available in the official organizer's announcement.
course_highlights: Flat course
Duration: 1 hour
Individual and team categories available
additional: A competition for children and adolescents is offered. Start and finish are at Hüffertsportplatz; precise location details require RUNME Premium. The event is part of the RUNME race calendar. Participants receive certificates and trophies; registration is online; the event takes place in good weather in October.

name: 25. Volkslauf um den Altwarmbüchener See
description: The Volkslauf around Lake Altwarmbüchener is part of the Sparkassen Laufpass of the Hanover region, one of the largest running series in Germany with 43 events in 2026. The race offers runners the opportunity to explore the Hanover region on foot and participate in a diverse range of running events. Each participation is rewarded with a stamp in the Laufpass, which is available both digitally and in traditional form. The event is aimed at recreational athletes and promotes active movement in the region.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Altwarmbüchener
Scenic route in the Hanover region
Part of a large running series with diverse race options
additional: Participation is rewarded with a stamp in the Laufpass, which is also available digitally via the Laufpass app. The Laufpass app offers an event calendar, a digital running diary, and additional information. The Volkslauf is embedded in a series of 43 running events in the Hanover region. The race takes place in Altwarmbüchen, with on-site registration possible, scheduled for March 1, 2026. It is part of the Laufpass series, featuring various distances including 1.6 km, 3.6 km, 7.2 km, and 10.8 km.

name: BKK Walking am Baldeneysee mit Mini-Marathon
description: The BKK Walking at Lake Baldeney is part of the Westenergie Marathon Weekend in Essen and offers a diverse program for walkers, Nordic walkers, and runners. The main marathon runs twice around Lake Baldeney with an additional turnaround loop and is characterized by a flat profile and fast bike paths. The marathon has been held annually since 1963, making it Germany's oldest event of its kind. The event is organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with support from numerous volunteers. The number of participants is limited to 3,000 to avoid bottlenecks on the course.
course_highlights: Flat profile around Lake Baldeney
Two laps with an additional turnaround loop in the first lap
Fast bike paths and early autumn weather
additional: Participant limit of 3,000 due to bottlenecks on the course. Walking program offers routes up to 14 km. Event takes place annually on the second Sunday in October. Organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with volunteer support. Distances: 1.1 km, 7 km, 42.2 km; limited to 3,000 participants; weather in October around 14°C, cloudy; registration recommended with the organizer.

name: Brakelsieker Volkslauf "Am Fuße des Mörths"
location: Sportplatz Brakelsiek, Schieder-Schwalenberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Brakelsieker Volkslauf "At the Foot of Mörth" is a classic local race, walking, and Nordic walking event in Schieder-Schwalenberg, taking place on a Saturday afternoon in October. Various distances are offered for adults and youths, including 5 km, 9 km, and 15 km running, as well as 5 km and 9 km walking or Nordic walking. The start and finish are located at the sports field in Brakelsiek, and the course runs around the village sports field with a rather hilly, rural profile at the foot of Mörth. The event provides a nice opportunity to experience the autumn landscape in a relaxed atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports field in Brakelsiek
Loop course around the village sports field, not a point-to-point course
Hilly course with a rural profile at the foot of Mörth
additional: Offered are running, walking, and Nordic walking distances for adults and youths. Typical weather in October is around 14 °C with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The course is not considered a tough mountain route but offers moderate elevation gain. Running and walking events, start and finish at the sports field in Brakelsiek, rather hilly course, rural profile.

name: Coesfelder DJK - Citylauf
description: The 32nd Coesfelder City Run will take place on October 10, 2026, in Coesfeld. The event is organized by DJK Eintracht Coesfeld e.V. and offers runners of all ages the opportunity to engage in sports. The City Run combines leisure, competitive, health, and rehabilitation sports and is an established event in the region. Online registration is available through the official website.
course_highlights: Measured, flat city courses through the historic city center
Various running distances for all age and performance groups
Attractive prizes, certificates, and trophies for top runners and groups
additional: The organizer's office is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 12:00 and 14:30 to 18:00. The office is closed on December 24 and 31, as well as on public holidays. The website features images from photobello and provides registration lists for individual races. Road/landscape run, registration open, various running distances, start and finish locations in the city center of Coesfeld, age categories for children, hobby runners, club members, and older participants.

name: Parforceheide Crosslauf
location: Sportplatz an der Heinrich-Zille-Straße, Stahnsdorf, Brandenburg, Germany
description: The Parforceheide Cross Country has been organized since 2008 by RSV Eintracht 1949 in Stahnsdorf and offers local recreational runners the opportunity to experience the diverse landscape of the Parforceheide. The course runs from the sports field along Heinrich-Zille-Straße past the Southwest Cemetery through forest and nature with small inclines, sandy passages, as well as asphalt and cobblestone sections. Races are offered over 1 km (Bambini), 3 km (school children), 5 km, and 10 km for youth and adults. After the race, the organizer provides refreshments, and football matches often take place on the sports field, creating a fun sports day for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Course through the Parforceheide with forest and nature passages
Varied surfaces: sand, asphalt, cobblestones
Small inclines provide challenge and variety
additional: There are races for different age groups and distances: Bambini run (1 km), school children run (3 km), 5 km and 10 km for youth and adults. Refreshments are provided on the sports field after the race. The event is part of the Mittelmarkcup and is supported by many volunteers. Football matches on artificial turf often take place afterwards, rounding out the day for families and companions. Terrain includes inclines, sandy passages, asphalt, cobblestones. Registration via www.ziel-zeit.de

name: Solvay Lauf
description: The Solvay Run Bernburg is a 5 km race in Bernburg, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place on October 10, 2026. The start is at Krumbholzallee 8 at 10:00 AM. The race is part of the Solvay Cup and combines cross-country and road running, making it not a simple flat city course. It is primarily aimed at local clubs and usually attracts 100 to 300 runners. The event offers professional timing, online results, certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop-off, and catering at the finish line.
course_highlights: 5 km course with a mix of cross-country and road running
Start at Krumbholzallee 8 in Bernburg
Local race with a manageable number of participants (100-300 runners)
additional: Registration is possible online, in person beforehand, or on the day of the event on site. Chip timing via race result, online results and start lists, photos and reports, printed and online certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop-off, and catering at the finish line. Typical weather in October: around 14°C, mostly cloudy with 40mm of precipitation. The event is not a large-scale event but a local race with typically 100 to 300 participants. It offers not only the race but also a friendly atmosphere with catering, showers, and parking facilities.

name: Viersener Herbstwaldlauf Rund um den Bismarckturm
description: The 79th Viersen Autumn Forest Run around the Bismarck Tower will take place on October 10, 2026, in Viersen. The event offers a 5 km run for adults on a hilly course with a time limit of one hour. Additionally, there is a Walking & Nordic Walking competition over 7.25 km. The age restriction is from 14 to 99 years for the run and 10 to 99 years for walking. The event is traditional and targets runners and walkers seeking a challenging course in an autumnal forest landscape.
course_highlights: Hilly course
Around the Bismarck Tower
Time limit of 1 hour for the 5 km run
additional: There are competitions for children and adolescents, further information can be found in the official announcement of the organizer. Start and finish are the same for all competitions, exact locations are only shown with RUNME Premium. Results are categorized by age groups, with classification based on year of birth. Multiple competitions with different distances, age groups, and start times; participation for youths from 14 years old; results are published on the website.

name: Volkslauf mit Walking um den AWB See
description: The 25th Volkslauf with walking around the AWB Lake is a local running and walking event in Altwarmbüchen, a district of Isernhagen. The event offers short, flat distances around the Altwarmbüchen Lake, with one lap measuring approximately 3.66 km. There are various running and walking routes for adults as well as children and youth races, making the day a communal running experience for the entire region. Start and finish are located at Seestraße 23, and the races take place in the afternoon.
course_highlights: Flat course around the Altwarmbüchen Lake
Lap of about 3.66 km in length
Offers for running and Nordic walking
additional: The races start in the afternoon in the following order: first the 3.6 km run, then the walkers, followed by the 7.2 km run for adults. The event is more a communal running day for the town than a single main race. Typical weather in October is around 14 °C with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Course lengths range from 1.6 km to 10.8 km, flat terrain, running and walking events, children and youth races, scheduled for October 10, 2026.

name: Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K
price_range: 25,00 € bis 70,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Berlin Morning Post Great 10K is Berlin's fastest 10 km race starting in front of Charlottenburg Palace. The course takes runners through Berlin Zoo and offers a unique running experience in the capital. In addition to the classic 10-kilometer route, there is also a 2x5 km relay as well as a 4.2 km short course from the zoo to Charlottenburg Palace. The event is suitable for all performance levels and ages and features a large running festival for the whole family.
course_highlights: Start in front of Charlottenburg Palace
Course passes through Berlin Zoo
Running festival on the forecourt of Charlottenburg Palace
additional: Timing with shoe transponder, refreshment points and toilets along the route, pacemakers for 10 km and short course, online certificate with personal result, BVG tickets for relay runners, luggage transport from start to finish, medal engraving and event shirts as additional services, HD video of the finish line for purchase, children and toddler runs for ages 2014 to 2021. Course lengths: 10 km, 4.2 km, children and toddler runs, relay competitions; registration until October 20, 2024; start in front of Berlin Zoo, finish at Charlottenburg Palace; event extras such as medal engraving, photos, and videos available.

name: 19. Burger-Rolandlauf
description: The Burger Roland Run is a traditional race that usually takes place in Burg and is organized jointly by the Roland Gymnasium Burg and the LG Ihleläufer Burg. The course runs through the city along the Ihle, through the forest, and past the Bismarck Tower, with a finish at the schoolyard of the Gymnasium. In addition to the athletic competition, participants can enjoy a lively supporting program with live music, children's activities, and refreshments. In 2026, the event in Burg was canceled due to lack of approval; instead, a replacement event will be held in the Tangerhütte city park.
course_highlights: Course runs through the city of Burg along the Ihle
Forest passage with views of the Bismarck Tower
Finish at the schoolyard of the Roland Gymnasium
additional: The traditional route in Burg was not approved in 2026. Instead, a replacement event will take place in the Tangerhütte city park. Already paid entry fees can be refunded. After the race, there will be a supporting program with music, children's activities, and refreshments. Cancellation in 2026, replacement event in Tangerhütte, course through Burg, children's program, bouncy castle, refreshments

name: Frühstückslauf
description: The breakfast run in Wernigerode is a communal run without timing, leading from the marketplace up to Wernigerode Castle. The route is approximately 3 kilometers long with an elevation gain of 100 meters. The run takes place in a group and is free of charge. After the run, a small snack is served, making it a social event.
course_highlights: Route approximately 3 km long
Elevation gain approximately 100 m
Group run up to Wernigerode Castle
additional: The run is free of charge, conducted in a group, and without timing. A small snack is served afterwards. Group run, no timing, subsequent snack.

name: H/21 Halbmarathon
description: The H/21 Half Marathon Hannover is a new running event in the national calendar, combining urban flair, modern beats, and green route sections. Start and finish are located in the city of Hannover, and the route passes by prominent hotspots through the state capital. The event takes place in autumn and offers a special running experience in a lively city environment. Join the prologue as Hannover writes a new chapter in running history.
course_highlights: Route combines urban flair with green sections
Start and finish in the city of Hannover
Route passes by prominent hotspots of the state capital
additional: Check-in takes place on October 10, 2026, with the start gun firing on October 11, 2026. The event is a fall highlight with urban flair and modern music. There are attractive side events, and the route is secured by security personnel. Participation is at your own risk, and the regulations of the DLV and IAAF apply. In 2026, the route will be run twice over 10 km, later covering the full half marathon distance; registration is open until the day of the event; race features a modern atmosphere and music.

name: Bad Hersfelder Lollslauf
description: The Bad Hersfelder Lollslauf is a traditional running event held annually in Bad Hersfeld, attracting runners of all ages and skill levels. With various distances from a toddler run to a 10 km individual race, the Lollslauf offers a sporting challenge in a beautiful setting. In addition to the competition, community spirit and the joy of running are emphasized. The event is a fixture in the race calendar and draws participants from all over Germany.
course_highlights: 500m toddler run around the marketplace and the oldest folk festival in Germany
Various courses from 500m to 10 km with start and finish at Linggplatz
Run through the historic old town of Bad Hersfeld
additional: Start times: 1.3 km school run at 09:35, 5 km individual race at 10:00, 5 km team race at 10:10, 5 km Nordic walking at 11:30, 10 km individual race at 11:45, 500 m toddler run at 11:15. Certificates available for download digitally, drinks at the finish area. Team race with 5-7 persons per team possible. Trophies for overall winners. Multiple competition classes, registration on site possible, scenic course in Bad Hersfeld.

name: Burscheider Stadtlauf
location: Burscheid, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Burscheid City Run takes place on October 11, 2026, in the city center of Burscheid and offers an ideal environment for runners of all performance levels. There are various distances: the 10-kilometer main race, a 3-kilometer run, and an 800-meter race that serves as a qualification for the sports badge. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and is aimed at both ambitious runners and recreational athletes. All finishers receive the traditional Kretzer City Run bread, and the top places are awarded special trophies.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer main race through the city center
3-kilometer run for recreational athletes
800-meter youth race as a sports badge qualification
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event at the registration office with a late registration fee of €5.00, but late registrants do not receive the Kretzer City Run bread. Race packets will be distributed from 10:30 AM at the Protestant church. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall "Auf dem Schulberg". Free drinks are available along the course and at the finish line. There is an age group classification according to DLO. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross, Burscheid branch. Bib numbers must be worn on the chest. The event also includes children's races, race packets from 10:30 AM, online results, age group classification, as well as medals and trophies. The weather in October is usually mild, making participation comfortable.

name: Laubacher Ramsberglauf
price_range: bis 20. September vergünstigtes Startgeld, danach zzgl. Nachmeldegebühr
description: The Laubach Ramsberglauf is a traditional race event that starts and ends in the picturesque castle park of Laubach. The event offers various race distances for different age and performance groups, including a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run, as well as children’s and kids’ races. The races feature a varied course that runs through the beautiful landscape around Laubach. The organization ensures a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments, changing facilities, and an award ceremony directly in the castle park.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the Laubach castle park
Varied course through the landscape around Laubach
Refreshments and changing facilities in the sports and cultural hall
additional: Registration is via RACERESULT with a discounted entry fee until September 20, after which a late registration fee applies. Changing and shower facilities are available in the sports and cultural hall. The award ceremony takes place directly in the castle park. Courses: 10 km main race, 5 km fun run, children’s races over 1500 m and 300 m; registration via Raceresult; start and finish in the castle park; refreshments, changing and shower facilities on site; weather in October around 14°C, cloudy.

name: Porta Volkslauf
organizer: SC Nammen / SC Porta Westfalica Nammen e.V.
description: The Porta-Volkslauf 2026 is a traditional running event in Porta Westfalica that has been a fixed part of the regional race calendar for over three decades. The event attracts runners of all ages, from ambitious competitors to casual runners. The course runs over streets and field paths around the Nammer sports field and through the Nammer Unterholz nature reserve, offering varied, flat sections with a magnificent panorama of the Porta. The race is part of the Mühlenkreisserie and takes place at the local sports facility in Nammen. The friendly atmosphere and sense of community make the day a special experience.
course_highlights: Course over streets and field paths around the Nammer sports field
Sections through the Nammer Unterholz nature reserve
Flat and varied course sections with a panorama of the Porta
additional: The race is part of the Mühlenkreisserie (8th race 2026). Course maps for short distance (5.5 km), medium (8.8 km), and long distance (17 km) are available as PDFs. Registration will open soon. The event takes place at the sports facility in Nammen (Poggenbeeke). The courses are flat and offer unobstructed views of nature. Registration and course maps will be available soon. There will be drinks, coffee, cake, and bratwurst at the start-finish area.

name: Sebastian Fredrich Gedenklauf (LM/LC/NLC)
description: The Sebastian Fredrich Memorial Run is a traditional race in Lubmin organized by the triathlon and running group of HSG Uni Greifswald. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly and well-organized atmosphere supported by many volunteers. The course runs through scenic sections and is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of an active running and triathlon community in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.
course_highlights: Running course through scenic sections in Lubmin
Good organization with many helpers along the course and at the finish area
Traditional race with a high number of participants and a positive atmosphere
additional: The event is organized by the triathlon and running group of HSG Uni Greifswald. There are relay competitions on middle and short distances. The event is characterized by very good participation and positive feedback. An para-athlete was specially honored for outstanding performance. The event also offers special short distances for youth (U10, U12, U14) and promotes club spirit. The weather in October is usually mild, with temperatures around 14°C, and the event takes place at the seaside resort center near the Baltic Sea.

name: Storkower See Lauf
description: The Storkower See Run is a traditional running event organized by the Triathlon Club Fürstenwalde 1990 e.V. and approved by the Brandenburg Athletics Association. On October 11, 2026, runners of various age groups and performance levels can participate on different distances around Lake Storkow. The event offers a fair competition atmosphere and is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages. Online registration opens in January 2026, and participants will be listed in an official participant list.
course_highlights: Various distances from 1 km to 15.2 km
Running routes around Lake Storkow
Start and finish area with modern race instructions
additional: Race bibs will be issued on the day of the event from 08:00 AM. There are several competition classes (WK1 to WK6) with different start times. Award ceremonies will take place from approximately 11:00 AM. Registration becomes valid only upon receipt of payment. Online registration is possible; start times and distances vary. Suitable for runners of all performance levels.

name: Styrumer Straßenlauf "Rund um die Neustadtstraße"
location: Neustadtstraße, Mülheim an der Ruhr, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
distance_verbose: 25 km, Halbmarathon, Halbmarathon, 15 km, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Styrumer Straßenlauf "Rund um die Neustadtstraße" is a traditional road race in Mülheim an der Ruhr, focusing on Neustadtstraße in Styrum. The event offers various distances from 1 km up to 100 km, including 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km, 25 km, a half marathon, and 50 km. The courses are officially measured and listed in the running.de race calendar, enabling participation in the German best lists. The race is conducted according to the rules and safety standards of the German Athletics Association (DLV).
course_highlights: Officially measured road race courses
A variety of distances from 1 km to 100 km
Event takes place on Neustadtstraße in Styrum
additional: Typical weather in October: around 14°C, lows of 6°C, average 40 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy. The event also includes shorter distances such as 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km, 25 km, as well as special runs for children and youth. The course runs through Neustadtstraße and Sportpark Styrum, with cool October weather averaging 14°C. The event is listed in the official race calendar and complies with the standards of the German Athletics Association.

name: Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof-Lauf 2026
location: Schloss Erbhof, Kirchwiehe, Thedinghausen, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof Run will take place on October 11, 2026, in Kirchwiehe, directly opposite Schloss Erbhof in Thedinghausen, Lower Saxony. Organized by TSV Thedinghausen, the road race has been open to children, adolescents, active adults, and masters since 2016. Distances offered include 10 km, 5 km, and an 800 m children's run, which takes place in the tree park near the start and finish. The course is a measured, flat 5 km loop, also suitable for Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Measured, flat 5 km loop
10 km course runs the loop twice
800 m children's run in the tree park directly at Schloss Erbhof
additional: The 5 km course is also suitable for Nordic walking. The weather in October typically averages 14°C with lows around 6°C and mostly cloudy skies. The children's race "Löwenlauf" is specifically designed for the youngest participants and takes place near the start and finish area. Start and finish in Kirchwiehe opposite Schloss Erbhof, children's race in the tree park, October weather with temperatures around 14°C low and 6°C high, 40 mm precipitation, mostly cloudy.

name: Wendlandmarathon
location: Kolborn bei Lüchow, Lüchow-Dannenberg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Wendlandmarathon Kolborn is a traditional road race in Lüchow, Lower Saxony, held annually since 1993. The event offers a wide range of distances from the marathon to half marathon and short children's runs, appealing to both long-distance runners and families. The course is measured according to AIMS/IAAF standards and features kilometer markers as well as refreshment stations. Participants have access to practical facilities such as parking, showers, changing rooms, certificates, and finisher medals for children.
course_highlights: Road race with course measured according to AIMS/IAAF standards
Kilometer markers and refreshment stations along the course
Various distances from 400 m to marathon
additional: Start in the morning with marathon and relay marathon, followed by half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km runs. Registration is possible online in advance or on race weekend on-site. Timing is provided by the organizer. There is a finish line catering. Certificates are printed and available online. Course length up to 42.2 km, on-course refreshments, finisher medals, parking, showers, changing rooms, registration online or on-site.

name: Westenergie Marathon
description: The Westenergie Marathon in Essen is a traditional race around the picturesque Baldeneysee. The event offers not only the classic marathon but also the Westenergie Seerunde, the AllbauTeamStaffel relay race, a mini-marathon for children, and a Walking Day. The course impresses with its scenic beauty and proximity to the lake shore, making the race a special experience for runners of all ages. The event is well organized and attracts numerous participants each year.
course_highlights: Run around the Baldeneysee with scenic lake views
Start and finish at Seaside Beach in Essen
Sections with lake views and through the landscape protection area Heisinger Aue
additional: Start and finish are at Seaside Beach at Baldeneysee. There is a paperless registration process via QR code on the event day. For children, there is a mini-marathon over 1.1 km with prizes and medals for all participants. Photobello offers race photos. The Walking Day routes feature various distances with beautiful lake views and also pass through the landscape protection area Heisinger Aue. The marathon is Germany's oldest continuously held marathon, with a flat, fast course, multiple race disciplines, and regional sponsorship. Results and certificates are available online.

name: Falke-Rothaarsteigmarathon
location: Schmallenberger Sauerland, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 23rd FALKE Rothaarsteig-Marathon will take place on October 17, 2026, in Schmallenberger Sauerland. The event offers disciplines for marathon, half marathon, walking, Nordic walking, and a 12.5 km AOK run. The course runs through the scenic region of the Rothaar Mountains and is recognized as an approved popular race by the DLV. Over 1,000 active runners participate annually and enjoy the varied trail and forest landscape.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the Rothaar Mountains
Approved popular race with DLV recognition
Various disciplines: marathon, half marathon, walking, Nordic walking, 12.5 km AOK run
additional: Registrations are possible from May 1, 2026. Late registrations are accepted until half an hour before the respective start. The start times are staggered: marathon at 11:00 AM, half marathon at 12:00 PM, walking and Nordic walking at 12:15 PM, AOK run at 11:45 AM. The event location is Latroper-Str. 57392 Fleckenberg in Schmallenberger Sauerland. Registration begins on May 1, 2026. No dog runs are permitted. Detailed course description available. Start times and organizational information can be found on the website.

name: Hachenburger Löwenlauf
description: The Hachenburg Lion Run is a traditional race with a family-friendly character, taking place on October 17, 2026, in Hachenburg. The event offers various distances, including a half marathon, 10.5 km run, 6.3 km fun/run team race, as well as children's races. The courses lead through diverse landscapes of the Westerwald with appealing elevation changes and beautiful views. Since 1989, the proceeds from the race have been donated to social projects, giving the race a special social significance.
course_highlights: Half marathon with the highest point at Gräbersberg (513 m) and varied ascents and descents
10.5 km run mostly on forest paths with the highest point at 439 m above sea level
Start and finish area at the round sports hall in Hachenburg with changing and shower facilities
additional: Electronic timing without chip, certificates for all finishers, prizes for class winners, special prize for the largest team participation in the team race. Late registration possible on October 16 from 17:00 and on the event day from 09:00. Refreshments with electrolytes, water, tea, cola, and fruit available on the course and at the finish. Changing and shower facilities available at the round sports hall. Various race distances (half marathon, 10.5 km, 6.3 km team and fun run, children's races), start and finish area at Lohmühle, Hachenburg, electronic timing (without chip), certificates for all finishers, prizes for class winners, refreshments on the course and at the finish, registration only online.

name: Herbstlauf des LSV Porz
organizer: LSV Porz / Kölner Lauf- und Nordic-Walkingteam
description: The autumn run of LSV Porz is the oldest road race in Cologne and takes place in the picturesque leisure area of Leidenhausen. The event offers distances from 1 km to 10 km, which are measured according to the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLV) and are eligible for best lists. Both ambitious runners and recreational joggers can enjoy the autumnal idyll while running. The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne and the surrounding area and is often used by top runners to check their form.
course_highlights: Running routes in the leisure area of Leidenhausen in autumnal surroundings
5 km loop as one of the fastest running routes in Cologne
Course measurement according to DLV guidelines, eligible for best lists
additional: Start number must be worn on the chest. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Late registration on the event day is possible for a fee of 2 €, students are exempt from the fee. Liability disclaimer for thefts, accidents, or other damages. Payment via SEPA direct debit a few days before the event. No fee will be charged if the event is canceled. Course measured, registration until 14.10.2025, start times from 11:00 am, parking available nearby, participation in running and Nordic walking events.

name: Krummenseelauf
description: The Krummenseelauf is a traditional road race in Mittenwalde, Brandenburg, organized by WSG 1981 Königs Wusterhausen since 1980. The course runs around Lake Krummensee, which is the central feature of the event. Three distances are offered (3.6 km, 7.2 km, and 15 km) as well as Nordic Walking, all starting in the morning. The event typically takes place in autumn and is part of the Oder-Spree-Cup, making it attractive for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Krummensee
Start at Krummenseer Straße at the sports field in Schenkendorf
Road race with distances of 3.6 km, 7.2 km, and 15 km
additional: All runs and Nordic Walking events start in the morning within a few minutes of each other. The event is part of the Oder-Spree-Cup and typically takes place in autumn with an average temperature of 14 °C. The event occurs in October, with start and finish in Schenkendorf, Mittenwalde. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the beautiful course around Lake Krummensee.

name: Panoramalauf Niedenstein
description: The 24th Niedensteiner Panorama Run will take place on October 17, 2026, in Niedenstein. The event is organized by SG 1898 Chattengau e.V. and the Niedenstein Running Group. The race offers an attractive course around the Hessenturm Stadium and the club house, set in the beautiful landscape of the region. Participants can look forward to a well-organized running event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Hessenturm Stadium in Niedenstein
Run through the picturesque surroundings of Niedenstein
Event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup
additional: Hilly terrain, family-friendly, children and youth races, finish at Hessenturm Stadium

name: Prignitzer Moormeile
description: The Prignitz Moon Race in Bad Wilsnack is a traditional run taking place on October 17, 2026, for the 26th time. The event offers various distances from 1 km to 12.4 km, running through Wilsnack forests, the spa park, and around the Karthane Hall. The races are suitable for children, teenagers, and adults and are part of the Prignitz Cup as well as the Brandenburg Cup. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, good catering along the route, and professional timing.
course_highlights: 12.4 km and 7.8 km through Wilsnack forests on asphalt and forest paths
3 km course through the spa park
1 km loop course in front of the Karthane Hall
additional: Late registrations are possible on the race day from 08:00 to 09:30, provided the maximum number of participants, 550, has not been reached. The late registration fee is 5 euros in addition to the race fee. Start and finish are at the Karthane Hall in Bad Wilsnack, which also offers showers and toilets. Overall winners receive trophies. Dogs are not allowed during the race. There are refreshment stations on the longer routes. The event offers online registration, catering, showers, and prizes for the top runners. The Moon Race is also known for notable guests such as Dieter Baumann and high participant numbers.

name: TeutoMarsch
location: Grundschule Hohne, Lengerich-Hohne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Teutomarsch is a unique hiking and running experience through the Teutoburg Forest and the surrounding area. Organized by the Turnverein Hohne von 1911 e.V. in Lengerich, the Teutomarsch offers two routes designed to inspire participants. The event is very popular and the starting spots are quickly filled. The exact course layout is still being finalized but promises a great and unique route. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and dogs are allowed on a leash.
course_highlights: Unique course through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area
Two different routes for a special experience
Nature experience in the Lengerich-Hohne region
additional: Registration for the Teutomarsch 2026 was fully booked within 30 minutes with 500 starting places. There is a waiting list. Participants agree to photo and video recordings and their publication. No refund of entry fees. Minimum age 16 years. Dogs are allowed on a leash. The organizer assumes no liability for personal or property damage as well as loss or theft. Trail running, no timing, refreshment stations along the route, start & finish at the Hohne elementary school, participant limit 500.

name: 20. Müggelsee-Halbmarathon
price_range: 15 EUR bis 47 EUR je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Müggelsee Half Marathon is a scenic race in the southeast of Berlin, completely circling the Große Müggelsee. The event offers three course lengths: half marathon, 10 kilometers, and 5 kilometers, each designed as either point-to-point or loop courses. The route passes through the historic Spreetunnel and offers an idyllic setting with views of the largest Berlin lake and the surrounding Müggelberge hills. The race is suitable for all runners aiming for personal bests or simply wanting to enjoy the community and nature. Start and finish are at the Müggelseeperle, and the race takes place on October 18, 2026.
course_highlights: Loop course completely around the Große Müggelsee
Crossing the historic Spreetunnel in Friedrichshagen
Idyllic landscape with views of Müggelberge and Berlin skyline
additional: Race bib pickup on October 17, 2026 from 12:30 to 16:00 and on October 18, 2026 from 07:30 at the Müggelseeperle. Late registrations only on October 17, 2026, with a 3 EUR late registration fee; no late registrations on race day. Free boat shuttle to the start on October 18, 2026, at 8:30 from Friedrichshagen/Spreetunnel. Bag drop available, changing tent on site. Optional T-shirt, preferred race number, and boat accompaniment tickets for relatives can be booked. Terrain includes lake and shoreline paths. Online registration, shuttle service, start/finish in the Müggelsee area, various race distances.

description: The Stadtwerke Lübeck Marathon on October 18, 2026 offers runners a diverse selection of distances in the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck. The event includes, in addition to the classic marathon, a duo marathon, half marathon, relay race, and other shorter runs suitable for all age and performance levels. The course runs through the picturesque city and provides a sporting challenge with regional championship scoring. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and emphasizes community and sporting passion.
course_highlights: Marathon with Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring
Change point for duo marathon in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea
Course through the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck
additional: Free medal engraving available upon registration by January 31, 2026, with name, distance, and finish time. Preferred starting number can be chosen free of charge during early registration phases, subject to availability. Relay race with 10 x 4.2 km segments. Handbike half marathon with the same course as the runner half marathon. Change point for duo marathon in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea. Course catering includes honey gels. Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring. Registration deadline is September 30, 2026. Various starting number and medal options.

name: Almetal-Marathon
description: The Almetal Marathon 2026 takes place on October 18 and offers runners a scenic route from Büren-Ringelstein to the Ahorn Sports Park in Paderborn. In addition to the classic marathon distance, there are two half-marathon variants as well as a relay race over four segments. The event is characterized by the voluntary commitment of numerous sports clubs and provides a family-friendly atmosphere as well as an impressive natural experience in the Almetal.
course_highlights: Scenic route along the Almetal
Marathon from Büren-Ringelstein to Paderborn
Two half-marathon variants and a relay race with 4 x 10.5 km
additional: The event is organized voluntarily by twelve sports clubs along the route. District administrator Christopher Rüther is the patron. It offers a family-friendly and accessible atmosphere appreciated by participants and spectators. The route runs from Büren-Ringelstein to Paderborn, including half-marathon variants and a relay race; registration via my.raceresult.com

name: Hambacher Herbstwaldlauf
description: The Hambacher Autumn Forest Run is a traditional race in Niederzier-Hambach that takes place annually in autumn. Participants enjoy the beautiful atmosphere with the vibrant colors of the forest in autumn weather. Around 200 runners participate across various age groups and distances. The event is organized by DJK "Löwe" Hambach e.V. and offers a family-friendly and sporting atmosphere for recreational and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal forest with colorful foliage
Various routes for children, teenagers, and adults
Traditional event with a family club character
additional: The event attracts approximately 200 runners. Results from the previous year are available online with certificate printing. The event is organized by DJK "Löwe" Hambach e.V. There are no specific details about start times, fee structures, or registration options on the website. Trail through the forest, online registration possible, start and finish at the Sophienhöhe parking lot, event in October 2026.

name: Müngstener Brückenlauf
description: The Müngstener Bridge Run is a traditional race in Solingen that takes participants through scenic landscapes. The course begins on the narrow Schäfchenweg and features a final ascent before the finish line, passing by meadows and fields. The race is organized by the Solinger Leichtathletik-Club 1951 e.V. and attracts runners from the region.
course_highlights: Start on the narrow, scenic Schäfchenweg
Final ascent before the finish line past meadows and fields
Run through a picturesque environment in Solingen
additional: Results from previous years are available in the archive. Photos of past races can be viewed in the SLC gallery. The course crosses the Müngstener Bridge, including scenic paths and ascents; annual event in October. Certificates can be downloaded online.

name: Traditioneller Sparkassen-Herbstwaldlauf
location: Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum, Beckum, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The traditional Sparkassen Autumn Forest Run in Beckum is a popular running event taking place on October 18, 2026, at the Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum. The event offers various competitions for all age groups, including a Bambini run, school run, 5 km fun run, 5 km walk, and the 10 km main race. Participants receive medals, certificates, and trophies, making the race an inspiring experience for both recreational and competitive runners. Late registrations are possible until about 30 minutes before the start, providing flexibility for last-minute entrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum
Competitions for all age groups from Bambini to main race
Trophies for the top finishers and certificates for all participants
additional: Late registrations are accepted on the event day until approximately 30 minutes before the start for a fee of 2€. All participants in the Bambini and school runs receive medals, certificates are awarded for the 5 km fun run and 5 km walk, and trophies are awarded to the top three finishers in the 10 km main race, with certificates for all participants. The race takes place in the forest, with registration and results available on the website.

name: Helberhäuser HauBerg-Lauf
description: The Helberhäuser HauBerg Run is a traditional race taking place for the 29th time on October 24, 2026. Organized by TSG Helberhausen, the event features a modified course that runs two laps of the well-known route. The race is part of the Rothaar Running Series and offers a sporting challenge for runners of all ages in the Hilchenbach region. TSG Helberhausen is a versatile sports club with a wide range of offerings, organizing the race as one of its many popular events.
course_highlights: Two laps of the well-known HauBerg Run route
Part of the Rothaar Running Series
Traditional race in the Hilchenbach region
additional: The course was adjusted for 2025. The event is embedded in the diverse sports offerings of TSG Helberhausen, which has over 20 departments providing a broad spectrum of sports. The 2026 anniversary features a special course layout where all runners will run the course in reverse. The event offers various competitions, including children's runs and Nordic walking, and takes place on a challenging hilly course.

name: Lauf um den Mittelpunkt von Sachsen
description: The race around the center of Saxony takes place in Naundorf (Bobritzsch-Hilbersdorf) and is organized by TVL Freiberg e.V. The event is a stadium-independent athletics event that appeals to various age groups from children to masters. The race offers a sporting challenge in the beautiful surroundings of the Tharandt Forest and is an established event in the Saxon athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Race in the Tharandt Forest near Naundorf
Stadium-independent event with a natural course layout
Various age groups from children to masters
additional: The race takes place on October 24, 2026, with different distances for children, adolescents, and adults. The event is part of the regional athletics competitions and offers the opportunity to participate in state championships as well as public race events.

name: Nordwalder Laufspektakel
description: The Nordwalde Running Spectacle is a popular running event with various race distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon, as well as children's runs. It takes place annually in Nordwalde and attracts numerous runners looking forward to a sporting challenge. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and good organization. It offers suitable running opportunities for both ambitious runners and families with children.
course_highlights: Race distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon
Children's runs over 1 km and 2 km
Participant records and course records for 5 km and half marathon
additional: The event takes place annually and offers not only the main races but also children's runs. There is a good mix of sporting challenge and family-friendly atmosphere. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. Over 800 participants in the last edition, including record times and culinary offerings, takes place in Nordwalde.

name: 24. Röntgenlauf
description: The Röntgenlauf in Remscheid is a traditional scenic race with various distances, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon, and ultramarathon. The half marathon is particularly popular, attracting up to 1500 participants and considered one of the largest scenic races in Germany. The courses lead through diverse natural scenery with forest paths and asphalt sections, with the half marathon covering about one-third of the Röntgenweg. There is a shuttle service from the finish back to the start for the half marathon, and environmental protection is emphasized by recommending reusable drinking containers.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races on a loop course between Hackenberg and Wuppersperre with approximately 95 m and 190 m elevation gain
Half marathon with approximately 405 m ascent and 560 m descent, part of the ultramarathon
Course through forest paths and asphalt, not suitable for spiked shoes
additional: The half marathon has an age restriction from 16 years, and the marathon and ultramarathon from 18 years. Minors require a written consent from guardians. There is clothing transport from start to finish and bus transfer from finish back to start. Participants are asked to use their own reusable drinking containers to protect the environment. Race bib, finisher medal, and refreshments are included. Courses vary from 5 km to ultramarathon (63.3 km), including children's races and scenic runs; registration until October 25, 2026.

name: 26. Dresden-Marathon / DRESDEN-MARATHON
description: The Dresden Marathon has been held regularly since 1999 at the end of October and offers a flat, fast course through the Saxon state capital with its famous sights. The route passes through the historic Old Town with the Brühlsche Terrasse, the Semper Opera, and other Baroque buildings, as well as through the lively Neustadt. Over 300 musicians and numerous bands create a special atmosphere along the course. The second half of the marathon leads through the district of Blasewitz with views of the castles on the Loschwitz Elbe hillside and the villas along Goetheallee, before returning along the Elbe to the Old Town.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Dresden's historic Old Town and Neustadt
Illuminated Waldschlößchen Tunnel and bridge, Großer Garten
Atmosphere created by over 300 musicians and bands along the route
additional: Over 300 musicians and numerous bands create a lively atmosphere along the course. There is a marathon expo, race bib distribution, and a SPARKASSEN pacemaker service. After the race, medals can be engraved, and services such as photo service, showers, changing rooms, toilets, and award ceremonies are available. The evening before, a jubilee party takes place in a festival tent behind the Heinz-Steyer Stadium (entry €25, limited participants). Multiple race disciplines, online registration, health questionnaire, event scheduled for October 24 and 25, 2026.

name: 35. Ricklinger Volkslauf / Ricklinger Volkslauf
location: Meisenwinkel 9, Hannover-Ricklingen, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Ricklinger Volkslauf is a local race event day in Hannover-Ricklingen, organized by TuS Ricklingen. It offers flat runs for adults of about 5.5 to 5.7 km as well as walking and Nordic walking over the same distance. The main race is a 10 km run, the Lothar-Mayer-Lauf. Additionally, there is a 400 m Bambini run for the youngest children and a 1 km school run, allowing families and club runners to start together but separated by age groups.
course_highlights: Flat courses in Hannover-Ricklingen
Runs for adults, children, and walking/Nordic walking
Finish at Meisenwinkel 9 in Hannover-Ricklingen
additional: Running and walking options are sorted by distance and age group. There is a 400 m Bambini run and a 1 km school run. All races end at the same finish location. The event takes place in Hannover-Ricklingen, with start and finish at Meisenwinkel 9. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various running options, including walking and children's races.

name: 44. Zerbster Rolandlauf
description: The 44th Zerbster Rolandlauf is a traditional community run in Zerbst, Saxony-Anhalt, with start and finish at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium. The event takes place on a Sunday in October and is organized by the athletics department of TSV Rot-Weiß Zerbst. Various distances are offered for all age groups, from short children's runs to 10 kilometers for adults. The course consists of a flat 5-kilometer loop on road and mixed terrain, which also passes through the stadium. Winners receive special 3D medals and certificates for the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop on road and mixed terrain
Course passes through the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium
10 km run consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Separate categories for children, adolescents, adults, and seniors. Winners receive special 3D medals and certificates for the top three in each category. Typical weather in October: around 14°C, mostly cloudy with about 40 mm of precipitation. The run also supports the Anhalt Hospice Zerbst, with the event designed as a community and public race featuring medals and certificates.

name: Oldenburg Marathon / Oldenburg Marathon 2026
price_range: 35 Euro für das Sportshirt (zusätzliche Startgebühren nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon on October 25, 2026, offers a diverse range of running events including the EWE Marathon, public half marathon, AZO relay half marathon, 10 km Volksbank City Run, 5 km Müller & Egerer Run, and the Decathlon Kids' Miles Run. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to participate in various disciplines. The course runs through the city of Oldenburg and provides a great running experience for participants of all performance levels. Additionally, there is a high-quality, sustainable long-sleeve shirt as a special offer for registered participants.
course_highlights: Diverse courses from marathon to kids' run
Course through the city of Oldenburg
Start time at 10:00 AM for short-distance runs
additional: Race bibs will be distributed on October 11 from 11 AM at the Schlosshöfe. Pre-event check-in on Saturday from 11 AM to 6 PM is recommended. There is a group registration option. A high-quality, sustainable long-sleeve shirt by Wijld for 35 EUR is available only with registration. Race bibs can also be collected by relatives. Multiple race distances, starting points in Oldenburg, special medals, event merchandise, and information on race bibs and registration.

name: Gütersloher DJK Halbmarathon
description: The Gütersloh DJK Half Marathon is an established running event in Gütersloh, taking place on October 25, 2026. Participants can choose from a half marathon as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The courses are officially measured according to DLV standards and are suitable for record listings. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for the fastest runners in various age groups and overall classifications.
course_highlights: DLV measured half marathon course according to IAAF/AIMS standards
5 km and 10 km road races as additional competitions
Impressive awards for positions 1-6 in the overall field
additional: Certificates can be downloaded from the timing company's website www.timeteam-jung.de. Award ceremonies will take place as soon as possible after the races in a tent. Parking is available at the Hauptschule Nord, Ahornallee. The DJK Gütersloh assumes no liability for accidents, thefts, or other damages. Course measurement according to DLV/IAAF/AIMS, online registration, parking at Hauptschule Nord, liability disclaimer, certificates via www.timeteam-jung.de

name: Oeventroper Volks- und Straßenlauf
location: Sportplatz 'In den Oeren', Arnsberg-Oeventrop, Arnsberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Oeventrop People's and Street Run is a local road race in Arnsberg-Oeventrop held at the sports field 'In den Oeren'. The focus is on the flat 10 km race for adults, which starts in the morning. Additionally, there is a 5 km youth run and several 1.1 km children's races, separated by age and gender. Start and finish are centrally located at the sports field, making the race family-friendly and easy to follow. The event is organized by TuS 1896 Oeventrop e.V. and is part of the Lauf Cup standings.
course_highlights: Flat 10 km loop course
5 km youth run on a flat loop
Children's races over 1.1 km separated by age and gender
additional: Start and finish are at the sports field 'In den Oeren', bringing everything together for runners and families in one place. There is a three-person team competition for the 5 km run. The children's races have separate starts for different age and gender groups. Race in Arnsberg-Oeventrop, Lauf Cup standings, parking at REWE and ALDI Widayweg

name: Oldenburg Marathon
price_range: 35 Euro für Sportshirt (genaue Startgebühr nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon on October 25, 2026, offers runners a diverse program with a marathon, half marathon, relay half marathon, 10 km city run, 5 km run, and children's miles run. The course takes participants through Oldenburg and Wardenburg and is known for its good catering and friendly atmosphere. The event is open to all performance levels and also features a public running series with additional competitions throughout the year. Participants receive high-quality long-sleeve shirts and extensive on-site services.
course_highlights: Refreshment stations every 5 km from 10 km mark with water, sports drinks, and fruit
Showers in the sports hall of Graf Anton Günther School approximately 300 meters from the start-finish area
Changing rooms and baggage drop-off at parking deck 1 in the Schlosshöfe
additional: Race bibs will be distributed on October 11 from 11 a.m. in the Schlosshöfe. On the day of the event, distribution begins at 7 a.m. for marathon runners and at 8 a.m. for all others. There is group registration available. After the race, extensive catering with drinks, fruit, coffee, tea, pastries, and non-alcoholic wheat beer is provided. Free massages are offered by physiotherapy students. Mobile toilets and changing facilities are available. Multiple race distances, start in Wardenburg, street closures in the city center, medals for finishers, online registration possible.

name: Birkhahnlauf
location: Schneeren, Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Birkhahnlauf in Schneeren is a traditional race that has been held annually for over 50 years on the last Sunday of October. The event offers courses for all age groups, from short children's runs of 500 meters to challenging 5 km and 10 km runs for adults. The race routes lead through the pine forest on paved forest paths with slightly sandy ground and no significant elevation profile, making the race a special experience in nature. A new addition is a 2.3 km course starting from the U12 age group. The family-friendly atmosphere and prompt award ceremonies with certificates and medals complete the event.
course_highlights: Race routes through pine forest on paved forest paths
Course lengths from 500 m to 10.2 km for all age groups
Kilometer markers on the 5.1 km and 10.2 km routes without significant elevation profile
additional: Start times: children 500m at 10:30 AM, 1000m at 10:45 AM, 2.3 km at 11:10 AM, 5.1 km and 10.2 km at 11:40 AM. Award ceremonies take place shortly after each race. Parking is available nearby and signposted. Registration is preferred online from August 1, 2026, with the start fee payable on site up to 20 minutes before the race begins. Race takes place in the forest, with courses from 0.5 km to 10 km, children's runs, online registration from August 1, 2026, race date October 25, 2026.

name: Glauchauer Herbstlauf
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinschaft Glauchau e.V. und Kreissportbund Zwickau
description: The Glauchau Autumn Run is a traditional running event in Glauchau that has been held annually in autumn since 1986. The event offers courses for runners of all ages and performance levels, including a half marathon, 10 km, 3.2 km, and 1.1 km runs, as well as walking and Nordic walking. The routes lead through the scenic surroundings with asphalt and paved paths, including past the reservoir and castle pond. The event is a sporting highlight for the region and warmly invites all running enthusiasts to actively experience the autumn.
course_highlights: 21.1 km flat landscape run with 75% asphalt and 25% paved paths
10 km course with 25% asphalt and 75% paved paths around the reservoir and castle pond
3.2 km and 1.1 km loops around the Sachsenlandhalle Glauchau grounds
additional: Half marathon time limit: 2:45 hours, intermediate check at km 14.3 (Pavilion Reservoir) until 12:00 PM, otherwise disqualification with shortened finish route. Bib with baggage tag and raffle ticket. Parking recommendation: Kaufland, Grenayer Straße. Late registration/change of registration on 24.10.2026 from 1:00 PM to 2:30 PM possible, late registration fee 5 euros. Registrations from 01.08.2026, bibs with chips, age group classification, team and special categories, no refunds, limit for corporate and family runs as well as Special Olympics, participation includes mailing of the entry fee.

name: Ottensteiner Wottellauf

tiers.label: tier_1
